29.s:
atha samucitādhikāriṇa uddiśya rahasya ucyate'tra vidhiḥ /
atha sarvāpyupāseyaṃ kulaprakriyayocyate // 1
29.d:
अथ समुचिताधिकारिण उद्दिश्य रहस्य उच्यतेऽत्र विधिः ।
अथ सर्वाप्युपासेयं कुलप्रक्रिययोच्यते ॥ 1
29.m:
Now the secret ritual is expounded here for the appropriate qualified candidate.
Here all this worship is stated according to the Kaula method (kulaprakriyā),

29.s:
tathā dhārādhirūḍheṣu guruśiṣyeṣu yocitā /
uktaṃ ca parameśena sāratvaṃ kramapūjane // 2
29.d:
तथा धाराधिरूढेषु गुरुशिष्येषु योचिता ।
उक्तं च परमेशेन सारत्वं क्रमपूजने ॥ 2
29.m:
and it is appropriate for gurus and disciples who have ascended the stream [of tradition].
And the Supreme Lord has stated the essential nature of the worship of succession (kramapūjana):

29.s:
siddhakramaniyuktasya māsenaikena yadbhavet /
na tadvarṣasahasraiḥ syānmantraughairvividhairiti // 3
29.d:
सिद्धक्रमनियुक्तस्य मासेनैकेन यद्भवेत् ।
न तद्वर्षसहस्रैः स्यान्मन्त्रौघैर्विविधैरिति ॥ 3
29.m:
"What is attained in a single month by one dedicated to the perfected sequence (siddhakrama),
would not come about in thousands of years through diverse multitudes of mantras."

29.s:
kulaṃ ca parameśasya śaktiḥ sāmarthyamūrdhvatā /
svātantryamojo vīryaṃ ca piṇḍaḥ saṃviccharīrakam // 4
29.d:
कुलं च परमेशस्य शक्तिः सामर्थ्यमूर्ध्वता ।
स्वातन्त्र्यमोजो वीर्यं च पिण्डः संविच्छरीरकम् ॥ 4
29.m:
Kula is the power of the Supreme Lord, his efficacy, transcendence,
absolute autonomy, vigor, virility, the collective mass, consciousness, and the body.

29.s:
tathātvena samastāni bhāvajātāni paśyataḥ /
dhvastaśaṅkāsamūhasya yāgastādṛśa eva saḥ // 5
29.d:
तथात्वेन समस्तानि भावजातानि पश्यतः ।
ध्वस्तशङ्कासमूहस्य यागस्तादृश एव सः ॥ 5
29.m:
For one who sees all classes of entities as such,
and whose mass of doubts has been destroyed, sacrifice is of just that nature.

29.s:
tādṛgrūpanirūḍhyarthaṃ manovākkāyavartmanā /
yadyatsamācaredvīraḥ kulayāgaḥ sa sa smṛtaḥ // 6
29.d:
तादृग्रूपनिरूढ्यर्थं मनोवाक्कायवर्त्मना ।
यद्यत्समाचरेद्वीरः कुलयागः स स स्मृतः ॥ 6
29.m:
For the firm establishment of such a state, whatever the hero (vīra)
undertakes by way of mind, speech, and body—that is remembered as the Kula sacrifice.

29.s:
bahiḥ śaktau yāmale ca dehe prāṇapathe matau /
iti ṣoḍhā kulejyā syātpratibhedaṃ vibhedinī // 7
29.d:
बहिः शक्तौ यामले च देहे प्राणपथे मतौ ।
इति षोढा कुलेज्या स्यात्प्रतिभेदं विभेदिनी ॥ 7
29.m:
Externally, in the śakti, in the dyad, in the body, in the vital path, and in the intellect:
thus the worship of Kula is sixfold, diversifying in each specific division.

29.s:
snānamaṇḍalakuṇḍādi ṣoḍhānyāsādi yanna tat /
kiñcidatropayujyeta kṛtaṃ vā khaṇḍanāya no // 8
29.d:
स्नानमण्डलकुण्डादि षोढान्यासादि यन्न तत् ।
किञ्चिदत्रोपयुज्येत कृतं वा खण्डनाय नो ॥ 8
29.m:
Bathing, the mandala, the hearth, and so forth, or the sixfold nyāsa and the like—what is not [required] there
is of no use here; or if performed, it causes no defect.

29.s:
ṣaṇmaṇḍalavinirmuktaṃ sarvāvaraṇavarjitam /
jñānajñeyamayaṃ kaulaṃ proktaṃ traiśirase mate // 9
29.d:
षण्मण्डलविनिर्मुक्तं सर्वावरणवर्जितम् ।
ज्ञानज्ञेयमयं कौलं प्रोक्तं त्रैशिरसे मते ॥ 9
29.m:
"Free from the six mandalas, devoid of all coverings,
consisting of knowledge and the object of knowledge, the Kaula [rite] is declared in the doctrine of the Traiśirasa."

29.s:
atra yāge ca yaddravyaṃ niṣiddhaṃ śāstrasantatau /
tadeva yojayeddhīmānvāmāmṛtapariplutam // 10
29.d:
अत्र यागे च यद्द्रव्यं निषिद्धं शास्त्रसन्ततौ ।
तदेव योजयेद्धीमान्वामामृतपरिप्लुतम् ॥ 10
29.m:
And in this sacrifice, whatever substance is prohibited in the lineage of scriptures,
the wise one should employ precisely that, overflowed with the nectar of the Left.

29.s:
śrībrahmayāmale'pyuktaṃ surā śivaraso bahiḥ /
tāṃ vinā bhuktimuktī no piṣṭakṣaudraguḍaistu sā // 11
29.d:
श्रीब्रह्मयामलेऽप्युक्तं सुरा शिवरसो बहिः ।
तां विना भुक्तिमुक्ती नो पिष्टक्षौद्रगुडैस्तु सा ॥ 11
29.m:
It is also said in the venerable Brahmayāmala: "Wine is externally the fluid of Śiva;
without it there is neither enjoyment nor liberation; and it is [made] from flour, honey, or molasses.

29.s:
strīnapuṃsakapuṃrūpā tu pūrvāparabhogadā /
drākṣotthaṃ tu paraṃ tejo bhairavaṃ kalpanojjhitam // 12
29.d:
स्त्रीनपुंसकपुंरूपा तु पूर्वापरभोगदा ।
द्राक्षोत्थं तु परं तेजो भैरवं कल्पनोज्झितम् ॥ 12
29.m:
Embodying female, neuter, and male forms, it yields previous and subsequent enjoyment;
that arisen from grapes, however, is supreme splendor, Bhairava-like, devoid of conceptual constructs.

29.s:
etatsvayaṃ rasaḥ śuddhaḥ prakāśānandacinmayaḥ /
devatānāṃ priyaṃ nityaṃ tasmādetatpivetsadā // 13
29.d:
एतत्स्वयं रसः शुद्धः प्रकाशानन्दचिन्मयः ।
देवतानां प्रियं नित्यं तस्मादेतत्पिवेत्सदा ॥ 13
29.m:
This itself is pure savor, consisting of luminosity, bliss, and consciousness,
always beloved to the deities; therefore, one should always drink it."

29.s:
śrīmatkramarahasye ca nyarūpi parameśinā /
arghapātraṃ yāgadhāma dīpa ityucyate trayam // 14
29.d:
श्रीमत्क्रमरहस्ये च न्यरूपि परमेशिना ।
अर्घपात्रं यागधाम दीप इत्युच्यते त्रयम् ॥ 14
29.m:
And in the venerable Kramarahasya, the Supreme Lord determined:
"The vessel for the offering (arghapātra), the site of sacrifice, and the lamp—this triad is declared

29.s:
rahasyaṃ kaulike yāge tatrārghaḥ śaktisaṃgamāt /
bhūvastrakāyapīṭhākhyaṃ dhāma cotkarṣabhāk kramāt // 15
29.d:
रहस्यं कौलिके यागे तत्रार्घः शक्तिसंगमात् ।
भूवस्त्रकायपीठाख्यं धाम चोत्कर्षभाक् क्रमात् ॥ 15
29.m:
to be the secret in the Kaula sacrifice. There, the offering [is superior] through union with the śakti;
and the site, termed the ground, cloth, body, and seat, increases in excellence in successive order.

29.s:
dīpā ghṛtotthā gāvo hi bhūcaryo devatāḥ smṛtāḥ /
iti jñātvā traye'muṣminyatnavānkauliko bhavet // 16
29.d:
दीपा घृतोत्था गावो हि भूचर्यो देवताः स्मृताः ।
इति ज्ञात्वा त्रयेऽमुष्मिन्यत्नवान्कौलिको भवेत् ॥ 16
29.m:
Lamps arisen from ghee are cows, for they are remembered as the terrestrial deities (bhūcarī)."
Knowing this, the Kaula should make effort regarding this triad.

29.s:
tenārghapātraprādhānyaṃ jñātvā dravyāṇi śambhunā /
yānyuktānyaviśaṅko'tra bhavecchaṅkā hi dūṣikā // 17
29.d:
तेनार्घपात्रप्राधान्यं ज्ञात्वा द्रव्याणि शम्भुना ।
यान्युक्तान्यविशङ्कोऽत्र भवेच्छङ्का हि दूषिका ॥ 17
29.m:
Therefore, recognizing the preeminence of the argha vessel, regarding whatever substances
have been spoken of here by Śambhu, one should be free of hesitation, for doubt is defiling.

29.s:
yāgauko gandhadhūpāḍhyaṃ praviśya prāgudaṅmukhaḥ /
parayā vā'tha mālinyā vilomāccānulomataḥ // 18
29.d:
यागौको गन्धधूपाढ्यं प्रविश्य प्रागुदङ्मुखः ।
परया वाऽथ मालिन्या विलोमाच्चानुलोमतः ॥ 18
29.m:
Having entered the sacrificial chamber filled with fragrance and incense, facing east or north,
either with the Parā or with Mālinī, in reverse and direct order,

29.s:
dāhāpyāyamayīṃ śuddhiṃ dīptasaumyavibhedataḥ /
krameṇa kuryādathavā mātṛsadbhāvamantrataḥ // 19
29.d:
दाहाप्यायमयीं शुद्धिं दीप्तसौम्यविभेदतः ।
क्रमेण कुर्यादथवा मातृसद्भावमन्त्रतः ॥ 19
29.m:
he should progressively perform the purification consisting of combustion and replenishment, differentiated into radiant and placid,
or else through the mantra of Mātṛsadbhāva.

29.s:
dīkṣāṃ cetpracikīrṣustacchodhyādhvanyāsakalpanam /
tataḥ saṃśodhyavastūni śaktyaivāmṛtatāṃ nayet // 20
29.d:
दीक्षां चेत्प्रचिकीर्षुस्तच्छोध्याध्वन्यासकल्पनम् ।
ततः संशोध्यवस्तूनि शक्त्यैवामृततां नयेत् ॥ 20
29.m:
If he wishes to perform initiation, [there is] the layout of the nyāsa of the path to be purified;
then he should bring the substances to be purified to the state of nectar through power alone.

29.s:
parāsampuṭagā yadvā mātṛsampuṭagāpyatho /
kevalā mālinī yadvā tāḥ samasteṣu karmasu // 21
29.d:
परासम्पुटगा यद्वा मातृसम्पुटगाप्यथो ।
केवला मालिनी यद्वा ताः समस्तेषु कर्मसु ॥ 21
29.m:
Either encased by Parā, or encased by Mātṛkā, or else
Mālinī alone: these [mantras are used] in all rites.

29.s:
nandahetuphalairdravyairarghapātraṃ prapūrayet /
tatroktamantratādātmyādbhairavātmatvamānayet // 22
29.d:
नन्दहेतुफलैर्द्रव्यैरर्घपात्रं प्रपूरयेत् ।
तत्रोक्तमन्त्रतादात्म्याद्भैरवात्मत्वमानयेत् ॥ 22
29.m:
One should fill the argha vessel with substances that are the causes and fruits of delight;
and through identity with the mantra taught therein, one should bring it to the nature of Bhairava.

29.s:
tena nirbharamātmānaṃ bahiścakrānucakragam /
vipruḍbhirūrdhvādharayorantaḥ pītyā ca tarpayet // 23
29.d:
तेन निर्भरमात्मानं बहिश्चक्रानुचक्रगम् ।
विप्रुड्भिरूर्ध्वाधरयोरन्तः पीत्या च तर्पयेत् ॥ 23
29.m:
With that, one should satisfy oneself completely, residing in the outer wheel and secondary wheels,
with drops above and below, and internally through drinking.

29.s:
tathā pūrṇasvaraśmyoghaḥ procchaladvṛttitāvaśāt /
bahistādṛśamātmānaṃ didṛkṣurbahirarcayet // 24
29.d:
तथा पूर्णस्वरश्म्योघः प्रोच्छलद्वृत्तितावशात् ।
बहिस्तादृशमात्मानं दिदृक्षुर्बहिरर्चयेत् ॥ 24
29.m:
Thus, the multitude of rays having become full, through the power of an surging disposition,
desirous of seeing oneself as such externally, he should worship externally.

29.s:
arkāṅgule'tha taddvitriguṇe raktapaṭe śubhe /
vyomni sindūrasubhage rājavarttabhṛte'thavā // 25
29.d:
अर्काङ्गुलेऽथ तद्द्वित्रिगुणे रक्तपटे शुभे ।
व्योम्नि सिन्दूरसुभगे राजवर्त्तभृतेऽथवा ॥ 25
29.m:
On an auspicious red cloth measuring twelve finger-breadths, or double or triple that,
or in space, adorned with vermilion, or coated with lapis lazuli,

29.s:
nārikelātmake kādye madyapūrṇe'tha bhājane /
yadvā samudite rūpe maṇḍalasthe ca tadṛśi // 26
29.d:
नारिकेलात्मके काद्ये मद्यपूर्णेऽथ भाजने ।
यद्वा समुदिते रूपे मण्डलस्थे च तदृशि ॥ 26
29.m:
or in a skull-vessel made of coconut, filled with wine,
or when [the deity's] form has arisen and is present in such a mandala,

29.s:
yāgaṃ kurvīta matimāṃstatrāyaṃ krama ucyate /
diśyudīcyāṃ rudrakoṇādvāyavyantaṃ gaṇeśvaram // 27
29.d:
यागं कुर्वीत मतिमांस्तत्रायं क्रम उच्यते ।
दिश्युदीच्यां रुद्रकोणाद्वायव्यन्तं गणेश्वरम् ॥ 27
29.m:
the wise one should perform the sacrifice. There, this procedure is stated:
in the northern direction, from the Rudra corner up to the Vāyu corner, [he should worship] the Lord of Gaṇas,

29.s:
vaṭukaṃ trīn gurūnsiddhānyoginīḥ pīṭhamarcayet /
prācyāṃ diśi gaṇeśādha ārabhyābhyarcayettataḥ // 28
29.d:
वटुकं त्रीन् गुरून्सिद्धान्योगिनीः पीठमर्चयेत् ।
प्राच्यां दिशि गणेशाध आरभ्याभ्यर्चयेत्ततः ॥ 28
29.m:
Vaṭuka, the three gurus, the Siddhas, the Yoginīs, and the sacred seat (pīṭha).
Then, in the eastern direction, starting below Gaṇeśa, he should worship

29.s:
siddhacakraṃ dikcatuṣke gaṇeśādhastanāntakam /
khagendraḥ sahavijjāmba illā+ī+ambayā saha // 29
29.d:
सिद्धचक्रं दिक्चतुष्के गणेशाधस्तनान्तकम् ।
खगेन्द्रः सहविज्जाम्ब इल्ला+ई+अम्बया सह ॥ 29
29.m:
the circle of Siddhas across the four directions, ending below Gaṇeśa:
Khagendra together with Vijjāmbā, and [Vakranātha] together with Illāī Ambā;

29.s:
vaktaṣṭirvimalo'nantamekhalāmbāyutaḥ purā /
śaktyā maṅgalayā kūrma illā+ī+ambayā saha // 30
29.d:
वक्तष्टिर्विमलोऽनन्तमेखलाम्बायुतः पुरा ।
शक्त्या मङ्गलया कूर्म इल्ला+ई+अम्बया सह ॥ 30
29.m: Vaktaṣṭi, Vimala united with Anantamekhalāmbā in the east; / with the power Maṅgalā, Kūrma together with Illāī Ambā; // 30

29.s:
jaitro yāmye hyavijitastathā sānandamekhalaḥ /
kāmamaṅgalayā meṣaḥ kullā+ī+ambayā saha // 31
29.d:
जैत्रो याम्ये ह्यविजितस्तथा सानन्दमेखलः ।
काममङ्गलया मेषः कुल्ला+ई+अम्बया सह ॥ 31
29.m: Jaitra in the south, then Avijita accompanied by Ānandamekhalā; / Meṣa with Kāmamaṅgalā together with Kullāī Ambā; // 31

29.s:
vindhyo'jito'pyajarayā saha mekhalayā pare /
macchandaḥ kuṅkuṇāmbā ca ṣaḍyugmaṃ sādhikārakam // 32
29.d:
विन्ध्योऽजितोऽप्यजरया सह मेखलया परे ।
मच्छन्दः कुङ्कुणाम्बा च षड्युग्मं साधिकारकम् ॥ 32
29.m: Vindhya along with Ajitā and Mekhalā in the west; / Macchanda and Kuṅkuṇāmbā: [this] group of six couples possesses authority. // 32

29.s:
saumye marutta īśāntaṃ dvitīyā paṅktirīdṛśī /
amaravaradevacitrālivindhyaguḍikā iti kramātṣaḍamī // 33
29.d:
सौम्ये मरुत्त ईशान्तं द्वितीया पङ्क्तिरीदृशी ।
अमरवरदेवचित्रालिविन्ध्यगुडिका इति क्रमात्षडमी ॥ 33
29.m: In the north, [extending] from the wind [northwest] to the northeastern direction, is the second row of such a kind: / Amaradeva, Varadeva, Citrālī, Vindhya, Guḍikā—these are the six in order. // 33

29.s:
sillā+ī eruṇayā tathā kumārī ca bodhā+ī /
samahālacchī cāparamekhalayā śaktayaḥ ṣaḍimāḥ // 34
29.d:
सिल्ला+ई एरुणया तथा कुमारी च बोधा+ई ।
समहालच्छी चापरमेखलया शक्तयः षडिमाः ॥ 34
29.m: Sillāī with Eruṇā, then Kumārī and Bodhāī, / Mahālacchī and [she] with another Mekhalā: these are the six powers. // 34

29.s:
ete hi sādhikārāḥ pūjyā yeṣāmiyaṃ bahuvibhedā /
santatiranavacchinnā citrā śiṣyapraśiṣyamayī // 35
29.d:
एते हि साधिकाराः पूज्या येषामियं बहुविभेदा ।
सन्ततिरनवच्छिन्ना चित्रा शिष्यप्रशिष्यमयी ॥ 35
29.m: These indeed possess authority and are to be worshipped, whose unbroken / and manifold lineage consisting of disciples and grand-disciples is of many divisions. // 35

29.s:
ānandāvalibodhiprabhupādāntātha yogiśabdāntā /
etā ovallyaḥ syurmudrāṣaṭkaṃ kramāttvetat // 36
29.d:
आनन्दावलिबोधिप्रभुपादान्ताथ योगिशब्दान्ता ।
एता ओवल्ल्यः स्युर्मुद्राषट्कं क्रमात्त्वेतत् ॥ 36
29.m: [Those lineages] ending with the words ānanda, āvali, bodhi, prabhu, pāda, and yogin— / these are the traditions (ovallī); and this is the set of six mudrās in succession: // 36

29.s:
dakṣāṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhikāntamatha sā kanīyasī vāmāt /
dvidaśāntordhvagakuṇḍalibaindavahṛnnābhikandamiti chu mmāḥ // 37
29.d:
दक्षाङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठिकान्तमथ सा कनीयसी वामात् ।
द्विदशान्तोर्ध्वगकुण्डलिबैन्दवहृन्नाभिकन्दमिति छु म्माः ॥ 37
29.m: from the right thumb to the little finger, and then the [little finger] of the left; / the upper twelve-finger space, Kuṇḍalinī, the bindu-point, heart, navel, and bulb: these are the secret signs (chummā). // 37

29.s:
śavarāḍabillapaṭṭillāḥ karabillāmbiśarabillāḥ /
aḍabīḍombīdakṣiṇabillāḥ kumbhārikākṣarākhyāca // 38
29.d:
शवराडबिल्लपट्टिल्लाः करबिल्लाम्बिशरबिल्लाः ।
अडबीडोम्बीदक्षिणबिल्लाः कुम्भारिकाक्षराख्याच ॥ 38
29.m: Śavarā, Aḍabillā, Paṭṭillā, Karabillā, Ambiśarabillā, / Aḍabī, Ḍombī, Dakṣiṇabillā, Kumbhārikā, and the one named Akṣarā; // 38

29.s:
devīkoṭṭakulādritripurīkāmākhyamaṭṭahāsaśca /
dakṣiṇapīṭhaṃ caitatṣaṭkaṃ gharapallipīṭhagaṃ kramaśaḥ // 39
29.d:
देवीकोट्टकुलाद्रित्रिपुरीकामाख्यमट्टहासश्च ।
दक्षिणपीठं चैतत्षट्कं घरपल्लिपीठगं क्रमशः ॥ 39
29.m: Devīkoṭṭa, Kulādri, Tripurī, Kāmākhyā, Aṭṭahāsa, / and the Southern Seat: this sextet belongs to the houses (ghara), hamlets (palli), and seats (pīṭha) in sequence. // 39

29.s:
iti saṅketābhijño bhramate pīṭheṣu yadi sa siddhīpsuḥ /
acirāllabhate tattatprāpyaṃ yadyoginīvadanāt // 40
29.d:
इति सङ्केताभिज्ञो भ्रमते पीठेषु यदि स सिद्धीप्सुः ।
अचिराल्लभते तत्तत्प्राप्यं यद्योगिनीवदनात् ॥ 40
29.m: If he who desires spiritual accomplishment, knowing these conventions, wanders among the seats, / he attains before long whatever is to be obtained from the mouth of the yoginī. // 40

29.s:
bhaṭṭendravalkalāhīndragajendrāḥ samahīdharāḥ /
ūrdhvaretasa ete ṣaḍadhikārapadojjhitāḥ // 41
29.d:
भट्टेन्द्रवल्कलाहीन्द्रगजेन्द्राः समहीधराः ।
ऊर्ध्वरेतस एते षडधिकारपदोज्झिताः ॥ 41
29.m: Bhaṭṭendra, Valkala, Ahīndra, Gajendra, together with Mahīdhara: / these [first] five and one [other] are celibate (ūrdhvaretas), destitute of the station of authority. // 41

29.s:
adhikāro hi vīryasya prasaraḥ kulavartmani /
tadaprasarayogena te proktā ūrdhvaretasaḥ // 42
29.d:
अधिकारो हि वीर्यस्य प्रसरः कुलवर्त्मनि ।
तदप्रसरयोगेन ते प्रोक्ता ऊर्ध्वरेतसः ॥ 42
29.m: For authority is the outflow of semen along the path of Kula; / due to their lack of that outflow, they are proclaimed to be celibate. // 42

29.s:
anyāśca gurutatpatnyaḥ śrīmatkālīkuloditāḥ /
anāttadehāḥ krīḍanti taistairdehairaśaṅkitāḥ // 43
29.d:
अन्याश्च गुरुतत्पत्न्यः श्रीमत्कालीकुलोदिताः ।
अनात्तदेहाः क्रीडन्ति तैस्तैर्देहैरशङ्किताः ॥ 43
29.m: And other gurus and their consorts declared in the auspicious Kālīkula, / having assumed no [gross] bodies, sport without hesitation through various [other] bodies. // 43

29.s:
prabodhitatathecchākaistajje kaulaṃ prakāśate /
tathārūpatayā tatra gurutvaṃ paribhāṣitam // 44
29.d:
प्रबोधिततथेच्छाकैस्तज्जे कौलं प्रकाशते ।
तथारूपतया तत्र गुरुत्वं परिभाषितम् ॥ 44
29.m: In him who is awakened by their will, the Kaula [knowledge] born of it shines forth; / because of having such a nature, the state of being a guru is designated there. // 44

29.s:
te viśeṣānna saṃpūjyāḥ smartavyā eva kevalam /
tato'bhyantarato vāyuvahnyormātṛkayā saha // 45
29.d:
ते विशेषान्न संपूज्याः स्मर्तव्या एव केवलम् ।
ततोऽभ्यन्तरतो वायुवह्न्योर्मातृकया सह ॥ 45
29.m: They are not to be specifically worshipped, but rather are merely to be remembered. / Then inside, in the wind and fire [directions], along with Mātṛkā, // 45

29.s:
mālinī kramaśaḥ pūjyā tato'ntarmantracakrakam /
mantrasiddhaprāṇasaṃvitkaraṇātmani yā kule // 46
29.d:
मालिनी क्रमशः पूज्या ततोऽन्तर्मन्त्रचक्रकम् ।
मन्त्रसिद्धप्राणसंवित्करणात्मनि या कुले ॥ 46
29.m: Mālinī is to be worshipped in sequence, and then inside, the wheel of mantras. / In the Kula consisting of the senses, consciousness, vital breath, and mantras of the Siddhas, // 46

29.s:
cakrātmake citiḥ prabhvī proktā seha kuleśvarī /
sā madhye śrīparā devī mātṛsadbhāvarūpiṇī // 47
29.d:
चक्रात्मके चितिः प्रभ्वी प्रोक्ता सेह कुलेश्वरी ।
सा मध्ये श्रीपरा देवी मातृसद्भावरूपिणी ॥ 47
29.m: the sovereign consciousness within the realm of the wheel is declared here to be Kuleśvarī. / She in the center is the venerable goddess Parā, embodying the true reality of the Mothers. // 47

29.s:
pūjyātha tatsamāropādaparātha parāparā /
ekavīrā ca sā pūjyā yadivā sakuleśvarā // 48
29.d:
पूज्याथ तत्समारोपादपराथ परापरा ।
एकवीरा च सा पूज्या यदिवा सकुलेश्वरा ॥ 48
29.m: She is to be worshipped, and by superposition onto her, Aparā and Parāparā; / she is to be worshipped either as the solitary heroine (ekavīrā) or along with Kuleśvara. // 48

29.s:
prasarecchaktirucchūnā sollāso bhairavaḥ punaḥ /
saṅghaṭṭānandaviśrāntyā yugmamitthaṃ prapūjayet // 49
29.d:
प्रसरेच्छक्तिरुच्छूना सोल्लासो भैरवः पुनः ।
सङ्घट्टानन्दविश्रान्त्या युग्ममित्थं प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 49
29.m: The power swollen with the desire for expansion, and Bhairava radiant with joy: / thus one should worship the couple through resting in the bliss of their union. // 49

29.s:
mahāprakāśarūpāyāḥ saṃvido visphuliṅgavat /
yo raśmyoghastamevātra pūjayeddevatāgaṇam // 50
29.d:
महाप्रकाशरूपायाः संविदो विस्फुलिङ्गवत् ।
यो रश्म्योघस्तमेवात्र पूजयेद्देवतागणम् ॥ 50
29.m: Resembling sparks of consciousness whose nature is great luminosity, / the flood of rays which exists—precisely that host of deities one should worship here. // 50

29.s:
antardvādaśakaṃ pūjyaṃ tato'ṣṭāṣṭākameva ca /
catuṣkaṃ vā yathecchaṃ vā kā saṅkhyā kila raśmiṣu // 51
29.d:
अन्तर्द्वादशकं पूज्यं ततोऽष्टाष्टाकमेव च ।
चतुष्कं वा यथेच्छं वा का सङ्ख्या किल रश्मिषु ॥ 51
29.m: Inside, the group of twelve is to be worshipped, and then the group of sixty-four (eight times eight), / or four, or according to wish: for what fixed number can there be among rays? // 51

29.s:
māheśī vairiñcī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī caturdikkam /
aindrī yāmyā muṇḍā yogeśīrīśatastu koṇeṣu // 52
29.d:
माहेशी वैरिञ्ची कौमारी वैष्णवी चतुर्दिक्कम् ।
ऐन्द्री याम्या मुण्डा योगेशीरीशतस्तु कोणेषु ॥ 52
29.m: Māheśī, Vairiñcī, Kaumārī, and Vaiṣṇavī in the four cardinal directions; / Aindrī, Yāmyā, Muṇḍā, and Yogeśī, starting from the northeast, in the corner directions. // 52

29.s:
pavanāntamaghorādikamaṣṭakamasminnathāṣṭake kramaśaḥ /
saṅghaṭṭānandadṛśā sampūjyaṃ yāmalībhūtam // 53
29.d:
पवनान्तमघोरादिकमष्टकमस्मिन्नथाष्टके क्रमशः ।
सङ्घट्टानन्ददृशा सम्पूज्यं यामलीभूतम् ॥ 53
29.m: In this octet, the group of eight beginning with Aghora down to Pavana in sequence / is to be worshipped as couples from the perspective of the bliss of union. // 53

29.s:
aṣṭāṣṭake'pi hi vidhau nānānāmaprapañcite bahudhā /
vidhireṣa eva vihitastatsaṃkhyā dīpamālā syāt // 54
29.d:
अष्टाष्टकेऽपि हि विधौ नानानामप्रपञ्चिते बहुधा ।
विधिरेष एव विहितस्तत्संख्या दीपमाला स्यात् ॥ 54
29.m: Even in the rite of sixty-four, elaborated in many ways with various names, / this very rule is prescribed; their number may constitute a garland of lamps. // 54

29.s:
śrīratnamālāśāstre tu varṇasaṃkhyāḥ pradīpakāḥ /
varṇāṃśca mukhyapūjyāyā vidyāyā gaṇayetsudhīḥ // 55
29.d:
श्रीरत्नमालाशास्त्रे तु वर्णसंख्याः प्रदीपकाः ।
वर्णांश्च मुख्यपूज्याया विद्याया गणयेत्सुधीः ॥ 55
29.m: In the sacred Ratnamālā treatise, however, the lights are the number of phonemes; / and the wise practitioner should count the phonemes of the principal mantra to be worshipped. // 55

29.s:
pīṭhakṣetrādibhiḥ sākaṃ kuryādvā kulapūjanam /
yathā śrīmādhavakule parameśena bhāṣitam // 56
29.d:
पीठक्षेत्रादिभिः साकं कुर्याद्वा कुलपूजनम् ।
यथा श्रीमाधवकुले परमेशेन भाषितम् ॥ 56
29.m: Or one should perform the worship of Kula together with the sacred seats, fields, and other places, / as was spoken by the Supreme Lord in the auspicious Mādhavakula: // 56

29.s:
sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhārānāmakramacatuṣṭayam /
pīṭhaśmaśānasahitaṃ pūjayedbhogamokṣayoḥ // 57
29.d:
सृष्टिसंस्थितिसंहारानामक्रमचतुष्टयम् ।
पीठश्मशानसहितं पूजयेद्भोगमोक्षयोः ॥ 57
29.m: One should worship the quartet of creation, maintenance, dissolution, and the nameless [fourth], / accompanied by the sacred seats and cremation grounds, for enjoyment and liberation. // 57

29.s:
ātmano vāthavā śakteścakrasyātha smaredimam /
nyasyatvena vidhiṃ dehe pīṭhākhye pārameśvaram // 58
29.d:
आत्मनो वाथवा शक्तेश्चक्रस्याथ स्मरेदिमम् ।
न्यस्यत्वेन विधिं देहे पीठाख्ये पारमेश्वरम् ॥ 58
29.m: One should mentally visualize this divine rule either in oneself, in the śakti, / or in the wheel, by way of installation (nyāsa) upon the body called the sacred seat: // 58

29.s:
aṭṭahāsaṃ śikhāsthāne caritraṃ ca karandhrake /
śrutyoḥ kaulagiriṃ nāsārandhrayośca jayantikām // 59
29.d:
अट्टहासं शिखास्थाने चरित्रं च करन्ध्रके ।
श्रुत्योः कौलगिरिं नासारन्ध्रयोश्च जयन्तिकाम् ॥ 59
29.m: Aṭṭahāsa at the crown-lock, and Caritra at the ear-aperture; / Kaulagiri in the ears, and Jayantikā in the nostrils; // 59

29.s:
bhruvorujjayinīṃ vaktre prayāgaṃ hṛdaye punaḥ /
vārāṇasīṃ skandhayuge śrīpīṭhaṃ virajaṃ gale // 60
29.d:
भ्रुवोरुज्जयिनीं वक्त्रे प्रयागं हृदये पुनः ।
वाराणसीं स्कन्धयुगे श्रीपीठं विरजं गले ॥ 60
29.m: Ujjayinī in the eyebrows, Prayāga in the mouth, and further / Vārāṇasī in the heart, the Śrīpīṭha on the two shoulders, and Viraja in the throat; // 60

29.s:
eḍābhīmudare hālāṃ nābhau kande tu gośrutim /
upasthe marukośaṃ ca nagaraṃ pauṇḍravardhanam // 61
29.d:
एडाभीमुदरे हालां नाभौ कन्दे तु गोश्रुतिम् ।
उपस्थे मरुकोशं च नगरं पौण्ड्रवर्धनम् ॥ 61
29.m: Eḍābhī in the belly, Hālā in the navel, and Gośruti in the bulb; / Marukośa in the generative organ, and the city Pauṇḍravardhana; // 61

29.s:
elāpuraṃ purastīraṃ sakthyūrvordakṣiṇāditaḥ /
kuḍyākeśīṃ ca sopānaṃ māyāpūkṣīrake tathā // 62
29.d:
एलापुरं पुरस्तीरं सक्थ्यूर्वोर्दक्षिणादितः ।
कुड्याकेशीं च सोपानं मायापूक्षीरके तथा ॥ 62
29.m: Elāpura and Purastīra on the right thigh and buttock, and following; / Kuḍyākeśī and Sopāna, as well as Māyāpū and Kṣīraka; // 62

29.s:
jānujaṅghe gulphayugme tvāmrātanṛpasadmanī /
pādādhāre tu vairiñcīṃ kālāgnyavadhidārikām // 63
29.d:
जानुजङ्घे गुल्फयुग्मे त्वाम्रातनृपसद्मनी ।
पादाधारे तु वैरिञ्चीं कालाग्न्यवधिदारिकाम् ॥ 63
29.m: on the knees, shanks, and pair of ankles, Āmrātaka and Nṛpasadman; / and on the soles of the feet, Vairiñcī and Kālāgnyavadhidārikā. // 63

29.s:
nāhamasmi nacānyo'sti kevalāḥ śaktayastvaham /
ityevaṃvāsanāṃ kuryātsarvadā smṛtimātrataḥ // 64
29.d:
नाहमस्मि नचान्योऽस्ति केवलाः शक्तयस्त्वहम् ।
इत्येवंवासनां कुर्यात्सर्वदा स्मृतिमात्रतः ॥ 64
29.m: ‘I am not, nor does any other exist; I am solely the powers’— / in this manner one should cultivate the contemplative attitude at all times through mere remembrance. // 64

29.s:
na tithirna ca nakṣatraṃ nopavāso vidhīyate /
grāmyadharmarataḥ siddhyetsarvadā smaraṇena hi // 65
29.d:
न तिथिर्न च नक्षत्रं नोपवासो विधीयते ।
ग्राम्यधर्मरतः सिद्ध्येत्सर्वदा स्मरणेन हि ॥ 65
29.m: Neither lunar day nor asterism nor fasting is prescribed; / devoted to worldly pleasure, he achieves spiritual accomplishment through constant remembrance. // 65

29.s:
mātaṅgakṛṣṇasaunikakārmukacārmikavikoṣidhātuvibhedāḥ /
mātsyikacākrikadayitāsteṣāṃ patnyo navātra navayāge // 66
29.d:
मातङ्गकृष्णसौनिककार्मुकचार्मिकविकोषिधातुविभेदाः ।
मात्स्यिकचाक्रिकदयितास्तेषां पत्न्यो नवात्र नवयागे ॥ 66
29.m: Mātaṅga, Kṛṣṇa, the butcher, bowmaker, leatherworker, swordsmith, metallurgist, / fisherman, and oil-presser: their wives are the nine consorts here in the sacrifice of nine. // 66

29.s:
saṅgamavaruṇākulagiryaṭṭahāsajayantīcaritrakāmrakakoṭṭam /
haimapuraṃ navamaṃ syānmadhye tāsāṃ ca cakriṇī mukhyā // 67
29.d:
सङ्गमवरुणाकुलगिर्यट्टहासजयन्तीचरित्रकाम्रककोट्टम् ।
हैमपुरं नवमं स्यान्मध्ये तासां च चक्रिणी मुख्या ॥ 67
29.m: Saṅgama, Varuṇā, Kulagiri, Aṭṭahāsa, Jayantī, Caritra, Āmraka, Koṭṭa, / and Haimapura is the ninth; and in their center, Cakriṇī is primary. // 67

29.s:
bījaṃ sā pīḍayate rasaśalkavibhāgato'tra kuṇḍalinī /
adhyuṣṭapīṭhanetrī kandasthā viśvato bhramati // 68
29.d:
बीजं सा पीडयते रसशल्कविभागतोऽत्र कुण्डलिनी ।
अध्युष्टपीठनेत्री कन्दस्था विश्वतो भ्रमति ॥ 68
29.m: She presses the seed through division of juice and husk: Kuṇḍalinī here, / the guide of the three and a half seats, residing in the bulb, moves everywhere. // 68

29.s:
iṣṭvā cakrodayaṃ tvitthaṃ madhye pūjyā kuleśvarī /
saṅkarṣiṇī tadantānte saṃhārāpyāyakāriṇī // 69
29.d:
इष्ट्वा चक्रोदयं त्वित्थं मध्ये पूज्या कुलेश्वरी ।
सङ्कर्षिणी तदन्तान्ते संहाराप्यायकारिणी ॥ 69
29.m: Having thus offered worship to the rising of the wheel, Kuleśvarī is to be worshipped in the center; / Saṅkarṣiṇī at its ultimate limit, who brings about destruction and repletion, // 69

29.s:
ekavīrā cakrayuktā cakrayāmalagāpi vā /
īśendrāgniyamakravyātkavāyūdakṣu hāsataḥ // 70
29.d:
एकवीरा चक्रयुक्ता चक्रयामलगापि वा ।
ईशेन्द्राग्नियमक्रव्यात्कवायूदक्षु हासतः ॥ 70
29.m: either as the solitary heroine, accompanied by the wheel, or situated in a dyad with the wheel. / In the northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest, and north, beginning with the north-northeast, // 70

29.s:
trikaṃ trikaṃ yajedetadbhāvisvatrikasaṃyutam /
hṛtkuṇḍalī bhruvormadhyametadeva kramāttrayam // 71
29.d:
त्रिकं त्रिकं यजेदेतद्भाविस्वत्रिकसंयुतम् ।
हृत्कुण्डली भ्रुवोर्मध्यमेतदेव क्रमात्त्रयम् ॥ 71
29.m: one should worship each triad united with its future triad. / The heart, Kuṇḍalinī, and the center between the eyebrows: this is precisely the triad in sequence. // 71

29.s:
śmaśānāni kramātkṣetrabhavaṃ sadyoginīgaṇam /
vasvaṅgulonnatānūrdhvavartulān kṣāmamadhyakān // 72
29.d:
श्मशानानि क्रमात्क्षेत्रभवं सद्योगिनीगणम् ।
वस्वङ्गुलोन्नतानूर्ध्ववर्तुलान् क्षाममध्यकान् ॥ 72
29.m: The cremation grounds, the immediate host of yoginīs born of the sacred fields in sequence: / lamps eight fingers high, elevated and round, thin in their middle, // 72

29.s:
raktavartīñśrutidṛśo dīpānkurvīta sarpiṣā /
yatkiñcidathavā madhye svānuṣṭhānaṃ prapūjayet // 73
29.d:
रक्तवर्तीञ्श्रुतिदृशो दीपान्कुर्वीत सर्पिषा ।
यत्किञ्चिदथवा मध्ये स्वानुष्ठानं प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 73
29.m: with red wicks and the appearance of the ears, one should make with clarified butter; / or one should worship whatever inner ritual performance is there in the center. // 73

29.s:
advaitameva na dvaitamityājñā parameśituḥ /
siddhāntavaiṣṇavādyuktā mantrā malayutāstataḥ // 74
29.d:
अद्वैतमेव न द्वैतमित्याज्ञा परमेशितुः ।
सिद्धान्तवैष्णवाद्युक्ता मन्त्रा मलयुतास्ततः ॥ 74
29.m: ‘Only non-duality, never duality’: this is the command of the Supreme Lord. / Therefore, the mantras taught in Siddhānta, Vaiṣṇava, and other systems are accompanied by impurity; // 74

29.s:
tāvattejo'sahiṣṇutvānnirjīvāḥ syurihādvaye /
kalaśaṃ netrabandhādi maṇḍalaṃ sruksruvānalam // 75
29.d:
तावत्तेजोऽसहिष्णुत्वान्निर्जीवाः स्युरिहाद्वये ।
कलशं नेत्रबन्धादि मण्डलं स्रुक्स्रुवानलम् ॥ 75
29.m: because they cannot endure that brilliance, they are lifeless here in non-duality. / The water vessel, blindfolding of the eyes, mandala, ladle, spoon, and fire— // 75

29.s:
hitvātra siddhiḥ sanmadye pātre madhye kṛśāṃ yajet /
ahorātramimaṃ yāgaṃ kurvataścāpare'hani // 76
29.d:
हित्वात्र सिद्धिः सन्मद्ये पात्रे मध्ये कृशां यजेत् ।
अहोरात्रमिमं यागं कुर्वतश्चापरेऽहनि ॥ 76
29.m:
[…] Leaving aside this accomplishment here, in the vessel containing good wine, he should worship Kṛśā in the center.
And for one performing this sacrifice for a day and night, on the following day,

29.s:
vīrabhojye kṛte'vaśyaṃ mantrāḥ siddhyantyayatnataḥ /
pīṭhastotraṃ paṭhedatra yāge bhāgyāvahāhvaye // 77
29.d:
वीरभोज्ये कृतेऽवश्यं मन्त्राः सिद्ध्यन्त्ययत्नतः ।
पीठस्तोत्रं पठेदत्र यागे भाग्यावहाह्वये ॥ 77
29.m:
when the banquet of the heroes (vīrabhojya) has been performed, mantras inevitably attain success without effort.
In this sacrifice called Bhāgyāvaha ("conferring good fortune"), one should recite the hymn to the seats (pīṭhastotra).

29.s:
mūrtīrevāthavā yugmarūpā vīrasvarūpiṇīḥ /
avadhūtā nirācārāḥ pūjayetkramaśo budhaḥ // 78
29.d:
मूर्तीरेवाथवा युग्मरूपा वीरस्वरूपिणीः ।
अवधूता निराचाराः पूजयेत्क्रमशो बुधः ॥ 78
29.m: Or else the wise one should worship in succession the forms, / as couples, having the nature of heroes, wandering unattached, free of conventional conduct.

29.s:
eka evātha kauleśaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvāpi tāvatīḥ /
śaktīryāmalayogena tarpayedviśvarūpavat // 79
29.d:
एक एवाथ कौलेशः स्वयं भूत्वापि तावतीः ।
शक्तीर्यामलयोगेन तर्पयेद्विश्वरूपवत् ॥ 79
29.m: Or the lord of the Kaula alone, having himself become [one], / should satisfy as many powers through the yoga of the dyad, like the universal form.

29.s:
kramo nāma na kaścitsyātprakāśamayasaṃvidi /
cidabhāvo hi nāstyeva tenākālaṃ tu tarpaṇam // 80
29.d:
क्रमो नाम न कश्चित्स्यात्प्रकाशमयसंविदि ।
चिदभावो हि नास्त्येव तेनाकालं तु तर्पणम् ॥ 80
29.m: There can be no succession whatsoever in consciousness consisting of luminosity; / for an absence of consciousness does not exist at all, and therefore the satisfying is timeless.

29.s:
atra krame bhedataroḥ samūlamunmūlanādāsanapakṣacarcā /
pṛthaṅna yuktā parameśvaro hi svaśaktidhāmnīva viśaṃśramīti // 81
29.d:
अत्र क्रमे भेदतरोः समूलमुन्मूलनादासनपक्षचर्चा ।
पृथङ्न युक्ता परमेश्वरो हि स्वशक्तिधाम्नीव विशंश्रमीति ॥ 81
29.m: In this sequence, since the tree of duality is uprooted together with its roots, discussion of the matter of the seat / separately is not appropriate; for the Supreme Lord rests as if in the abode of his own power.

29.s:
tato japaḥ prakartavyastrilakṣādivibhedataḥ /
uktaṃ śrīyogasañcāre sa ca citrasvarūpakaḥ // 82
29.d:
ततो जपः प्रकर्तव्यस्त्रिलक्षादिविभेदतः ।
उक्तं श्रीयोगसञ्चारे स च चित्रस्वरूपकः ॥ 82
29.m: Then recitation should be performed, differentiated into three hundred thousand and the like; / and that of varied nature has been taught in the venerable Yogasañcāra:

29.s:
udaye saṅgame śāntau trilakṣo japa ucyate /
āsye gamāgame sūtre haṃsākhye śaivayugmake // 83
29.d:
उदये सङ्गमे शान्तौ त्रिलक्षो जप उच्यते ।
आस्ये गमागमे सूत्रे हंसाख्ये शैवयुग्मके ॥ 83
29.m: "At rising, at union, [and] at rest, a recitation of three hundred thousand is declared; / in the mouth, in movement and return, in the thread named Haṃsa, and in the Śaiva couple—

29.s:
pañcalakṣā ime proktā daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret /
netre gamāgame vaktre haṃse caivākṣasūtrake // 84
29.d:
पञ्चलक्षा इमे प्रोक्ता दशांशं होममाचरेत् ।
नेत्रे गमागमे वक्त्रे हंसे चैवाक्षसूत्रके ॥ 84
29.m: these are declared to be five hundred thousand; one should perform oblation of a tenth part [thereof]. / In the eye, in movement and return, in the mouth, in Haṃsa, and in the rosary—

29.s:
śivaśaktisamāyoge ṣaḍlakṣo japa ucyate /
netre gamāgame karṇe haṃse vaktre ca bhāmini // 85
29.d:
शिवशक्तिसमायोगे षड्लक्षो जप उच्यते ।
नेत्रे गमागमे कर्णे हंसे वक्त्रे च भामिनि ॥ 85
29.m: in the union of Śiva and power, a recitation of six hundred thousand is declared. / In the eye, in movement and return, in the ear, in Haṃsa, and in the mouth, O beautiful lady,

29.s:
haste ca yugmake caiva japaḥ saptavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ /
netre gamāgame karṇāvāsyaṃ guhyaṃ ca guhyakam // 86
29.d:
हस्ते च युग्मके चैव जपः सप्तविधः स्मृतः ।
नेत्रे गमागमे कर्णावास्यं गुह्यं च गुह्यकम् ॥ 86
29.m: and in the hand, and in the pair, recitation is traditionally taught as sevenfold. / In the eye, in movement and return, in the ears, in the mouth, and in the secret and secret-most,

29.s:
śatāreṣu ca madhyasthaṃ sahasrāreṣu bhāmini /
japa eṣa rudralakṣo homo'pyatra daśāṃśataḥ // 87
29.d:
शतारेषु च मध्यस्थं सहस्रारेषु भामिनि ।
जप एष रुद्रलक्षो होमोऽप्यत्र दशांशतः ॥ 87
29.m: and in that which stands in the center of the hundred-spoked [centers], [and] in the thousand-spoked, O beautiful lady— / this is the recitation of eleven hundred thousand; the oblation here also is a tenth part.

29.s:
netre gamāgame karṇau mukhaṃ brahmabilāntaram /
stanau hastau ca pādau ca guhyacakre dvirabhyaset // 88
29.d:
नेत्रे गमागमे कर्णौ मुखं ब्रह्मबिलान्तरम् ।
स्तनौ हस्तौ च पादौ च गुह्यचक्रे द्विरभ्यसेत् ॥ 88
29.m: In the eye, in movement and return, in the ears, in the mouth, within the aperture of Brahmā, / in the breasts, the hands, and the feet, one should practice twice in the secret wheel.

29.s:
yatra yatra gataṃ cakṣuryatra yatra gataṃ manaḥ /
haṃsastatra dvirabhyasyo vikāsākuñcanātmakaḥ // 89
29.d:
यत्र यत्र गतं चक्षुर्यत्र यत्र गतं मनः ।
हंसस्तत्र द्विरभ्यस्यो विकासाकुञ्चनात्मकः ॥ 89
29.m: Wherever the eye goes, wherever the mind goes, / there Haṃsa, consisting of expansion and contraction, is to be practiced twice.

29.s:
sa ātmā mātṛkā devī śivo dehavyavasthitaḥ /
anyaḥ so'nyo'hamityevaṃ vikalpaṃ nācaredyataḥ // 90
29.d:
स आत्मा मातृका देवी शिवो देहव्यवस्थितः ।
अन्यः सोऽन्योऽहमित्येवं विकल्पं नाचरेद्यतः ॥ 90
29.m: He is the Self, the goddess Mātṛkā, Śiva situated in the body; / since one should not entertain the conceptual construct: 'He is another, I am another.'

29.s:
yo vilpayate tasya siddhimuktī sudūrataḥ /
atha ṣoḍaśalakṣādiprāṇacāre puroktavat // 91
29.d:
यो विल्पयते तस्य सिद्धिमुक्ती सुदूरतः ।
अथ षोडशलक्षादिप्राणचारे पुरोक्तवत् ॥ 91
29.m: For whoever entertains conceptual constructs, spiritual accomplishment and liberation are very far away." / Now, in the movement of breath of sixteen hundred thousand and so on, as previously stated,

29.s:
śuddhāśuddhavikalpānāṃ tyāga ekānta ucyate /
tatrasthaḥ svayamevaiṣa juhoti ca japatyapi // 92
29.d:
शुद्धाशुद्धविकल्पानां त्याग एकान्त उच्यते ।
तत्रस्थः स्वयमेवैष जुहोति च जपत्यपि ॥ 92
29.m: the abandonment of pure and impure conceptual constructs is declared to be solitary. / Standing therein, he himself both offers oblation and recites.

29.s:
japaḥ sañjalpavṛttiśca nādāmarśasvarūpiṇī /
tadāmṛṣṭasya cidvahnau layo homaḥ prakīrtitaḥ // 93
29.d:
जपः सञ्जल्पवृत्तिश्च नादामर्शस्वरूपिणी ।
तदामृष्टस्य चिद्वह्नौ लयो होमः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 93
29.m: Recitation is the activity of internal discourse consisting of the reflective apprehension of resonance; / the dissolution into the fire of consciousness of what has been so reflectively apprehended is proclaimed to be oblation.

29.s:
āmarśaśca purā prokto devīdvādaśakātmakaḥ /
dve antye saṃvidau tatra layarūpāhutikriyā // 94
29.d:
आमर्शश्च पुरा प्रोक्तो देवीद्वादशकात्मकः ।
द्वे अन्त्ये संविदौ तत्र लयरूपाहुतिक्रिया ॥ 94
29.m: And reflective awareness was taught previously as consisting of the twelve goddesses; / among them, the final two consciousnesses are the rite of offering in the form of dissolution.

29.s:
daśānyāstadupāyāyetyevaṃ home daśāṃśatām /
śrīśambhunātha ādikṣattrikārthāmbhodhicandramāḥ // 95
29.d:
दशान्यास्तदुपायायेत्येवं होमे दशांशताम् ।
श्रीशम्भुनाथ आदिक्षत्त्रिकार्थाम्भोधिचन्द्रमाः ॥ 95
29.m: The other ten are the means thereto; thus the ten-part nature in oblation / was instructed by the venerable Śambhunātha, the moon of the ocean of Trika teachings.

29.s:
sākaṃ bāhyasthayā śaktyā yadā tveṣa samarcayet /
tadāyaṃ parameśokto rahasyo bhaṇyate vidhiḥ // 96
29.d:
साकं बाह्यस्थया शक्त्या यदा त्वेष समर्चयेत् ।
तदायं परमेशोक्तो रहस्यो भण्यते विधिः ॥ 96
29.m: When, however, he worships together with an external power, / then this secret ritual taught by the Supreme Lord is set forth.

29.s:
uktaṃ śrīyogasañcāre brahmacarye sthitiṃ bhajet /
ānando brahma paramaṃ tacca dehe tridhā sthitam // 97
29.d:
उक्तं श्रीयोगसञ्चारे ब्रह्मचर्ये स्थितिं भजेत् ।
आनन्दो ब्रह्म परमं तच्च देहे त्रिधा स्थितम् ॥ 97
29.m: It is stated in the venerable Yogasañcāra: "One should abide in the celibate observance; / bliss is the supreme Brahman, and that stands threefold in the body.

29.s:
upakāri dvayaṃ tatra phalamanyattadātmakam /
oṣṭhyāntyatritayāsevī brahmacārī sa ucyate // 98
29.d:
उपकारि द्वयं तत्र फलमन्यत्तदात्मकम् ।
ओष्ठ्यान्त्यत्रितयासेवी ब्रह्मचारी स उच्यते ॥ 98
29.m: Among them, two are instrumental, the other is the fruit of that nature; / one who serves the final triad of labials is called a celibate practitioner.

29.s:
tadvarjitā ye paśava ānandaparivarjitāḥ /
ānandakṛttrimāhārāstadvarjaṃ cakrayājakāḥ // 99
29.d:
तद्वर्जिता ये पशव आनन्दपरिवर्जिताः ।
आनन्दकृत्त्रिमाहारास्तद्वर्जं चक्रयाजकाः ॥ 99
29.m: Those bound souls who are devoid of it are devoid of bliss; / they consume artificial food of bliss, and worship the wheel devoid of it;

29.s:
dvaye'pi niraye yānti raurave bhīṣaṇe tviti /
śakterlakṣaṇametāvattadvato hyavibheditā // 100
29.d:
द्वयेऽपि निरये यान्ति रौरवे भीषणे त्विति ।
शक्तेर्लक्षणमेतावत्तद्वतो ह्यविभेदिता ॥ 100
29.m: both go to the terrible hell of Raurava." / The definition of the power is just this: non-differentiation from the possessor of power.

29.s:
tādṛśīṃ tena tāṃ kuryānnatu varṇādyapekṣaṇam /
laukikālaukikadvyātmasaṅgāttādātmyato'dhikāt // 101
29.d:
तादृशीं तेन तां कुर्यान्नतु वर्णाद्यपेक्षणम् ।
लौकिकालौकिकद्व्यात्मसङ्गात्तादात्म्यतोऽधिकात् ॥ 101
29.m: Therefore he should make her of such a kind, and not look to caste and the like; / from the union of both ordinary and extraordinary natures, from an even greater non-duality,

29.s:
kāryahetusahotthā sā tridhoktā śāsane guroḥ /
sākṣātparamparāyogāttattulyeti tridhā punaḥ // 102
29.d:
कार्यहेतुसहोत्था सा त्रिधोक्ता शासने गुरोः ।
साक्षात्परम्परायोगात्तत्तुल्येति त्रिधा पुनः ॥ 102
29.m: she is taught as threefold in the master's teaching: born of effect, born of cause, and co-born; / and again threefold: by direct connection, by indirect connection, and as equal to that.

29.s:
śrīsarvācārahṛdaye tadetadupasaṃhṛtam /
ṣaḍetāḥ śaktayaḥ proktā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ // 103
29.d:
श्रीसर्वाचारहृदये तदेतदुपसंहृतम् ।
षडेताः शक्तयः प्रोक्ता भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाः ॥ 103
29.m: In the venerable Sarvācārahṛdaya this very teaching is summarized: / these six powers are declared to bestow the fruit of enjoyment and liberation.

29.s:
dvābhyāṃ tu sṛṣṭisaṃhārau tasmānmelakamuttamam /
tāmāhṛtya mitho'bhyarcya tarpayitvā parasparam // 104
29.d:
द्वाभ्यां तु सृष्टिसंहारौ तस्मान्मेलकमुत्तमम् ।
तामाहृत्य मिथोऽभ्यर्च्य तर्पयित्वा परस्परम् ॥ 104
29.m: By the two, however, are emission and dissolution; therefore the meeting of the two is supreme. / Having brought her, having worshipped each other, and having satisfied one another,

29.s:
antaraṅgakrameṇaiva mukhyacakrasya pūjanam /
yadevānandasandohi saṃvido hyantaraṅgakam // 105
29.d:
अन्तरङ्गक्रमेणैव मुख्यचक्रस्य पूजनम् ।
यदेवानन्दसन्दोहि संविदो ह्यन्तरङ्गकम् ॥ 105
29.m: the worship of the principal wheel proceeds purely by the inner sequence; / whatever is an abundance of bliss is indeed internal to consciousness.

29.s:
tatpradhānaṃ bhaveccakramanucakramato'param /
vikāsāttṛptitaḥ pāśotkartanātkṛtiśaktitaḥ // 106
29.d:
तत्प्रधानं भवेच्चक्रमनुचक्रमतोऽपरम् ।
विकासात्तृप्तितः पाशोत्कर्तनात्कृतिशक्तितः ॥ 106
29.m: That becomes the primary wheel, and the subordinate wheel is other than that; / through expansion, satisfaction, cutting of the fetter, and power of action,

29.s:
cakraṃ kaseścakeḥ kṛtyā karoteśca kiloditam /
yāgaśca tarpaṇaṃ bāhye vikāsastacca kīrtyate // 107
29.d:
चक्रं कसेश्चकेः कृत्या करोतेश्च किलोदितम् ।
यागश्च तर्पणं बाह्ये विकासस्तच्च कीर्त्यते ॥ 107
29.m: the wheel (cakra) is indeed proclaimed from the roots 'to expand' (kas), 'to satisfy' (cak), 'to act' (kṛ), and 'to cut' (kṛt). / Ritual worship and satisfaction are in the external realm, and that is proclaimed as expansion.

29.s:
cakrānucakrāntaragācchaktimatparikalpitāt /
prāṇagādapyathānandasyandino'bhyavahārataḥ // 108
29.d:
चक्रानुचक्रान्तरगाच्छक्तिमत्परिकल्पितात् ।
प्राणगादप्यथानन्दस्यन्दिनोऽभ्यवहारतः ॥ 108
29.m: From what is located within the wheel and subordinate wheels, imagined by the possessor of power, / and also from what is located in the breath, from the food that flows with bliss,

29.s:
gandhadhūpasragādeśca bāhyāducchalanaṃ citaḥ /
itthaṃ svocitavastvaṃśairanucakreṣu tarpaṇam // 109
29.d:
गन्धधूपस्रगादेश्च बाह्यादुच्छलनं चितः ।
इत्थं स्वोचितवस्त्वंशैरनुचक्रेषु तर्पणम् ॥ 109
29.m: and from perfume, incense, garlands, and the like, external overflow of consciousness [arises]. / In this way, with portions of their suitable substances, satisfaction in the subordinate wheels

29.s:
kurvīyātāmihānyonyaṃ mukhyacakraikatākṛte /
uktaṃ ca triśirastantre vimalāsanagocaraḥ // 110
29.d:
कुर्वीयातामिहान्योन्यं मुख्यचक्रैकताकृते ।
उक्तं च त्रिशिरस्तन्त्रे विमलासनगोचरः ॥ 110
29.m: the two should perform for each other here, for the sake of the unity of the primary wheel. / And it is stated in the Triśirastantra: "Having the spotless seat as its sphere,

29.s:
akṣaṣaṭkasya madhye tu rudrasthānaṃ samāviśet /
nijanijabhogābhogapravikāsinijasvarūpaparimarśe // 111
29.d:
अक्षषट्कस्य मध्ये तु रुद्रस्थानं समाविशेत् ।
निजनिजभोगाभोगप्रविकासिनिजस्वरूपपरिमर्शे ॥ 111
29.m: in the center of the six senses one should enter the station of Rudra." / In the reflective awareness of their own nature expanding in the fullness of their respective enjoyments,

29.s:
kramaśo'nucakradevyaḥ saṃviccakraṃ hi madhyamaṃ yānti /
svasthatanoraparasya tu tā dehādhiṣṭhitaṃ vihāya yataḥ // 112
29.d:
क्रमशोऽनुचक्रदेव्यः संविच्चक्रं हि मध्यमं यान्ति ।
स्वस्थतनोरपरस्य तु ता देहाधिष्ठितं विहाय यतः ॥ 112
29.m: the goddesses of the subordinate wheels indeed go gradually to the central wheel of consciousness; / for, leaving what resides in the body of another whose body is healthy,

29.s:
āsata iti tadahaṃyurno pūrṇo nāpi cocchalati /
anucakradevatātmakamarīciparipūraṇādhigatavīryam // 113
29.d:
आसत इति तदहंयुर्नो पूर्णो नापि चोच्छलति ।
अनुचक्रदेवतात्मकमरीचिपरिपूरणाधिगतवीर्यम् ॥ 113
29.m: they abide [within]. Therefore, his ego-sense is neither complete nor does it surge forth. / Having attained potency through the replenishment of rays consisting of the deities of the subordinate wheels,

29.s:
tacchaktiśaktimadyugamanyonyasamunmukhaṃ bhavati /
tadyugalamūrdhvadhāmapraveśasaṃsparśajātasaṅkṣobham // 114
29.d:
तच्छक्तिशक्तिमद्युगमन्योन्यसमुन्मुखं भवति ।
तद्युगलमूर्ध्वधामप्रवेशसंस्पर्शजातसङ्क्षोभम् ॥ 114
29.m: that pair of power and possessor of power becomes oriented towards each other. / That pair, agitated by the agitation born of touching the entrance to the upper abode,

29.s:
kṣubhnātyanucakrāṇyapi tāni tadā tanmayāni na pṛthaktu /
itthaṃ yāmalametadgalitabhidāsaṃkathaṃ yadeva syāt // 115
29.d:
क्षुभ्नात्यनुचक्राण्यपि तानि तदा तन्मयानि न पृथक्तु ।
इत्थं यामलमेतद्गलितभिदासंकथं यदेव स्यात् ॥ 115
29.m: agitates also the subordinate wheels; then they consist of that, and are not separate. / Thus this dyad, in whatever way its talk of difference is dissolved,

29.s:
kramatāratamyayogātsaiva hi saṃvidvisargasaṅghaṭṭaḥ /
taddhruvadhāmānuttaramubhayātmakajagadudārasānandam // 116
29.d:
क्रमतारतम्ययोगात्सैव हि संविद्विसर्गसङ्घट्टः ।
तद्ध्रुवधामानुत्तरमुभयात्मकजगदुदारसानन्दम् ॥ 116
29.m: by virtue of the graduation of sequence, that very consciousness is the friction of creative emission; / that is the stable abode, the unexcelled, filled with the noble bliss of the world possessing both natures,

29.s:
no śāntaṃ nāpyuditaṃ śāntoditasūtikāraṇaṃ paraṃ kaulam /
anavacchinnapadepsustāṃ saṃvidamātmasātsadā kuryāt // 117
29.d:
नो शान्तं नाप्युदितं शान्तोदितसूतिकारणं परं कौलम् ।
अनवच्छिन्नपदेप्सुस्तां संविदमात्मसात्सदा कुर्यात् ॥ 117
29.m: neither quiescent nor emergent, the source and cause of the quiescent and the emergent, the supreme Kaula. / Desiring the unconditioned state, one should always assimilate that consciousness to oneself.

29.s:
anavacchinnaṃ paramārthato hi rūpaṃ cito devyāḥ /
īdṛktādṛkprāyapraśamodayabhāvavilayaparikathayā // 118
29.d:
अनवच्छिन्नं परमार्थतो हि रूपं चितो देव्याः ।
ईदृक्तादृक्प्रायप्रशमोदयभावविलयपरिकथया ॥ 118
29.m: For in the highest sense the nature of the goddess of consciousness is unconditioned. / Through discourse on the dissolution of entities into cessation and emergence of such-and-such kind,

29.s:
anavacchinnaṃ dhāma praviśedvaisargikaṃ subhagaḥ /
śāntoditātmakaṃ dvayamatha yugapadudeti śaktiśaktimatoḥ // 119
29.d:
अनवच्छिन्नं धाम प्रविशेद्वैसर्गिकं सुभगः ।
शान्तोदितात्मकं द्वयमथ युगपदुदेति शक्तिशक्तिमतोः ॥ 119
29.m: the fortunate one should enter the unconditioned, emissive abode. / Then the pair consisting of quiescent and emergent arises simultaneously in power and the possessor of power;

29.s:
rūpamuditaṃ parasparadhāmagataṃ śāntamātmagatameva /
ubhayamapi vastutaḥ kila yāmalamiti tathoditaṃ śāntam // 120
29.d:
रूपमुदितं परस्परधामगतं शान्तमात्मगतमेव ।
उभयमपि वस्तुतः किल यामलमिति तथोदितं शान्तम् ॥ 120
29.m: the emergent form goes to the abode of the other, the quiescent remains only in oneself. / Both indeed are fundamentally a dyad; thus it is spoken of as quiescent and emergent.

29.s:
śaktistadvaducitāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān /
śāntoditātmakobhayarūpaparāmarśasāmyayoge'pi // 121
29.d:
शक्तिस्तद्वदुचितां सृष्टिं पुष्णाति नो तद्वान् ।
शान्तोदितात्मकोभयरूपपरामर्शसाम्ययोगेऽपि ॥ 121
29.m: The power nourishes the appropriate creation in that manner, but the possessor of power does not; / even in the union of equal reflective awareness of the dual nature consisting of the quiescent and the emergent,

29.s:
pravikasvaramadhyapadā śaktiḥ śāstre tataḥ kathitā /
tasyāmeva kulārthaṃ samyak saṃcārayedgurustena // 122
29.d:
प्रविकस्वरमध्यपदा शक्तिः शास्त्रे ततः कथिता ।
तस्यामेव कुलार्थं सम्यक् संचारयेद्गुरुस्तेन ॥ 122
29.m: therefore in scripture power is declared to have an expanding central state; / for that reason, the guru should fully transmit the secret Kula teaching into her alone.

29.s:
taddvāreṇa ca kathitakrameṇa saṃcārayeta nṛṣu /
svaśarīrādhikasadbhāvabhāvitāmiti tataḥ prāha // 123
29.d:
तद्द्वारेण च कथितक्रमेण संचारयेत नृषु ।
स्वशरीराधिकसद्भावभावितामिति ततः प्राह ॥ 123
29.m: And by that door, in the manner described, he should transmit [it] into men. / Therefore he says: '[He should transmit it] as brought into being by the true reality exceeding one's own body.' // 123

29.s:
śrīmatkallaṭanāthaḥ proktasamastārthalabdhaye vākyam /
tanmukhyacakramuktaṃ maheśinā yoginīvaktram // 124
29.d:
श्रीमत्कल्लटनाथः प्रोक्तसमस्तार्थलब्धये वाक्यम् ।
तन्मुख्यचक्रमुक्तं महेशिना योगिनीवक्त्रम् ॥ 124
29.m: The venerable Kallaṭanātha uttered this statement for obtaining the entire meaning: / 'That primary wheel has been proclaimed by the Great Lord as the Yoginī-mouth.' // 124

29.s:
tatraiṣa sampradāyastasmātsaṃprāpyate jñānam /
tadidamalekhyaṃ bhaṇitaṃ vaktrādvaktrasthamuktayuktyā ca // 125
29.d:
तत्रैष सम्प्रदायस्तस्मात्संप्राप्यते ज्ञानम् ।
तदिदमलेख्यं भणितं वक्त्राद्वक्त्रस्थमुक्तयुक्त्या च ॥ 125
29.m: There is this lineage transmission; from that, knowledge is obtained. / That very thing has been declared to be non-writable, residing from mouth to mouth, by the logic stated. // 125

29.s:
vaktraṃ pradhānacakraṃ svā saṃvillikhyatāṃ ca katham /
atha sṛṣṭe dvitaye'smin śāntoditadhāmni ye'nusaṃdadhate // 126
29.d:
वक्त्रं प्रधानचक्रं स्वा संविल्लिख्यतां च कथम् ।
अथ सृष्टे द्वितयेऽस्मिन् शान्तोदितधाम्नि येऽनुसंदधते ॥ 126
29.m: The mouth is the primary wheel, and how could one's own consciousness be written down? / Now, in this twofold creation, in the abode of the quiescent and the emergent, those who concentrate // 126

29.s:
prācyāṃ visargasattāmanavacchidi te pade rūḍhāḥ /
ye siddhimāptukāmāste'bhyuditaṃ rūpamāhareyuratho // 127
29.d:
प्राच्यां विसर्गसत्तामनवच्छिदि ते पदे रूढाः ।
ये सिद्धिमाप्तुकामास्तेऽभ्युदितं रूपमाहरेयुरथो ॥ 127
29.m: upon the primordial presence of creative emission, are rooted in the undivided state. / Those who wish to attain spiritual accomplishment may gather the emergent form, and then // 127

29.s:
tenaiva pūjayeyuḥ saṃvinnaikaṭyaśuddhatamavapuṣā /
tadapica mitho hi vaktrātpradhānato vaktragaṃ yato bhaṇitam // 128
29.d:
तेनैव पूजयेयुः संविन्नैकट्यशुद्धतमवपुषा ।
तदपिच मिथो हि वक्त्रात्प्रधानतो वक्त्रगं यतो भणितम् ॥ 128
29.m: they should worship by means of that very body, supremely purified by proximity to consciousness. / Moreover, that which passes mutually from the primary mouth into the mouth is described, // 128

29.s:
ajarāmarapadadānapravaṇaṃ kulasaṃjñitaṃ paramam /
ye'pyaprāptavibodhāste'bhyuditotphullayāgasaṃrūḍhāḥ // 129
29.d:
अजरामरपददानप्रवणं कुलसंज्ञितं परमम् ।
येऽप्यप्राप्तविबोधास्तेऽभ्युदितोत्फुल्लयागसंरूढाः ॥ 129
29.m: since it is inclined toward granting the unaging and immortal state, designated as Kula, the supreme. / Even those who have not attained awakening, being firmly established in the emergent, blossoming ritual, // 129

29.s:
tatparikalpitacakrasthadevatāḥ prāpnuvanti vijñānam /
te tatra śakticakre tenaivānandarasamayena bahiḥ // 130
29.d:
तत्परिकल्पितचक्रस्थदेवताः प्राप्नुवन्ति विज्ञानम् ।
ते तत्र शक्तिचक्रे तेनैवानन्दरसमयेन बहिः ॥ 130
29.m: reach realization, becoming the deities abiding in that imagined wheel. / There, in that wheel of powers, through that very [wheel] composed of the nectar of bliss, externally // 130

29.s:
dikṣu catasṛṣu proktakrameṇa gaṇanāthataḥ prabhṛti sarvam /
saṃpūjya madhyamapade kuleśayugmaṃ tvarātraye devīḥ // 131
29.d:
दिक्षु चतसृषु प्रोक्तक्रमेण गणनाथतः प्रभृति सर्वम् ।
संपूज्य मध्यमपदे कुलेशयुग्मं त्वरात्रये देवीः ॥ 131
29.m: in the four directions according to the described order, having worshiped everything beginning with the Lord of Hosts, / the sage should worship in the middle state the pair of Kula-lords, the goddesses in the triad of Tvarā, // 131

29.s:
bāhye pratyaramatha kila catuṣkamiti raśmicakramarkāram /
aṣṭakamaṣṭāṣṭakamatha vividhaṃ saṃpūjayetkrameṇa muniḥ // 132
29.d:
बाह्ये प्रत्यरमथ किल चतुष्कमिति रश्मिचक्रमर्कारम् ।
अष्टकमष्टाष्टकमथ विविधं संपूजयेत्क्रमेण मुनिः ॥ 132
29.m: and outside, on each spoke, a quartet: the twelve-spoked wheel of rays, / the octad, and the sixty-four-fold wheel in various ways, in succession. // 132

29.s:
nijadehagate dhāmani tathaiva pūjyaṃ samabhyasyet /
yattacchāntaṃ rūpaṃ tenābhyastena hṛdayasaṃvittyā // 133
29.d:
निजदेहगते धामनि तथैव पूज्यं समभ्यस्येत् ।
यत्तच्छान्तं रूपं तेनाभ्यस्तेन हृदयसंवित्त्या ॥ 133
29.m: Just so, one should repeatedly practice what is to be worshiped in the abode located within one's own body. / That which is the quiescent form, when practiced through the consciousness of the heart, // 133

29.s:
śāntaṃ śivapadameti hi galitataraṅgārṇavaprakhyam /
tacchāntapadādhyāsāccakrastho devatāgaṇaḥ sarvaḥ // 134
29.d:
शान्तं शिवपदमेति हि गलिततरङ्गार्णवप्रख्यम् ।
तच्छान्तपदाध्यासाच्चक्रस्थो देवतागणः सर्वः ॥ 134
29.m: leads indeed to the quiescent state of Śiva, resembling an ocean whose waves have subsided. / Due to overlay upon that quiescent state, the entire multitude of deities abiding in the wheel // 134

29.s:
tiṣṭhatyuparatavṛttiḥ śūnyālambī nirānandaḥ /
yo'pyanucakradṛgādisvarūpabhāk so'pi yattadāyattaḥ // 135
29.d:
तिष्ठत्युपरतवृत्तिः शून्यालम्बी निरानन्दः ।
योऽप्यनुचक्रदृगादिस्वरूपभाक् सोऽपि यत्तदायत्तः ॥ 135
29.m: remains with ceased activity, relying on the void, devoid of bliss. / Even that which partakes of the nature of the secondary wheels such as sight, since it depends on that, // 135

29.s:
tenānande magnastiṣṭhatyānandasākāṅkṣaḥ /
paratatsvarūpasaṅghaṭṭamantareṇaiṣa karaṇaraśmigaṇaḥ // 136
29.d:
तेनानन्दे मग्नस्तिष्ठत्यानन्दसाकाङ्क्षः ।
परतत्स्वरूपसङ्घट्टमन्तरेणैष करणरश्मिगणः ॥ 136
29.m: remains immersed in that [quiescence], longing for bliss. / Without collision with that supreme nature, this multitude of rays of the senses // 136

29.s:
āste hi niḥsvarūpaḥ svarūpalābhāya conmukhitaḥ /
raṇaraṇakarasānnijarasabharitabahirbhāvacarvaṇavaśena // 137
29.d:
आस्ते हि निःस्वरूपः स्वरूपलाभाय चोन्मुखितः ।
रणरणकरसान्निजरसभरितबहिर्भावचर्वणवशेन ॥ 137
29.m: remains indeed devoid of its own nature, yet directed upward to attain its nature, / out of the flavor of longing, through relishing external entities filled with its own flavor. // 137

29.s:
viśrāntidhāma kiñcillabdhvā svātmanyathārpayate /
tannijaviṣayārpaṇataḥ pūrṇasamucchalitasaṃvidāsāraḥ // 138
29.d:
विश्रान्तिधाम किञ्चिल्लब्ध्वा स्वात्मन्यथार्पयते ।
तन्निजविषयार्पणतः पूर्णसमुच्छलितसंविदासारः ॥ 138
29.m: Having obtained a slight place of rest, it then offers [them] into its own self; / from that offering of its own objects, a torrential downpour of full, surging consciousness [arises]. // 138

29.s:
anucakradevatāgaṇaparipūraṇajātavīryavikṣobhaḥ /
cakreśvaro'pi pūrvoktayuktitaḥ procchaledrabhasāt // 139
29.d:
अनुचक्रदेवतागणपरिपूरणजातवीर्यविक्षोभः ।
चक्रेश्वरोऽपि पूर्वोक्तयुक्तितः प्रोच्छलेद्रभसात् ॥ 139
29.m: With an agitation of potency born of fully filling the multitude of deities of the secondary wheels, / even the lord of the wheel surges forth impetuously, in the manner previously explained. // 139

29.s:
trividho visarga itthaṃ saṅghaṭṭaḥ proditastathā śāntaḥ /
visṛjati yato vicitraḥ sargo vigataśca yatra sarga iti // 140
29.d:
त्रिविधो विसर्ग इत्थं सङ्घट्टः प्रोदितस्तथा शान्तः ।
विसृजति यतो विचित्रः सर्गो विगतश्च यत्र सर्ग इति ॥ 140
29.m: Thus creative emission is threefold: collision, emergent, and quiescent; / for it emits, diverse creation [arises], and into it creation dissolves. // 140

29.s:
śrītattvarakṣaṇe śrīnigame triśiromate ca tatproktam /
kuṇḍaṃ śaktiḥ śivo liṅgaṃ melakaṃ paramaṃ padam // 141
29.d:
श्रीतत्त्वरक्षणे श्रीनिगमे त्रिशिरोमते च तत्प्रोक्तम् ।
कुण्डं शक्तिः शिवो लिङ्गं मेलकं परमं पदम् ॥ 141
29.m: In the venerable Tattvarakṣaṇa, the venerable Nigama, and in the Triśiromata, that has been taught: / 'The pit is the power; Śiva is the liṅga; their union is the supreme state. // 141

29.s:
dvābhyāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhṛtistadvisargastrividho game /
srotodvayasya niṣṭhāntamūrdhvādhaścakrabodhanam // 142
29.d:
द्वाभ्यां सृष्टिः संहृतिस्तद्विसर्गस्त्रिविधो गमे ।
स्रोतोद्वयस्य निष्ठान्तमूर्ध्वाधश्चक्रबोधनम् ॥ 142
29.m: From both arise creation and withdrawal; that threefold creative emission is in the Āgama. / It is the awakening of the upper and lower wheels, the boundary of the two streams, // 142

29.s:
viśrāmaṃ ca samāveśaṃ suṣīṇāṃ marutāṃ tathā /
gatabhedaṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ sandhīnāṃ marmaṇāmapi // 143
29.d:
विश्रामं च समावेशं सुषीणां मरुतां तथा ।
गतभेदं च यन्त्राणां सन्धीनां मर्मणामपि ॥ 143
29.m: the rest and absorption of the channels and winds, / and the overcoming of the division of mystical mechanisms, joints, and vital points, // 143

29.s:
dvāsaptatipade dehe sahasrāre ca nityaśaḥ /
gatyāgatyantarā vittī saṅghaṭṭayati yacchivaḥ // 144
29.d:
द्वासप्ततिपदे देहे सहस्रारे च नित्यशः ।
गत्यागत्यन्तरा वित्ती सङ्घट्टयति यच्छिवः ॥ 144
29.m: in the body of seventy-two [thousand] channels, and continuously in the thousand-petaled [lotus]. / Because Śiva brings into collision the two awarenesses between going and coming, // 144

29.s:
tatprayatnātsadā tiṣṭhetsaṅghaṭṭe bhairave pade /
ubhayostannirākārabhāvasaṃprāptilakṣaṇam // 145
29.d:
तत्प्रयत्नात्सदा तिष्ठेत्सङ्घट्टे भैरवे पदे ।
उभयोस्तन्निराकारभावसंप्राप्तिलक्षणम् ॥ 145
29.m: therefore, by effort, one should always abide in the collision, in the state of Bhairava, / which has the characteristic of attaining the formless reality of both [Śiva and Śakti], // 145

29.s:
mātrāvibhāgarahitaṃ susphuṭārthaprakāśakam /
abhyasyedbhāvasaṃvittiṃ sarvabhāvanivartanāt // 146
29.d:
मात्राविभागरहितं सुस्फुटार्थप्रकाशकम् ।
अभ्यस्येद्भावसंवित्तिं सर्वभावनिवर्तनात् ॥ 146
29.m: is free of distinction of morae, and reveals clearly manifest reality. / One should cultivate consciousness of reality by turning back from all objective entities, // 146

29.s:
sūryasomau tu saṃrudhya layavikṣepamārgataḥ /
evaṃ trividhavimarśāveśasamāpattidhāmni ya udeti // 147
29.d:
सूर्यसोमौ तु संरुध्य लयविक्षेपमार्गतः ।
एवं त्रिविधविमर्शावेशसमापत्तिधाम्नि य उदेति ॥ 147
29.m: restraining the sun and moon through the paths of dissolution and projection. / Thus, in the abode of attainment of the absorption of threefold reflective awareness, that which arises, // 147

29.s:
saṃvitparimarśātmā dhvanistadeveha mantravīryaṃ syāt /
tatraivoditatādṛśaphalalābhasamutsukaḥ svakaṃ mantram // 148
29.d:
संवित्परिमर्शात्मा ध्वनिस्तदेवेह मन्त्रवीर्यं स्यात् ।
तत्रैवोदिततादृशफललाभसमुत्सुकः स्वकं मन्त्रम् ॥ 148
29.m: the resonance whose essence is reflective awareness of consciousness, would here be the potency of mantra. / Eager to attain such a fruit arising right there, if he constantly dwells // 148

29.s:
anusandhāya sadā cedāste mantrodayaṃ sa vai vetti /
atraiva japaṃ kuryādanucakraikatvasaṃvidāgamane // 149
29.d:
अनुसन्धाय सदा चेदास्ते मन्त्रोदयं स वै वेत्ति ।
अत्रैव जपं कुर्यादनुचक्रैकत्वसंविदागमने ॥ 149
29.m: upon his own mantra, he truly knows the rising of mantra. / One should perform repetition right here when the consciousness of oneness of the secondary wheels arrives, // 149

29.s:
yugapallakṣavibhedaprapañcitaṃ nādavṛttyaiva /
śrīyogasañcare'pica mudreyaṃ yoginīpriyā paramā // 150
29.d:
युगपल्लक्षविभेदप्रपञ्चितं नादवृत्त्यैव ।
श्रीयोगसञ्चरेऽपिच मुद्रेयं योगिनीप्रिया परमा ॥ 150
29.m: which is elaborated through hundreds of thousands of distinctions simultaneously, solely by the operation of sound. / Also in the venerable Yogasañcāra [it is taught]: 'This supreme mudrā is dear to the yoginīs. // 150

29.s:
koṇatrayāntarāśritanityonmukhamaṇḍalacchade kamale /
satatāviyutaṃ nālaṃ ṣoḍaśadalakamalakalitasanmūlam // 151
29.d:
कोणत्रयान्तराश्रितनित्योन्मुखमण्डलच्छदे कमले ।
सततावियुतं नालं षोडशदलकमलकलितसन्मूलम् ॥ 151
29.m: On the lotus having petal-coverings of the circle perpetually facing upward, resting within the three corners, / the stalk is constantly joined, possessing a firm root composed of a sixteen-petaled lotus. // 151

29.s:
madhyasthanālagumphitasarojayugaghaṭṭanakramādagnau /
madhyasthapūrṇasundaraśaśadharadinakarakalaughasaṅghaṭṭāt // 152
29.d:
मध्यस्थनालगुम्फितसरोजयुगघट्टनक्रमादग्नौ ।
मध्यस्थपूर्णसुन्दरशशधरदिनकरकलौघसङ्घट्टात् ॥ 152
29.m: In the fire, through the friction of the pair of lotuses strung upon the central stalk, / from the collision of the host of digits of the full, beautiful moon and sun situated in the middle, // 152

29.s:
tridalāruṇavīryakalāsaṅgānmadhye'ṅkuraḥ sṛṣṭiḥ /
iti śaśadharavāsarapaticitragusaṃghaṭṭamudrayā jhaṭiti // 153
29.d:
त्रिदलारुणवीर्यकलासङ्गान्मध्येऽङ्कुरः सृष्टिः ।
इति शशधरवासरपतिचित्रगुसंघट्टमुद्रया झटिति ॥ 153
29.m: creation is the sprout in the middle, born of union with the red potency-digit of three petals.' / Thus, through the mudrā of collision of the moon, the sun, and the fire, instantly // 153

29.s:
sṛṣṭyādikramamantaḥ kurvaṃsturye sthitiṃ labhate /
etatkhecaramudrāveśe'nyonyasya śaktiśaktimatoḥ // 154
29.d:
सृष्ट्यादिक्रममन्तः कुर्वंस्तुर्ये स्थितिं लभते ।
एतत्खेचरमुद्रावेशेऽन्योन्यस्य शक्तिशक्तिमतोः ॥ 154
29.m: effecting within the sequence of creation and the rest, one attains stability in the Fourth. / When this mudrā of the skyfarer penetrates the power and the possessor of power mutually, // 154

29.s:
pānopabhogalīlāhāsādiṣu yo bhavedvimarśamayaḥ /
avyaktadhvanirāvasphoṭaśrutinādanādāntaiḥ // 155
29.d:
पानोपभोगलीलाहासादिषु यो भवेद्विमर्शमयः ।
अव्यक्तध्वनिरावस्फोटश्रुतिनादनादान्तैः ॥ 155
29.m: whatever consists of reflective awareness during drinking, enjoyment, amorous play, laughter, and so forth, / as inarticulate sound, burst, audition, resonance, and sound's end, // 155

29.s:
avyucchinnānāhatarūpaistanmantravīryaṃ syāt /
iti cakrāṣṭakarūḍhaḥ sahajaṃ japamācaran pare dhāmni // 156
29.d:
अव्युच्छिन्नानाहतरूपैस्तन्मन्त्रवीर्यं स्यात् ।
इति चक्राष्टकरूढः सहजं जपमाचरन् परे धाम्नि ॥ 156
29.m: in uninterrupted and unstruck forms, that would be the potency of mantra. / Established thus in the eight wheels, performing the spontaneous repetition in the supreme abode, // 156

29.s:
yadbhairavāṣṭakapadaṃ tallabhate'ṣṭakakalābhinnam /
gamanāgamane'vasitau karṇe nayane dviliṅgasaṃparke // 157
29.d:
यद्भैरवाष्टकपदं तल्लभतेऽष्टककलाभिन्नम् ।
गमनागमनेऽवसितौ कर्णे नयने द्विलिङ्गसंपर्के ॥ 157
29.m: one attains that state of the eight Bhairavas differentiated by the eight digits: / in going and coming, in cessation, in the ear, in the eye, in the contact of the two sexes, // 157

29.s:
tatsaṃmelanayoge dehāntākhye ca yāmale cakre /
kucamadhyahṛdayadeśādoṣṭhāntaṃ kaṇṭhagaṃ yadavyaktam // 158
29.d:
तत्संमेलनयोगे देहान्ताख्ये च यामले चक्रे ।
कुचमध्यहृदयदेशादोष्ठान्तं कण्ठगं यदव्यक्तम् ॥ 158
29.m: in the union thereof, and in the dyadic wheel named the body's end; / and whatever is inarticulate, rising from the breast-center, the heart region, to the lip-edge and throat, // 158

29.s:
taccakradvayamadhyagamākarṇya kṣobhavigamasamaye yat /
nirvānti tatra caivaṃ yo'ṣṭavidho nādabhairavaḥ paramaḥ // 159
29.d:
तच्चक्रद्वयमध्यगमाकर्ण्य क्षोभविगमसमये यत् ।
निर्वान्ति तत्र चैवं योऽष्टविधो नादभैरवः परमः ॥ 159
29.m: hearing that which is situated between the two wheels, at the moment of cessation of agitation / they dissolve therein; and thus the supreme eightfold Sound-Bhairava, // 159

29.s:
jyotirdhvanisamirakṛtaḥ sā māntrī vyāptirucyate paramā /
sakalākaleśaśūnyaṃ kalāḍhyakhamale tathā kṣapaṇakaṃ ca // 160
29.d:
ज्योतिर्ध्वनिसमिरकृतः सा मान्त्री व्याप्तिरुच्यते परमा ।
सकलाकलेशशून्यं कलाढ्यखमले तथा क्षपणकं च ॥ 160
29.m: composed of light, sound, and air, is declared to be the supreme pervasion of mantra: / devoid of all and parts, full of digits, in the sky-impurity, and in the ascetic, // 160

29.s:
antaḥsthaṃ kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyaṃ candrādvyāptistathonmanānteyam /
evaṃ karmaṇi karmaṇi yatra kvāpi smaran vyāptim // 161
29.d:
अन्तःस्थं कण्ठ्योष्ठ्यं चन्द्राद्व्याप्तिस्तथोन्मनान्तेयम् ।
एवं कर्मणि कर्मणि यत्र क्वापि स्मरन् व्याप्तिम् ॥ 161
29.m: internal, guttural, labial, from the moon, and likewise this pervasion ending in Unmanā. / Thus remembering this pervasion wherever [he may be] in every action, // 161

29.s:
satatamalepo jīvanmuktaḥ parabhairavībhavati /
tādṛṅmelakakalikākalitatanuḥ ko'pi yo bhavedgarbhe // 162
29.d:
सततमलेपो जीवन्मुक्तः परभैरवीभवति ।
तादृङ्मेलककलिकाकलिततनुः कोऽपि यो भवेद्गर्भे ॥ 162
29.m: eternally unstained, liberated while living, he becomes the supreme Bhairava. / Whoever has his body formed in the womb from the bud of such a union // 162

29.s:
uktaḥ sa yoginībhūḥ svayameva jñānabhājanaṃ rudraḥ /
śrīvīrāvaliśāstre bālo'pi ca garbhago hi śivarūpaḥ // 163
29.d:
उक्तः स योगिनीभूः स्वयमेव ज्ञानभाजनं रुद्रः ।
श्रीवीरावलिशास्त्रे बालोऽपि च गर्भगो हि शिवरूपः ॥ 163
29.m: is declared to be yoginī-born, Rudra himself, a vessel of knowledge. / In the venerable Vīrāvalī scripture [it is said]: 'Even as an infant in the womb, he is indeed of the nature of Śiva.' // 163

29.s:
ādīyate yataḥ sāraṃ tasya mukhyasya caiṣa yat /
mukhyaśca yāgastenāyamādiyāga iti smṛtaḥ // 164
29.d:
आदीयते यतः सारं तस्य मुख्यस्य चैष यत् ।
मुख्यश्च यागस्तेनायमादियाग इति स्मृतः ॥ 164
29.m:
Because its essence is extracted, and because this principal [rite]
is the chief sacrifice, it is remembered as the 'primordial sacrifice' (ādiyāga). // 164

29.s:
tatra tatra ca śāstre'sya svarūpaṃ stutavān vibhuḥ /
śrīvīrāvalihārdeśakhamatārṇavavartiṣu // 165
29.d:
तत्र तत्र च शास्त्रेऽस्य स्वरूपं स्तुतवान् विभुः ।
श्रीवीरावलिहार्देशखमतार्णववर्तिषु ॥ 165
29.m:
And in various scriptures the all-pervading Lord praised its nature:
in the Śrīvīrāvalī, the Hārdeśa, the Khamatārṇava, // 165

29.s:
śrīsiddhotphullamaryādāhīnacaryākulādiṣu /
yugmasyāsya prasādena vratayogavivarjitaḥ // 166
29.d:
श्रीसिद्धोत्फुल्लमर्यादाहीनचर्याकुलादिषु ।
युग्मस्यास्य प्रसादेन व्रतयोगविवर्जितः ॥ 166
29.m:
the Śrīsiddhotphulla, the Maryādāhīna, the Caryākula, and others.
By the grace of this couple, free from vows and yogic practices, // 166

29.s:
sarvadā smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ādiyāgaikatatparaḥ /
śaktidehe nije nyasyedvidyāṃ kūṭamanukramāt // 167
29.d:
सर्वदा स्मरणं कृत्वा आदियागैकतत्परः ।
शक्तिदेहे निजे न्यस्येद्विद्यां कूटमनुक्रमात् ॥ 167
29.m:
always remembering [this], devoted solely to the primordial sacrifice,
he should deposit the Vidyā and the Kūṭa sequentially upon the body of his śakti and upon his own. // 167

29.s:
dhyātvā candranibhaṃ padmamātmānaṃ bhāskaradyutim /
vidyāmantrātmakaṃ pīṭhadvayamatraiva melayet // 168
29.d:
ध्यात्वा चन्द्रनिभं पद्ममात्मानं भास्करद्युतिम् ।
विद्यामन्त्रात्मकं पीठद्वयमत्रैव मेलयेत् ॥ 168
29.m:
Meditating on the moon-like lotus and on oneself having the radiance of the sun,
he should unite right here the two seats, which consist of the vidyā and the mantra. // 168

29.s:
na paṭhyate rahasyatvātspaṣṭaiḥ śabdairmayā punaḥ /
kutūhalī tūktaśāstrasaṃpāṭhādeva lakṣayet // 169
29.d:
न पठ्यते रहस्यत्वात्स्पष्टैः शब्दैर्मया पुनः ।
कुतूहली तूक्तशास्त्रसंपाठादेव लक्षयेत् ॥ 169
29.m:
It is not recited again by me in explicit words due to its secret nature;
but the curious one should understand [it] from the recitation of the scriptures mentioned. // 169

29.s:
yadbhajante sadā sarve yadvān devaśca devatā /
taccakraṃ paramaṃ devīyāgādau saṃnidhāpakam // 170
29.d:
यद्भजन्ते सदा सर्वे यद्वान् देवश्च देवता ।
तच्चक्रं परमं देवीयागादौ संनिधापकम् ॥ 170
29.m:
That which all worship always, or which the god and goddess worship,
that supreme wheel is that which makes present [the deities] at the beginning of the sacrifice of the Goddess and the like. // 170

29.s:
deha eva paraṃ liṅgaṃ sarvatattvātmakaṃ śivam /
devatācakrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ pūjādhāma taduttamam // 171
29.d:
देह एव परं लिङ्गं सर्वतत्त्वात्मकं शिवम् ।
देवताचक्रसंजुष्टं पूजाधाम तदुत्तमम् ॥ 171
29.m:
The body itself is the supreme linga, Śiva comprising all tattvas,
frequented by the wheel of deities, the supreme abode of worship. // 171

29.s:
tadeva maṇḍalaṃ mukhyaṃ tritriśūlābjacakrakham /
tatraiva devatācakraṃ bahirantaḥ sadā yajet // 172
29.d:
तदेव मण्डलं मुख्यं त्रित्रिशूलाब्जचक्रखम् ।
तत्रैव देवताचक्रं बहिरन्तः सदा यजेत् ॥ 172
29.m:
That itself is the principal maṇḍala, the void of the wheel of three tridents and lotuses;
right there one should constantly worship the wheel of deities internally and externally. // 172

29.s:
svasvamantraparāmarśapūrvaṃ tajjanmabhī rasaiḥ /
ānandabahulaiḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāravidhinā spṛśet // 173
29.d:
स्वस्वमन्त्रपरामर्शपूर्वं तज्जन्मभी रसैः ।
आनन्दबहुलैः सृष्टिसंहारविधिना स्पृशेत् ॥ 173
29.m:
Preceded by the reflective awareness of their respective mantras, with the fluids born thereof
abounding in bliss, he should touch [them] according to the rule of emission and retraction. // 173

29.s:
tatsparśarabhasodbuddhasaṃviccakraṃ tadīśvaraḥ /
labhate paramaṃ dhāma tarpitāśeṣadaivataḥ // 174
29.d:
तत्स्पर्शरभसोद्बुद्धसंविच्चक्रं तदीश्वरः ।
लभते परमं धाम तर्पिताशेषदैवतः ॥ 174
29.m:
He whose wheel of consciousness is awakened by the impetuosity of that contact, the master thereof,
having satisfied all the deities, attains the supreme abode. // 174

29.s:
anuyāgoktavidhinā dravyairhṛdayahāribhiḥ /
tathaiva svasvakāmarśayogādantaḥ pratarpayet // 175
29.d:
अनुयागोक्तविधिना द्रव्यैर्हृदयहारिभिः ।
तथैव स्वस्वकामर्शयोगादन्तः प्रतर्पयेत् ॥ 175
29.m:
According to the rule prescribed for the subsequent sacrifice, with heart-captivating substances,
he should likewise gratify them within, through the yoga of reflective awareness of their respective natures. // 175

29.s:
kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitāmāttairmānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasandohibhiḥ /
ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye'harniśam // 176
29.d:
कृत्वाधारधरां चमत्कृतिरसप्रोक्षाक्षणक्षालितामात्तैर्मानसतः स्वभावकुसुमैः स्वामोदसन्दोहिभिः ।
आनन्दामृतनिर्भरस्वहृदयानर्घार्घपात्रक्रमात् त्वां देव्या सह देहदेवसदने देवार्चयेऽहर्निशम् ॥ 176
29.m:
Having made the supporting earth cleansed in an instant by the sprinkling of the savor of wonder,
with flowers of intrinsic nature gathered mentally, brimming with their own fragrant multitudes,
in the sequence of the priceless vessel of offering that is one's own heart filled with the nectar of bliss,
O God, I worship you day and night together with the Goddess in the temple that is the body. // 176

29.s:
śrīvīrāvalyamaryādaprabhṛtau śāstrasañcaye /
sa eṣa paramo yāgaḥ stutaḥ śītāṃśumaulinā // 177
29.d:
श्रीवीरावल्यमर्यादप्रभृतौ शास्त्रसञ्चये ।
स एष परमो यागः स्तुतः शीतांशुमौलिना ॥ 177
29.m:
In the collection of scriptures beginning with the Śrīvīrāvalī and the Maryādāhīna,
this very supreme sacrifice was praised by the moon-crested Lord. // 177

29.s:
athavā prāṇavṛttisthaṃ samastaṃ devatāgaṇam /
paśyetpūrvoktayuktyaiva tatraivābhyarcayedguruḥ // 178
29.d:
अथवा प्राणवृत्तिस्थं समस्तं देवतागणम् ।
पश्येत्पूर्वोक्तयुक्त्यैव तत्रैवाभ्यर्चयेद्गुरुः ॥ 178
29.m:
Or rather, the guru should behold the entire assembly of deities residing in the operation of the vital breath
by the very method stated before, and should worship them right there. // 178

29.s:
prāṇāśritānāṃ devīnāṃ brahmanāsādibhedibhiḥ /
karandhrairviśatāpānacāndracakreṇa tarpaṇam // 179
29.d:
प्राणाश्रितानां देवीनां ब्रह्मनासादिभेदिभिः ।
करन्ध्रैर्विशतापानचान्द्रचक्रेण तर्पणम् ॥ 179
29.m:
The gratification of the goddesses residing in the vital breath is accomplished by the lunar wheel of the apāna,
entering through the apertures of the hands that penetrate the opening of Brahman, the nose, and so forth. // 179

29.s:
evaṃ prāṇakrameṇaiva tarpayeddevatāgaṇam /
acirāttatprasādena jñānasiddhīrathāśnute // 180
29.d:
एवं प्राणक्रमेणैव तर्पयेद्देवतागणम् ।
अचिरात्तत्प्रसादेन ज्ञानसिद्धीरथाश्नुते ॥ 180
29.m:
Thus, in the very sequence of the vital breath, he should gratify the host of deities;
soon, through their grace, he obtains spiritual accomplishments of knowledge. // 180

29.s:
saṃvinmātrasthitaṃ devīcakraṃ vā saṃvidarpaṇāt /
viśvābhogaprayogeṇa tarpaṇīyaṃ vipaścitā // 181
29.d:
संविन्मात्रस्थितं देवीचक्रं वा संविदर्पणात् ।
विश्वाभोगप्रयोगेण तर्पणीयं विपश्चिता ॥ 181
29.m:
Or the wise man should gratify the wheel of goddesses residing solely in consciousness, through the offering of consciousness,
by means of the practice of universal expanse. // 181

29.s:
yatra sarve layaṃ yānti dahyante tattvasañcayāḥ /
tāṃ citiṃ paśya kāyasthāṃ kālānalasamaprabhām // 182
29.d:
यत्र सर्वे लयं यान्ति दह्यन्ते तत्त्वसञ्चयाः ।
तां चितिं पश्य कायस्थां कालानलसमप्रभाम् ॥ 182
29.m:
Behold that funeral pyre of consciousness stationed in the body, possessing a radiance like the fire of destruction,
wherein all dissolve and the heaps of tattvas are consumed. // 182

29.s:
śūnyarūpe śmaśāne'smin yoginīsiddhasevite /
krīḍāsthāne mahāraudre sarvāstamitavigrahe // 183
29.d:
शून्यरूपे श्मशानेऽस्मिन् योगिनीसिद्धसेविते ।
क्रीडास्थाने महारौद्रे सर्वास्तमितविग्रहे ॥ 183
29.m:
In this cremation ground of the nature of the void, frequented by yoginīs and siddhas,
a place of sport, immensely terrible, where all physical form has set, // 183

29.s:
svaraśmimaṇḍalākīrṇe dhvaṃsitadhvāntasantatau /
sarvairvikalpairnirmukte ānandapadakevale // 184
29.d:
स्वरश्मिमण्डलाकीर्णे ध्वंसितध्वान्तसन्ततौ ।
सर्वैर्विकल्पैर्निर्मुक्ते आनन्दपदकेवले ॥ 184
29.m:
filled with the circle of its own rays, the continuity of darkness destroyed,
freed from all conceptual constructs, nothing but the plane of bliss, // 184

29.s:
asaṃkhyacitisaṃpūrṇe śmaśāne citibhīṣaṇe /
samastadevatādhāre praviṣṭaḥ ko na siddhyati // 185
29.d:
असंख्यचितिसंपूर्णे श्मशाने चितिभीषणे ।
समस्तदेवताधारे प्रविष्टः को न सिद्ध्यति ॥ 185
29.m:
in the cremation ground filled with countless pyres, terrifying with funeral fires,
the support of all deities—who that enters here does not attain spiritual accomplishment? // 185

29.s:
śrīmadvīrāvalīśāstre itthaṃ provāca bhairavī /
itthaṃ yāgaṃ vidhāyādau tādṛśaucityabhāginam // 186
29.d:
श्रीमद्वीरावलीशास्त्रे इत्थं प्रोवाच भैरवी ।
इत्थं यागं विधायादौ तादृशौचित्यभागिनम् ॥ 186
29.m:
Thus the Goddess Bhairavī spoke in the venerable Vīrāvalīśāstra.
Having thus performed the sacrifice at the outset, one endowed with such fitness, // 186

29.s:
lakṣaikīyaṃ svaśiṣyaṃ taṃ dīkṣayettādṛśi krame /
rudraśaktyā tu taṃ prokṣya devābhyāśe niveśayet // 187
29.d:
लक्षैकीयं स्वशिष्यं तं दीक्षयेत्तादृशि क्रमे ।
रुद्रशक्त्या तु तं प्रोक्ष्य देवाभ्याशे निवेशयेत् ॥ 187
29.m:
his own disciple of a single aim, he should initiate into such a sequence:
having sprinkled him with the power of Rudra, he should seat him near the deity. // 187

29.s:
bhujau tasya samālokya rudraśaktyā pradīpayet /
tayaivāsyārpayetpuṣpaṃ karayorgandhadigdhayoḥ // 188
29.d:
भुजौ तस्य समालोक्य रुद्रशक्त्या प्रदीपयेत् ।
तयैवास्यार्पयेत्पुष्पं करयोर्गन्धदिग्धयोः ॥ 188
29.m:
Looking at his two arms, he should kindle them with the power of Rudra;
with that very [power] he should place a flower into his hands anointed with fragrant paste. // 188

29.s:
nirālambau tu tau tasya sthāpayitvā vicintayet /
rudraśaktyākṛṣyamāṇau dīptayāṅkuśarūpayā // 189
29.d:
निरालम्बौ तु तौ तस्य स्थापयित्वा विचिन्तयेत् ।
रुद्रशक्त्याकृष्यमाणौ दीप्तयाङ्कुशरूपया ॥ 189
29.m:
Placing the two [arms] without support, he should meditate on them
as being drawn by the radiant power of Rudra in the form of a hook. // 189

29.s:
tataḥ sa svayamādāya vastraṃ baddhadṛśirbhavet /
svayaṃ ca pātayetpuṣpaṃ tatpātāllakṣayetkulam // 190
29.d:
ततः स स्वयमादाय वस्त्रं बद्धदृशिर्भवेत् ।
स्वयं च पातयेत्पुष्पं तत्पाताल्लक्षयेत्कुलम् ॥ 190
29.m:
Then, having taken the cloth himself, [the disciple] should have his eyes bound,
and he should drop the flower himself; from its fall [the guru] should recognize the spiritual family (kula). // 190

29.s:
tato'sya mukhamuddhāṭya pādayoḥ praṇipātayet /
hastayormūrdhni cāpyasya devīcakraṃ samarcayet // 191
29.d:
ततोऽस्य मुखमुद्धाट्य पादयोः प्रणिपातयेत् ।
हस्तयोर्मूर्ध्नि चाप्यस्य देवीचक्रं समर्चयेत् ॥ 191
29.m:
Then, uncovering his face, he should have him prostrate at his feet;
and upon his hands and head he should worship the wheel of goddesses. // 191

29.s:
ākarṣyākarṣakatvena preryaprerakabhāvataḥ /
uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nābhiṃ daṇḍena saṃpuṭam // 192
29.d:
आकर्ष्याकर्षकत्वेन प्रेर्यप्रेरकभावतः ।
उक्तं श्रीरत्नमालायां नाभिं दण्डेन संपुटम् ॥ 192
29.m:
Through the state of being attracted and attractor, and through the nature of impeller and impelled,
it is taught in the Śrīratnamālā: having the navel enclosed by the staff, // 192

29.s:
vāmabhūṣaṇajaṅghābhyāṃ nitambenāpyalaṅkṛtam /
śiṣyahaste puṣpabhṛte codanāstraṃ tu yojayet // 193
29.d:
वामभूषणजङ्घाभ्यां नितम्बेनाप्यलङ्कृतम् ।
शिष्यहस्ते पुष्पभृते चोदनास्त्रं तु योजयेत् ॥ 193
29.m:
adorned with the left ornament and the shanks, and also with the hip—
he should apply the missile of impulsion to the disciple's hand holding the flower, // 193

29.s:
yāvatsa stobhamāyātaḥ svayaṃ patati mūrdhani /
śivahastaḥ svayaṃ so'yaṃ sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ // 194
29.d:
यावत्स स्तोभमायातः स्वयं पतति मूर्धनि ।
शिवहस्तः स्वयं सोऽयं सद्यःप्रत्ययकारकः ॥ 194
29.m:
until, undergoing possession, it falls of its own accord upon the head.
This is the hand of Śiva itself, producing immediate conviction. // 194

29.s:
anenaiva prayogeṇa carukaṃ grāhayedguruḥ /
śiṣyeṇa dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca tatpātaḥ prāgvadeva tu // 195
29.d:
अनेनैव प्रयोगेण चरुकं ग्राहयेद्गुरुः ।
शिष्येण दन्तकाष्ठं च तत्पातः प्राग्वदेव तु ॥ 195
29.m:
By this very practice the guru should have the sacrificial food (caru) taken
by the disciple, as well as the tooth-cleaning stick; its fall is just as before. // 195

29.s:
karastobho netrapaṭagrahāt prabhṛti yaḥ kila /
dantakāṣṭhasamādānaparyantastatra lakṣayet // 196
29.d:
करस्तोभो नेत्रपटग्रहात् प्रभृति यः किल ।
दन्तकाष्ठसमादानपर्यन्तस्तत्र लक्षयेत् ॥ 196
29.m:
The seizure of the hand, which indeed begins from the taking of the blindfold
and lasts up to the grasping of the tooth-stick—therein he should discern // 196

29.s:
tīvramandādibhedena śaktipātaṃ tathāvidham /
ityeṣa samayī proktaḥ śrīpūrve karakampataḥ // 197
29.d:
तीव्रमन्दादिभेदेन शक्तिपातं तथाविधम् ।
इत्येष समयी प्रोक्तः श्रीपूर्वे करकम्पतः ॥ 197
29.m:
the descent of power according to the divisions of intense, mild, and so forth, in that manner.
Such a one is declared an initiate into the rule (samayī) in the Śrīpūrva from the trembling of the hand; // 197

29.s:
samayī tu karastobhāditi śrībhogahastake /
carveva vā gururdadyādvāmāmṛtapariplutam // 198
29.d:
समयी तु करस्तोभादिति श्रीभोगहस्तके ।
चर्वेव वा गुरुर्दद्याद्वामामृतपरिप्लुतम् ॥ 198
29.m:
and 'an initiate into the rule from the seizure of the hand' in the Śrībhogahastaka.
Or the guru may give the caru flooded with the nectar of the left. // 198

29.s:
niḥśaṅkaṃ grahaṇācchaktigotro māyojjhito bhavet /
sakampastvādadānaḥ syāt samayī vācanādiṣu // 199
29.d:
निःशङ्कं ग्रहणाच्छक्तिगोत्रो मायोज्झितो भवेत् ।
सकम्पस्त्वाददानः स्यात् समयी वाचनादिषु ॥ 199
29.m:
From taking it without hesitation, he belongs to the lineage of Śakti and is freed from māyā;
but taking it with trembling, he would be an initiate into the rule with regard to instruction and the like. // 199

29.s:
kālāntare'dhvasaṃśuddhyā pālanātsamayasthiteḥ /
siddhipātramiti śrīmadānandeśvara ucyate // 200
29.d:
कालान्तरेऽध्वसंशुद्ध्या पालनात्समयस्थितेः ।
सिद्धिपात्रमिति श्रीमदानन्देश्वर उच्यते ॥ 200
29.m:
In time, through the purification of the path and the keeping of the rule,
he becomes a vessel of spiritual accomplishment: thus it is said in the Śrīmadānandeśvara. // 200

29.s:
yadā tu putrakaṃ kuryāttadā dīkṣāṃ samācaret /
uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nādiphāntāṃ jvalatprabhām // 201
29.d:
यदा तु पुत्रकं कुर्यात्तदा दीक्षां समाचरेत् ।
उक्तं श्रीरत्नमालायां नादिफान्तां ज्वलत्प्रभाम् ॥ 201
29.m:
When, however, he would make him a spiritual son (putraka), then he should perform the initiation.
It is said in the Śrīratnamālā: [the mantra] beginning with nāda and ending with phaṭ, of blazing radiance, // 201

29.s:
nyasyecchikhāntaṃ patati tenātredṛk kramo bhavet /
prokṣitasya śiśornyastaproktaśodhyādhvapaddhateḥ // 202
29.d:
न्यस्येच्छिखान्तं पतति तेनात्रेदृक् क्रमो भवेत् ।
प्रोक्षितस्य शिशोर्न्यस्तप्रोक्तशोध्याध्वपद्धतेः ॥ 202
29.m:
he should install up to the tuft of hair; it falls, and therefore such a sequence should occur here.
For the child who has been sprinkled, upon whom the stated course of the path to be purified has been installed, // 202

29.s:
ṛjudehajuṣaḥ śaktiṃ pādānmūrdhāntamāgatām /
pāśāndahantīṃ saṃdīptāṃ cintayettanmayo guruḥ // 203
29.d:
ऋजुदेहजुषः शक्तिं पादान्मूर्धान्तमागताम् ।
पाशान्दहन्तीं संदीप्तां चिन्तयेत्तन्मयो गुरुः ॥ 203
29.m:
the guru, identified with it, should meditate on the power that occupies an upright body,
which has reached from the feet to the head, burning the bonds, blazing brightly. // 203

29.s:
upaviśya tatastasya mūlaśodhyāt prabhṛtyalam /
antaśodhyāvasānāntāṃ dahantīṃ cintayetkramāt // 204
29.d:
उपविश्य ततस्तस्य मूलशोध्यात् प्रभृत्यलम् ।
अन्तशोध्यावसानान्तां दहन्तीं चिन्तयेत्क्रमात् ॥ 204
29.m:
Having seated himself, he should then completely meditate on it sequentially
burning from the primary element to be purified up to the end of the final element to be purified. // 204

29.s:
evaṃ sarvāṇi śodhyāni tattvādīni puroktavat /
dagdhvā līnāṃ śive dhyāyenniṣkale sakale'thavā // 205
29.d:
एवं सर्वाणि शोध्यानि तत्त्वादीनि पुरोक्तवत् ।
दग्ध्वा लीनां शिवे ध्यायेन्निष्कले सकलेऽथवा ॥ 205
29.m:
Having thus burned all the tattvas and other items to be purified as previously explained,
he should meditate on [the power] dissolved in Śiva, either formless or with form. // 205

29.s:
yoginā yojitā mārge sajātīyasya poṣaṇam /
kurute nirdahatyantadbhinnajātikadambakam // 206
29.d:
योगिना योजिता मार्गे सजातीयस्य पोषणम् ।
कुरुते निर्दहत्यन्तद्भिन्नजातिकदम्बकम् ॥ 206
29.m:
Employed on the path by the yogin, it provides nourishment to that of the same kind,
and utterly burns the collection of different kinds. // 206

29.s:
anayā śodhyamānasya śiśostīvrādibhedataḥ /
śaktipātāccitivyomaprāṇanāntarbahistanūḥ // 207
29.d:
