31.m: Then, by the measure of half the desired area, one should mark from the centre in the cardinal directions; / by two cords originating from pairs of cardinal points, a fish figure is produced at each corner.

31.s:
matsyeṣu vedāḥ sūtrāṇītyevaṃ syāccaturasrakam /
ekasmātprabhṛti proktaṃ śatāntaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yataḥ // 7
31.d:
मत्स्येषु वेदाः सूत्राणीत्येवं स्याच्चतुरस्रकम् ।
एकस्मात्प्रभृति प्रोक्तं शतान्तं मण्डलं यतः ॥ 7
31.m: At the fish figures are the four cords; thus a square is formed. / Since the maṇḍala is taught starting from one up to a hundred,

31.s:
siddhātantre maṇḍalānāṃ śataṃ tatpīṭha ucyate /
yattanmadhyagataṃ mukhyaṃ maṇḍalānāṃ trayaṃ smṛtam // 8
31.d:
सिद्धातन्त्रे मण्डलानां शतं तत्पीठ उच्यते ।
यत्तन्मध्यगतं मुख्यं मण्डलानां त्रयं स्मृतम् ॥ 8
31.m: a hundred maṇḍalas are described on that seat in the Siddhātantra, / of which the primary triad of maṇḍalas situated in their midst is remembered,

31.s:
madhyaśūlaṃ tritriśūlaṃ navaśūlamiti sphuṭam /
tatra śūlavidhānaṃ yaduktaṃ bhedairanantakaiḥ // 9
31.d:
मध्यशूलं त्रित्रिशूलं नवशूलमिति स्फुटम् ।
तत्र शूलविधानं यदुक्तं भेदैरनन्तकैः ॥ 9
31.m: clearly known as the central trident, the three-trident, and the nine-trident. / There, the procedure for the trident, which is taught with endless varieties,

31.s:
tadyoni maṇḍalaṃ brūmaḥ sadbhāvakramadarśitam /
vedāśrite caturhaste tribhāgaṃ sarvatastyajet // 10
31.d:
तद्योनि मण्डलं ब्रूमः सद्भावक्रमदर्शितम् ।
वेदाश्रिते चतुर्हस्ते त्रिभागं सर्वतस्त्यजेत् ॥ 10
31.m: is the matrix-maṇḍala which we now describe as shown in the sequence of the Sadbhāva: / In a four-cubit square, one should discard one third on every side;

31.s:
bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ sarvaṃ tattatkṣetraṃ vibhājayet /
brahmasūtradvayasyātha madhyaṃ brahmapadaṃ sphuṭam // 11
31.d:
भागैः षोडशभिः सर्वं तत्तत्क्षेत्रं विभाजयेत् ।
ब्रह्मसूत्रद्वयस्याथ मध्यं ब्रह्मपदं स्फुटम् ॥ 11
31.m: one should divide that entire field into sixteen parts. / Then, clearly taking the centre of the two central cords as the station of Brahman,

31.s:
kṛtvāvadhiṃ tato lakṣyaṃ caturthaṃ sūtramāditaḥ /
tatastiryagvrajet sūtraṃ caturthaṃ tadanantare // 12
31.d:
कृत्वावधिं ततो लक्ष्यं चतुर्थं सूत्रमादितः ।
ततस्तिर्यग्व्रजेत् सूत्रं चतुर्थं तदनन्तरे ॥ 12
31.m: making it the limit, the fourth line is to be sighted from the beginning; / then the transverse line should run to the fourth one adjacent to it.

31.s:
koṣṭhe cendudvayaṃ kuryādbahirbhāgārdhabhāgataḥ /
tayorlagnaṃ brahmasūtrāttṛtīye marmaṇi sthitam // 13
31.d:
कोष्ठे चेन्दुद्वयं कुर्याद्बहिर्भागार्धभागतः ।
तयोर्लग्नं ब्रह्मसूत्रात्तृतीये मर्मणि स्थितम् ॥ 13
31.m: In the compartment, one should make two crescents from half a part on the outer side; / touching them, situated at the third intersection from the central cord,

31.s:
koṣṭhakārdhe'paraṃ ceti yugmamantarmukhaṃ bhavet /
brahmasūtrāddvitīyasmin haste marmaṇi niścalam // 14
31.d:
कोष्ठकार्धेऽपरं चेति युग्ममन्तर्मुखं भवेत् ।
ब्रह्मसूत्राद्द्वितीयस्मिन् हस्ते मर्मणि निश्चलम् ॥ 14
31.m: and another in half a compartment, a pair facing inwards will result. / Making [the compass] steady at the intersection on the second cubit from the central cord,

31.s:
kṛtvā pūrṇenduyugalaṃ vartayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ /
brahmasūtragatāt ṣaṣṭhāt tiryagbhāgāttṛtīyake // 15
31.d:
कृत्वा पूर्णेन्दुयुगलं वर्तयेत विचक्षणः ।
ब्रह्मसूत्रगतात् षष्ठात् तिर्यग्भागात्तृतीयके ॥ 15
31.m: the wise practitioner should trace a pair of full circles. / From the sixth transverse section from that on the central cord, in the third,

31.s:
kṛtvārdhakoṣṭhake sūtraṃ pūrṇacandrāgralambitam /
bhramayedunmukhaṃ khaṇḍacandrayugvahnibhāgagam // 16
31.d:
कृत्वार्धकोष्ठके सूत्रं पूर्णचन्द्राग्रलम्बितम् ।
भ्रमयेदुन्मुखं खण्डचन्द्रयुग्वह्निभागगम् ॥ 16
31.m: placing the cord in the half-compartment, hanging from the front of the full circle, / one should sweep it facing upwards, reaching the fire [south-east] division, conjoined with a pair of crescent moons.

31.s:
tiryagbhāgadvayaṃ tyaktvā khaṇḍendoḥ paścimāttataḥ /
koṇaṃ yāvattathā syācca kuryāt khaṇḍaṃ bhramadvayam // 17
31.d:
तिर्यग्भागद्वयं त्यक्त्वा खण्डेन्दोः पश्चिमात्ततः ।
कोणं यावत्तथा स्याच्च कुर्यात् खण्डं भ्रमद्वयम् ॥ 17
31.m: Leaving two transverse divisions, from the west of the crescent moon, / until the corner is reached, one should make two crescent sweeps in that manner.

31.s:
sutīkṣṇakuṭilāgraṃ tadekaṃ śṛṅgaṃ prajāyate /
dvitīyasminnapi proktaḥ śṛṅga eṣa vidhiḥ sphuṭaḥ // 18
31.d:
सुतीक्ष्णकुटिलाग्रं तदेकं शृङ्गं प्रजायते ।
द्वितीयस्मिन्नपि प्रोक्तः शृङ्ग एष विधिः स्फुटः ॥ 18
31.m: Thus a single prong is produced, having a very sharp and curved tip. / This same rule is clearly taught for the second prong as well.

31.s:
madhyaśṛṅge'tha kartavye tṛtīye ūrdhvakoṣṭhake /
caturthārdhe ca candrārdhadvayamantarmukhaṃ bhavet // 19
31.d:
मध्यशृङ्गेऽथ कर्तव्ये तृतीये ऊर्ध्वकोष्ठके ।
चतुर्थार्धे च चन्द्रार्धद्वयमन्तर्मुखं भवेत् ॥ 19
31.m: Now, when the central prong is to be made, in the third upper compartment / and in half of the fourth, two crescents should face inward,

31.s:
tacca pūrṇendumekaṃ prāgvartitaṃ prāpnuyādyathā /
anyonyagranthiyogena baddhāratvaṃ prajāyate // 20
31.d:
तच्च पूर्णेन्दुमेकं प्राग्वर्तितं प्राप्नुयाद्यथा ।
अन्योन्यग्रन्थियोगेन बद्धारत्वं प्रजायते ॥ 20
31.m: in such a way that they meet the one full circle traced earlier; / through their mutual knotting, unity is produced.

31.s:
evaṃ dvitīyapārśve'sya khaṇḍendudvayavartanāt /
madhyābhyāṃ gaṇḍikā śliṣṭā parābhyāmagrato nayet // 21
31.d:
एवं द्वितीयपार्श्वेऽस्य खण्डेन्दुद्वयवर्तनात् ।
मध्याभ्यां गण्डिका श्लिष्टा पराभ्यामग्रतो नयेत् ॥ 21
31.m:
In this way, on its second side, by drawing two crescents,
one should lead [the line] from the middle pair [so that] a segment is joined, and from the outer pair toward the front, // 21

31.s:
sūtraṃ pārśvadvaye yena tīkṣṇaṃ syānmadhyaśṛṅgagam /
pārśvadvayādhare paścādbrahmasūtraṃ dvitīyakam // 22
31.d:
सूत्रं पार्श्वद्वये येन तीक्ष्णं स्यान्मध्यशृङ्गगम् ।
पार्श्वद्वयाधरे पश्चाद्ब्रह्मसूत्रं द्वितीयकम् ॥ 22
31.m:
by which thread on both flanks the [prong] extending to the central prong becomes sharp.
Below the two flanks, behind, a second central thread // 22

31.s:
avadhānena saṃgrāhyamācāryeṇohavedinā /
bhavetpaścānmukho mantrī tasmiṃśca brahmasūtrake // 23
31.d:
अवधानेन संग्राह्यमाचार्येणोहवेदिना ।
भवेत्पश्चान्मुखो मन्त्री तस्मिंश्च ब्रह्मसूत्रके ॥ 23
31.m:
must be carefully apprehended by the master who understands deduction.
And on that central thread, the mantrin should face west. // 23

31.s:
madhyaśṛṅgaṃ varjayitvā sarvaḥ pūrvodito vidhiḥ /
tato yadunmukhaṃ khaṇḍacandrayugmaṃ puroditam // 24
31.d:
मध्यशृङ्गं वर्जयित्वा सर्वः पूर्वोदितो विधिः ।
ततो यदुन्मुखं खण्डचन्द्रयुग्मं पुरोदितम् ॥ 24
31.m:
Leaving aside the central prong, the entire procedure is as previously stated.
Then, from that upward-turned pair of crescents described before, // 24

31.s:
tato dvayena kartavyā gaṇḍikāntaḥsusaṃgatā /
dvayenāgragasūtrābhyāṃ madhyaśṛṅgadvayaṃ bhavet // 25
31.d:
ततो द्वयेन कर्तव्या गण्डिकान्तःसुसंगता ।
द्वयेनाग्रगसूत्राभ्यां मध्यशृङ्गद्वयं भवेत् ॥ 25
31.m:
by [the first] pair a segment well joined within is to be made;
by the [second] pair, through two threads extending to the front, the pair of central prongs is formed. // 25

31.s:
adho bhāgavivṛddhyāsya padmaṃ vṛttacatuṣṭayam /
tataścakraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ dvidhātha tat // 26
31.d:
अधो भागविवृद्ध्यास्य पद्मं वृत्तचतुष्टयम् ।
ततश्चक्रं षोडशारं द्वादशारं द्विधाथ तत् ॥ 26
31.m:
By expanding its lower part, [there is] a lotus [with] four concentric circles;
then a wheel of sixteen spokes, or of twelve spokes; or it is twofold. // 26

31.s:
madhye kuleśvarīsthānaṃ vyoma vā tilakaṃ ca vā /
padmaṃ vātha ṣaḍaraṃ vā viyaddvādaśakaṃ ca vā // 27
31.d:
मध्ये कुलेश्वरीस्थानं व्योम वा तिलकं च वा ।
पद्मं वाथ षडरं वा वियद्द्वादशकं च वा ॥ 27
31.m:
In the center is the seat of the Kuleśvarī, or the void, or a dot,
or a lotus, or a six-spoked [wheel], or a group of twelve voids. // 27

31.s:
tritriśūle'tra saptāre śliṣṭamātreṇa madhyataḥ /
padmānāmatha cakrāṇāṃ vyomnāṃ vā saptakaṃ bhavet // 28
31.d:
त्रित्रिशूलेऽत्र सप्तारे श्लिष्टमात्रेण मध्यतः ।
पद्मानामथ चक्राणां व्योम्नां वा सप्तकं भवेत् ॥ 28
31.m:
Here, in the three tridents having seven spokes, simply by joining from the center,
there may be a group of seven lotuses, or of wheels, or of voids, // 28

31.s:
miśritaṃ vātha saṃkīrṇaṃ samāsavyāsabhedataḥ /
tataḥ kṣetrārdhamānena kṣetraṃ tatrādhikaṃ kṣipet // 29
31.d:
मिश्रितं वाथ संकीर्णं समासव्यासभेदतः ।
ततः क्षेत्रार्धमानेन क्षेत्रं तत्राधिकं क्षिपेत् ॥ 29
31.m:
or mixed, or combined through distinctions of concise and expanded [arrangements].
Then, measuring half the field, one should project an additional field there. // 29

31.s:
tatra daṇḍaḥ smṛto bhāgaḥ ṣaḍarāmalasārakaḥ /
sutīkṣṇāgraḥ suraktābhaḥ kṣaṇādāveśakārakaḥ // 30
31.d:
तत्र दण्डः स्मृतो भागः षडरामलसारकः ।
सुतीक्ष्णाग्रः सुरक्ताभः क्षणादावेशकारकः ॥ 30
31.m:
There, the shaft is taught as a section, having the pure essence of six spokes,
with an exceedingly sharp tip, very reddish in hue, inducing possession in an instant. // 30

31.s:
yā sā kuṇḍalinī devī taraṅgākhyā mahormiṇī /
sā ṣaḍaśreṇa kandākhye sthitā ṣaḍdevatātmikā // 31
31.d:
या सा कुण्डलिनी देवी तरङ्गाख्या महोर्मिणी ।
सा षडश्रेण कन्दाख्ये स्थिता षड्देवतात्मिका ॥ 31
31.m:
That goddess Kuṇḍalinī, called Taraṅgā, possessing great waves,
she is situated in the [center] called Kanda in a hexagonal form, composed of six deities. // 31

31.s:
aṣṭabhāgaiśca vistīrṇo dīrghaścāpi tadardhataḥ /
tato dvārāṇi kāryāṇi citravartanayā kramāt // 32
31.d:
अष्टभागैश्च विस्तीर्णो दीर्घश्चापि तदर्धतः ।
ततो द्वाराणि कार्याणि चित्रवर्तनया क्रमात् ॥ 32
31.m:
And it is eight units wide, and in length half of that.
Then the doors are to be constructed in sequence by variegated drawing: // 32

31.s:
vedāśrāyatarūpāṇi yadivā vṛttamātrataḥ /
spaṣṭaśṛṅgamatho kuryādyadivā vaiparītyataḥ // 33
31.d:
वेदाश्रायतरूपाणि यदिवा वृत्तमात्रतः ।
स्पष्टशृङ्गमथो कुर्याद्यदिवा वैपरीत्यतः ॥ 33
31.m:
having four-cornered, oblong shapes, or simply circular,
one should make the prong distinct, or conversely [reversed]. // 33

31.s:
unmukhaṃ candrayugmaṃ vā bhaṅktvā kuryāccatuṣṭayam /
kuṭilo madhyataḥ spaṣṭo'dhomukhaḥ pārśvagaḥ sthitaḥ // 34
31.d:
उन्मुखं चन्द्रयुग्मं वा भङ्क्त्वा कुर्याच्चतुष्टयम् ।
कुटिलो मध्यतः स्पष्टोऽधोमुखः पार्श्वगः स्थितः ॥ 34
31.m:
Or breaking the upward-turned pair of crescents, one may make four:
curved in the middle, distinct, downward-turned, located on the flanks, // 34

31.s:
uttāno'rdho'samaḥ pūrṇaḥ śliṣṭo granthigatastathā /
candrasyetthaṃ dvādaśadhā vartanā bhramabhedinī // 35
31.d:
उत्तानोऽर्धोऽसमः पूर्णः श्लिष्टो ग्रन्थिगतस्तथा ।
चन्द्रस्येत्थं द्वादशधा वर्तना भ्रमभेदिनी ॥ 35
31.m:
upward-facing, halved, uneven, full, joined, and situated at a knot.
Thus twelvefold is the drawing of the crescent that dispels confusion. // 35

31.s:
antarbahirmukhatvena sā punardvividhā matā /
tadbhedānmaṇḍalānāṃ syādasaṅkhyo bhedavistaraḥ // 36
31.d:
अन्तर्बहिर्मुखत्वेन सा पुनर्द्विविधा मता ।
तद्भेदान्मण्डलानां स्यादसङ्ख्यो भेदविस्तरः ॥ 36
31.m:
Moreover, through facing inward and outward, it is considered twofold.
From these variations there arises an innumerable multitude of maṇḍalas, // 36

31.s:
pīṭhavīthībahiarbhūmikaṇṭhakarṇakapolataḥ /
śobhopaśobhāsaṃbhedādguṇarekhāvikalpataḥ // 37
31.d:
पीठवीथीबहिअर्भूमिकण्ठकर्णकपोलतः ।
शोभोपशोभासंभेदाद्गुणरेखाविकल्पतः ॥ 37
31.m:
due to the plinth, the pathway, the outer ground, the neck, the corners, and the cheeks,
due to the interplay of main and secondary ornaments, and due to options among the colored boundary lines, // 37

31.s:
svastikadvitayādyaṣṭatayāparyantabhedataḥ /
bhāvābhāvavikalpena maṇḍalānāmanantatā // 38
31.d:
स्वस्तिकद्वितयाद्यष्टतयापर्यन्तभेदतः ।
भावाभावविकल्पेन मण्डलानामनन्तता ॥ 38
31.m:
due to distinctions ranging from two svastikas up to eight,
and due to the presence or absence of options, the maṇḍalas are infinite. // 38

31.s:
tato rajāṃsi deyāni yathāśobhānusārataḥ /
sindūraṃ rājavartaṃ ca khaṭikā ca sitottamā // 39
31.d:
ततो रजांसि देयानि यथाशोभानुसारतः ।
सिन्दूरं राजवर्तं च खटिका च सितोत्तमा ॥ 39
31.m:
Then colored powders are to be applied according to proper beauty:
vermilion, lapis lazuli, and excellent white chalk. // 39

31.s:
uttamāni rajāṃsīha devatātrayayogataḥ /
parā candrasamaprakhyā raktā devī parāparā // 40
31.d:
उत्तमानि रजांसीह देवतात्रययोगतः ।
परा चन्द्रसमप्रख्या रक्ता देवी परापरा ॥ 40
31.m:
These are the highest powders here, corresponding to the triad of deities:
Parā resembles the moon, the goddess Parāparā is red, // 40

31.s:
aparā sā parā kālī bhīṣaṇā caṇḍayoginī /
dṛṣṭvaitanmaṇḍalaṃ devyaḥ sarvā nṛtyanti sarvadā // 41
31.d:
अपरा सा परा काली भीषणा चण्डयोगिनी ।
दृष्ट्वैतन्मण्डलं देव्यः सर्वा नृत्यन्ति सर्वदा ॥ 41
31.m:
and Aparā is that supreme Kālī, terrifying, the fierce yoginī.
Seeing this maṇḍala, all the goddesses dance constantly. // 41

31.s:
anarcite'pyadīkṣeṇa dṛṣṭe dīkṣyeta mātṛbhiḥ /
kiṃvātibahunoktena tritriśūlārasaptakāḥ // 42
31.d:
अनर्चितेऽप्यदीक्षेण दृष्टे दीक्ष्येत मातृभिः ।
किंवातिबहुनोक्तेन त्रित्रिशूलारसप्तकाः ॥ 42
31.m:
Even if uninitiated, one who sees it, even without worship, is initiated by the Mothers.
What need to say more? The seven spokes of the three tridents // 42

31.s:
śūlayāgāḥ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇyevaṃ sārdhaśatadvayam /
yā sā devī parā śaktiḥ prāṇavāhā vyavasthitā // 43
31.d:
शूलयागाः षट् सहस्राण्येवं सार्धशतद्वयम् ।
या सा देवी परा शक्तिः प्राणवाहा व्यवस्थिता ॥ 43
31.m:
are six thousand two hundred and fifty trident-sacrifices.
That goddess who is the supreme power, residing as the flow of the vital breath, // 43

31.s:
viśvāntaḥ kuṇḍalākārā sā sākṣādatra vartitā /
tattvāni tattvadevyaśca viśvamasminpratiṣṭhitam // 44
31.d:
विश्वान्तः कुण्डलाकारा सा साक्षादत्र वर्तिता ।
तत्त्वानि तत्त्वदेव्यश्च विश्वमस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ 44
31.m:
coiled within the universe, is directly drawn here.
The principles of reality, the deities of the principles, and the entire universe are established in this [maṇḍala]. // 44

31.s:
atrordhve tantumātreṇa tisraḥ śūlāragāḥ sthitāḥ /
āsanatvena cecchādyā bhogamokṣaprasādhikāḥ // 45
31.d:
अत्रोर्ध्वे तन्तुमात्रेण तिस्रः शूलारगाः स्थिताः ।
आसनत्वेन चेच्छाद्या भोगमोक्षप्रसाधिकाः ॥ 45
31.m:
Here, above, by the mere cord, the three [goddesses] are located on the trident tips;
and as the seat [stand] Will and the others, bestowing enjoyment and liberation. // 45

31.s:
tāstu mokṣaikakāmasya śūlārāviddhamadhyakāḥ /
tasmādenaṃ mahāyāgaṃ mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ // 46
31.d:
तास्तु मोक्षैककामस्य शूलाराविद्धमध्यकाः ।
तस्मादेनं महायागं महाविभवविस्तरैः ॥ 46
31.m:
For one whose sole desire is liberation, however, their centers are pierced by the trident's prongs.
Therefore, the wise person desiring prosperity or desiring liberation // 46

31.s:
pūjayedbhūtikāmo vā mokṣakāmo'pivā budhaḥ /
asya darśanamātreṇa bhūtavetālaguhyakāḥ // 47
31.d:
पूजयेद्भूतिकामो वा मोक्षकामोऽपिवा बुधः ।
अस्य दर्शनमात्रेण भूतवेतालगुह्यकाः ॥ 47
31.m:
should worship this great sacrifice with extensive and great riches.
By the mere sight of this, spirits, vetālas, and guhyakas // 47

31.s:
palāyante daśa diśaḥ śivaḥ sākṣātprasīdati /
mandaśaktibalāviddho'pyetanmaṇḍalapūjanāt // 48
31.d:
पलायन्ते दश दिशः शिवः साक्षात्प्रसीदति ।
मन्दशक्तिबलाविद्धोऽप्येतन्मण्डलपूजनात् ॥ 48
31.m:
flee into the ten directions, and Śiva becomes visibly gracious.
Even one affected by weak power, by worshiping this maṇḍala // 48

31.s:
satataṃ māsaṣaṭkena trikajñānaṃ samaśnute /
yatprāpya heyopādeyaṃ svayameva vicārya saḥ // 49
31.d:
सततं मासषट्केन त्रिकज्ञानं समश्नुते ।
यत्प्राप्य हेयोपादेयं स्वयमेव विचार्य सः ॥ 49
31.m:
continually for six months attains the knowledge of the Trika.
Having attained that, discerning on his own what is to be abandoned and what is to be embraced, // 49

31.s:
dehānte syādbhairavātmā siddhikāmo'tha siddhyati /
maṇḍalasyāsya yo vyāptiṃ devatānyāsameva ca // 50
31.d:
देहान्ते स्याद्भैरवात्मा सिद्धिकामोऽथ सिद्ध्यति ।
मण्डलस्यास्य यो व्याप्तिं देवतान्यासमेव च ॥ 50
31.m:
at the end of the body he becomes of the nature of Bhairava, or if desiring spiritual accomplishments, he succeeds.
He who knows the pervasion of this maṇḍala, the installation of its deities, // 50

31.s:
vartanāṃ ca vijānāti sa gurustrikaśāsane /
tasya pādarajo mūrdhni dhāryaṃ śivasamīhinā // 51
31.d:
वर्तनां च विजानाति स गुरुस्त्रिकशासने ।
तस्य पादरजो मूर्ध्नि धार्यं शिवसमीहिना ॥ 51
31.m:
and its drawing, is a guru in the Trika teaching;
the dust of his feet should be placed upon the head by one who aspires to Śiva. // 51

31.s:
atra sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsān kramāt trīnapi pūjayet /
turyaṃ tu madhyato yadvā sarveṣu paripūrakam // 52
31.d:
अत्र सृष्टिस्थितिध्वंसान् क्रमात् त्रीनपि पूजयेत् ।
तुर्यं तु मध्यतो यद्वा सर्वेषु परिपूरकम् ॥ 52
31.m:
Here one should worship in succession the three: emanation, stasis, and dissolution;
or the fourth in the center, which fills all [three]. // 52

31.s:
catustriśūlaṃ vā guptadaṇḍaṃ yāgaṃ samācaret /
tatra tat pūjayetsamyak sphuṭaṃ kramacatuṣṭayam // 53
31.d:
चतुस्त्रिशूलं वा गुप्तदण्डं यागं समाचरेत् ।
तत्र तत् पूजयेत्सम्यक् स्फुटं क्रमचतुष्टयम् ॥ 53
31.m:
Or one may perform the sacrifice [having] four tridents or a hidden shaft;
there one should properly worship that distinct fourfold cycle. // 53

31.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ gupte ṣaḍardhahṛdaye pare /
ṣaṭke proktaṃ sūcitaṃ śrīsiddhayogīśvarīmate // 54
31.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं गुप्ते षडर्धहृदये परे ।
षट्के प्रोक्तं सूचितं श्रीसिद्धयोगीश्वरीमते ॥ 54
31.m:
Thus this has been taught in the secret, supreme Heart of the Trika,
proclaimed in the Shaṭka, and indicated in the Siddhayogīśvarīmata. // 54

31.s:
agrataḥ sūtrayitvā tu maṇḍalaṃ sarvakāmadam /
mahāśūlasamopetaṃ padmacakrādibhūṣitam // 55
31.d:
अग्रतः सूत्रयित्वा तु मण्डलं सर्वकामदम् ।
महाशूलसमोपेतं पद्मचक्रादिभूषितम् ॥ 55
31.m:
Having first laid out with threads the maṇḍala that grants all desires,
provided with a great trident and adorned with lotuses, wheels, and the like, // 55

31.s:
dvāre dvāre likhecchūlaṃ varjayitvā tu paścimam /
koṇeṣvapica vā kāryaṃ mahāśūlaṃ drumānvitam // 56
31.d:
द्वारे द्वारे लिखेच्छूलं वर्जयित्वा तु पश्चिमम् ।
कोणेष्वपिच वा कार्यं महाशूलं द्रुमान्वितम् ॥ 56
31.m:
at every door one should draw a trident, leaving aside the western one;
or in the corners a great trident accompanied by trees should be made. // 56

31.s:
amṛtāmbhobhavārīṇāṃ śūlāgre tu trikaṃ trikam /
śūla itthaṃ prakartavyamaṣṭadhā tat tridhāpivā // 57
31.d:
अमृताम्भोभवारीणां शूलाग्रे तु त्रिकं त्रिकम् ।
शूल इत्थं प्रकर्तव्यमष्टधा तत् त्रिधापिवा ॥ 57
31.m:
On the tip of the trident of nectar, water, fire, and wind, there is a triad each.
In this way the trident is to be made eightfold, or threefold. // 57

31.s:
evaṃ saṃsūcitaṃ divyaṃ khecarīṇāṃ puraṃ tviti /
sthānāntare'pi kathitaṃ śrīsiddhātantraśāsane // 58
31.d:
एवं संसूचितं दिव्यं खेचरीणां पुरं त्विति ।
स्थानान्तरेऽपि कथितं श्रीसिद्धातन्त्रशासने ॥ 58
31.m:
Thus has the divine city of the khecarīs been indicated.
It is also described in another passage in the teaching of the Siddhātantra: // 58

31.s:
kajaṃ madhye tadardhena śūlaśṛṅgāṇi tāni tu /
śūlāṅkaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kalpyaṃ kamalāṅkaṃ ca pūraṇe // 59
31.d:
कजं मध्ये तदर्धेन शूलशृङ्गाणि तानि तु ।
शूलाङ्कं मण्डलं कल्प्यं कमलाङ्कं च पूरणे ॥ 59
31.m:
A lotus in the middle, and by half of that are those trident prongs;
the maṇḍala is to be designed marked by tridents, and marked by lotuses in filling. // 59

31.s:
atha śūlābjavinyāsaḥ śrīpūrve triśiromate /
siddhātantre trikakule devyāyāmalamālayoḥ // 60
31.d:
अथ शूलाब्जविन्यासः श्रीपूर्वे त्रिशिरोमते ।
सिद्धातन्त्रे त्रिककुले देव्यायामलमालयोः ॥ 60
31.m:
Now the arrangement of the trident and the lotus as taught in the Mālinīvijayottara, in the Triśiromata,
in the Siddhātantra, in the Trikakula, in the Devyāyāmala and the Mālayāmala, // 60

31.s:
yathoktaḥ sāraśāstre ca tantrasadbhāvaguhyayoḥ /
tathā pradarśyate spaṣṭaṃ yadyapyuktakramādgataḥ // 61
31.d:
यथोक्तः सारशास्त्रे च तन्त्रसद्भावगुह्ययोः ।
तथा प्रदर्श्यते स्पष्टं यद्यप्युक्तक्रमाद्गतः ॥ 61
31.m:
and in the Sāraśāstra, Tantrasadbhāva, and Guhyatantra,
is clearly set forth, even though it follows the already stated method. // 61

31.s:
vedāśrite trihaste prāk pūrvamardha vibhājayet /
hastārdhaṃ sarvatastyaktvā pūrvodagyāmyadiggatam // 62
31.d:
वेदाश्रिते त्रिहस्ते प्राक् पूर्वमर्ध विभाजयेत् ।
हस्तार्धं सर्वतस्त्यक्त्वा पूर्वोदग्याम्यदिग्गतम् ॥ 62
31.m:
On a square ground measuring three cubits, one should first divide the eastern half,
leaving aside half a cubit on all sides: east, north, and south. // 62

31.s:
tryaṅgulaiḥ koṣṭhakairūrdhvaistiryak cāṣṭadvidhātmakaiḥ /
dvau dvau bhāgau parityajya punardakṣiṇasaumyagau // 63
31.d:
त्र्यङ्गुलैः कोष्ठकैरूर्ध्वैस्तिर्यक् चाष्टद्विधात्मकैः ।
द्वौ द्वौ भागौ परित्यज्य पुनर्दक्षिणसौम्यगौ ॥ 63
31.m:
With squares of three digits vertically and across, consisting of two times eight,
leaving aside two units each on the southern and northern sides, // 63

31.s:
brahmaṇaḥ pārśvayorjīvāccaturthāt pūrvatastathā /
bhāgārdhabhāgamānaṃ tu khaṇḍacandradvayaṃ dvayam // 64
31.d:
ब्रह्मणः पार्श्वयोर्जीवाच्चतुर्थात् पूर्वतस्तथा ।
भागार्धभागमानं तु खण्डचन्द्रद्वयं द्वयम् ॥ 64
31.m:
on both sides of the central axis, from the fourth chord toward the east,
two crescents each, measuring half a unit, [are drawn]. // 64

31.s:
tayorantastṛtīye tu dakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ /
jīve khaṇḍenduyugalaṃ kuryādantarbhramādbudhaḥ // 65
31.d:
तयोरन्तस्तृतीये तु दक्षिणोत्तरपार्श्वयोः ।
जीवे खण्डेन्दुयुगलं कुर्यादन्तर्भ्रमाद्बुधः ॥ 65
31.m:
Inside the two, on the third chord on the southern and northern sides,
the wise practitioner should draw a pair of crescents by curving inward. // 65

31.s:
tayoraparamarmasthaṃ khaṇḍendudvayakoṭigam /
bahirmukhaṃ bhramaṃ kuryāt khaṇḍacandradvayaṃ dvayam // 66
31.d:
तयोरपरमर्मस्थं खण्डेन्दुद्वयकोटिगम् ।
बहिर्मुखं भ्रमं कुर्यात् खण्डचन्द्रद्वयं द्वयम् ॥ 66
31.m:
Situated at another junction of those two, reaching the tips of the two crescents,
he should make an outward-facing curve, [forming] two crescents each. // 66

31.s:
tadvadbrahmaṇi kurvīta bhāgabhāgārdhasaṃmitam /
tato dvitīyabhāgānte brahmaṇaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ // 67
31.d:
तद्वद्ब्रह्मणि कुर्वीत भागभागार्धसंमितम् ।
ततो द्वितीयभागान्ते ब्रह्मणः पार्श्वयोर्द्वयोः ॥ 67
31.m: Likewise, one should make [a marking] along the central line measuring half of a part. / Then, at the end of the second part, on both sides of the central line, // 67

31.s:
dve rekhe pūrvage neye bhāgatryaṃśaśame budhaiḥ /
ekārdhendūrdhvakoṭisthaṃ brahmasūtrāgrasaṅgatam // 68
31.d:
द्वे रेखे पूर्वगे नेये भागत्र्यंशशमे बुधैः ।
एकार्धेन्दूर्ध्वकोटिस्थं ब्रह्मसूत्राग्रसङ्गतम् ॥ 68
31.m: the wise should draw two lines running eastward, equal to one-third of a part. / Situated at the upper tip of one crescent, joined to the front of the central line, // 68

31.s:
sūtradvayaṃ prakurvīta madhyaśṛṅgaprasiddhaye /
tadagrapārśvayorjīvāt sūtramekāntare dhṛtam // 69
31.d:
सूत्रद्वयं प्रकुर्वीत मध्यशृङ्गप्रसिद्धये ।
तदग्रपार्श्वयोर्जीवात् सूत्रमेकान्तरे धृतम् ॥ 69
31.m: one should place two threads in order to produce the central prong. / Held from the chord at the sides of its tip, with one interval between them, // 69

31.s:
ādidvitīyakhaṇḍendukoṇāt koṇāntamānayet /
tayorevāparājjīvāt prathamārdhendukoṇataḥ // 70
31.d:
आदिद्वितीयखण्डेन्दुकोणात् कोणान्तमानयेत् ।
तयोरेवापराज्जीवात् प्रथमार्धेन्दुकोणतः ॥ 70
31.m: one should draw [a thread] from the corner of the first and second crescent to the end of the [next] corner. / From the other chord of those two, and from the corner of the first crescent, // 70

31.s:
tadvadeva nayetsūtraṃ śṛṅgadvitayasiddhaye /
kṣetrārdhe cāpare daṇḍo dvikaraśchannapañcakaḥ // 71
31.d:
तद्वदेव नयेत्सूत्रं शृङ्गद्वितयसिद्धये ।
क्षेत्रार्धे चापरे दण्डो द्विकरश्छन्नपञ्चकः ॥ 71
31.m: one should draw a thread in the very same way, to produce the pair of [outer] prongs. / In the other half of the diagram is the shaft, two cubits [long], with five covered [parts]. // 71

31.s:
ṣaḍvistṛtaṃ caturdīrghaṃ tadadho'malasārakam /
vedāṅgulaṃ ca tadadho mūlaṃ tīkṣṇāgramiṣyate // 72
31.d:
षड्विस्तृतं चतुर्दीर्घं तदधोऽमलसारकम् ।
वेदाङ्गुलं च तदधो मूलं तीक्ष्णाग्रमिष्यते ॥ 72
31.m: Six [digits] broad and four long, beneath it is an āmalaka fruit; / and beneath that, four digits [long], the base is intended to have a sharp tip. // 72

31.s:
ādikṣetrasya kurvīta dikṣu dvāracatuṣṭayam /
hastāyāmaṃ tadardhaṃ vā vistārādapi tatsamam // 73
31.d:
आदिक्षेत्रस्य कुर्वीत दिक्षु द्वारचतुष्टयम् ।
हस्तायामं तदर्धं वा विस्तारादपि तत्समम् ॥ 73
31.m: In the directions of the initial diagram, one should make four doors, / one cubit in length or half of that, and equal to that in width. // 73

31.s:
dviguṇaṃ bāhyataḥ kuryāttataḥ padmaṃ yathā śṛṇu /
ekaikabhāgamānāni kuryādvṛttāni vedavat // 74
31.d:
द्विगुणं बाह्यतः कुर्यात्ततः पद्मं यथा शृणु ।
एकैकभागमानानि कुर्याद्वृत्तानि वेदवत् ॥ 74
31.m: On the outside, one should make [the surrounding space] double [that size]; then hear how the lotus [is made]: / one should draw circles, measuring one part each, four in number. // 74

31.s:
dikṣvaṣṭau punarapyaṣṭau jīvasūtrāṇi ṣoḍaśa /
dvayordvayoḥ punarmadhye tatsaṃkhyātāni pātayet // 75
31.d:
दिक्ष्वष्टौ पुनरप्यष्टौ जीवसूत्राणि षोडश ।
द्वयोर्द्वयोः पुनर्मध्ये तत्संख्यातानि पातयेत् ॥ 75
31.m: Eight [chords] in the directions, and again eight, making sixteen chord-lines; / then, between each pair, one should drop an equal number of [threads]. // 75

31.s:
eṣāṃ tṛtīyavṛttasthaṃ pārśvajīvasamaṃ bhramam /
etadantaṃ prakurvīta tato jīvāgramānayet // 76
31.d:
एषां तृतीयवृत्तस्थं पार्श्वजीवसमं भ्रमम् ।
एतदन्तं प्रकुर्वीत ततो जीवाग्रमानयेत् ॥ 76
31.m: Rotating these on the third circle, equal to the lateral chord, / one should carry [it] to this limit; from there, one should bring out the tip of the chord. // 76

31.s:
yatraiva kutracitsaṅgastatsaṃbandhe sthirīkṛte /
tatra kṛtvā nayenmantrī patrāgrāṇāṃ prasiddhaye // 77
31.d:
यत्रैव कुत्रचित्सङ्गस्तत्संबन्धे स्थिरीकृते ।
तत्र कृत्वा नयेन्मन्त्री पत्राग्राणां प्रसिद्धये ॥ 77
31.m: Wherever there is a junction, once that connection is fixed firmly, / having positioned [the thread] there, the mantrin should extend it to produce the petal tips. // 77

31.s:
ekaikasmindale kuryātkesarāṇāṃ trayaṃ trayam /
dviguṇāṣṭāṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ tadvacchṛṅgakajatrayam // 78
31.d:
एकैकस्मिन्दले कुर्यात्केसराणां त्रयं त्रयम् ।
द्विगुणाष्टाङ्गुलं कार्यं तद्वच्छृङ्गकजत्रयम् ॥ 78
31.m: On each single petal, one should make three filaments. / Likewise, three prongs should be made measuring twice eight digits. // 78

31.s:
karṇikā pītavarṇena mūlamadhyāgrabhedataḥ /
sitaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kāryaṃ kesarajālakam // 79
31.d:
कर्णिका पीतवर्णेन मूलमध्याग्रभेदतः ।
सितं रक्तं तथा पीतं कार्यं केसरजालकम् ॥ 79
31.m: The pericarp is yellow in color; by division into base, middle, and tip, / the net of filaments should be made white, red, and yellow. // 79

31.s:
dalāni śuklavarṇāni prativāraṇayā saha /
pīṭhaṃ tadvaccatuṣkoṇaṃ karṇikārdhasamaṃ bahiḥ // 80
31.d:
दलानि शुक्लवर्णानि प्रतिवारणया सह ।
पीठं तद्वच्चतुष्कोणं कर्णिकार्धसमं बहिः ॥ 80
31.m: The petals are white in color, together with the enclosing border; / the pedestal, likewise four-cornered, is on the outside equal to half the pericarp. // 80

31.s:
sitaraktapītakṛṣṇaistatpādān vahnitaḥ kramāt /
caturbhirapi śṛṅgāṇi tribhirmaṇḍalamiṣyate // 81
31.d:
सितरक्तपीतकृष्णैस्तत्पादान् वह्नितः क्रमात् ।
चतुर्भिरपि शृङ्गाणि त्रिभिर्मण्डलमिष्यते ॥ 81
31.m: Its feet are [colored] with white, red, yellow, and black in succession starting from the fire [corner]; / the prongs are taught with four [colors], and the circle with three. // 81

31.s:
daṇḍaḥ syānnīlaraktena pītamāmalasārakam /
raktaṃ śūlaṃ prakurvīta yattatpūrvaṃ prakalpitam // 82
31.d:
दण्डः स्यान्नीलरक्तेन पीतमामलसारकम् ।
रक्तं शूलं प्रकुर्वीत यत्तत्पूर्वं प्रकल्पितम् ॥ 82
31.m: The shaft should be blue-red, the āmalaka fruit yellow; / one should make the trident red, just as previously conceived. // 82

31.s:
paścāddvārasya pūrveṇa tyaktvāṅgulacatuṣṭayam /
dvāraṃ vedāśri vṛttaṃ vā saṃkīrṇaṃ vā vicitritam // 83
31.d:
पश्चाद्द्वारस्य पूर्वेण त्यक्त्वाङ्गुलचतुष्टयम् ।
द्वारं वेदाश्रि वृत्तं वा संकीर्णं वा विचित्रितम् ॥ 83
31.m: Behind the doorway, leaving four digits towards the east, / [is] the doorway, four-cornered or circular, or mixed and variegated, // 83

31.s:
ekadvitripuraṃ tulyaṃ sāmudgamathavobhayam /
kapolakaṇṭhaśobhopaśobhādibahucitritam // 84
31.d:
एकद्वित्रिपुरं तुल्यं सामुद्गमथवोभयम् ।
कपोलकण्ठशोभोपशोभादिबहुचित्रितम् ॥ 84
31.m: having one, two, or three levels, symmetrical, caskets-shaped or both, / richly decorated with jambs, necking, moldings, and supplementary ornaments, // 84

31.s:
vicitrākārasaṃsthānaṃ vallīsūkṣmagṛhānvitam /
śrīdevyāyāmale tūktaṃ kṣetre vedāśrite sati // 85
31.d:
विचित्राकारसंस्थानं वल्लीसूक्ष्मगृहान्वितम् ।
श्रीदेव्यायामले तूक्तं क्षेत्रे वेदाश्रिते सति ॥ 85
31.m: of varied form and design, furnished with creepers and small pavilions. / Now in the Śrīdevyāyāmala it is taught: when the diagram is four-cornered, // 85

31.s:
ardhaṃ dvādaśadhā kṛtvā tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca tiryajam /
bhāgamekaṃ svapārśvordhvaṃ guruḥ samavatārayet // 86
31.d:
अर्धं द्वादशधा कृत्वा तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च तिर्यजम् ।
भागमेकं स्वपार्श्वोर्ध्वं गुरुः समवतारयेत् ॥ 86
31.m: having divided half into twelve parts transversely and vertically, / the guru should bring down one transverse part upward on his own side. // 86

31.s:
madhyasthaṃ taṃ tribhāgaṃ ca tadante bhramayedubhau /
bhāgamekaṃ parityajya tanmadhye bhramayetpunaḥ // 87
31.d:
मध्यस्थं तं त्रिभागं च तदन्ते भ्रमयेदुभौ ।
भागमेकं परित्यज्य तन्मध्ये भ्रमयेत्पुनः ॥ 87
31.m: And that tripartite section situated in the center—at its end he should rotate both [arcs]; / leaving aside one part, he should again rotate [the line] within it. // 87

31.s:
tṛtīyāṃśordhvato bhrāmyamūrdhvāṃśaṃ yāvadantataḥ /
caturthāṃśāttadūrdhvaṃ tu ūrdhvādho yojayetpunaḥ // 88
31.d:
तृतीयांशोर्ध्वतो भ्राम्यमूर्ध्वांशं यावदन्ततः ।
चतुर्थांशात्तदूर्ध्वं तु ऊर्ध्वाधो योजयेत्पुनः ॥ 88
31.m: Rotating upward from the third part up to the end of the top part, / he should then join from the fourth part upward and downward. // 88

31.s:
tanmānādūrdhvamābhrāmya caturthena niyojayet /
ūrdhvādyojayate sūtraṃ brahmasūtrāvadhi kramāt // 89
31.d:
तन्मानादूर्ध्वमाभ्राम्य चतुर्थेन नियोजयेत् ।
ऊर्ध्वाद्योजयते सूत्रं ब्रह्मसूत्रावधि क्रमात् ॥ 89
31.m: Having rotated upward by that measure, he should join with the fourth; / he joins the thread from above in succession up to the central line. // 89

31.s:
kramādvaipulyataḥ kṛtvā aṃśaṃ vai hrāsayet punaḥ /
ardhabhāgapramāṇastu daṇḍo dviguṇa iṣyate // 90
31.d:
क्रमाद्वैपुल्यतः कृत्वा अंशं वै ह्रासयेत् पुनः ।
अर्धभागप्रमाणस्तु दण्डो द्विगुण इष्यते ॥ 90
31.m: Having executed it according to width in due order, he should again diminish the part; / the shaft, measuring half a part, is prescribed as double [that]. // 90

31.s:
bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ gṛhītvā tu ubhayoratha gocarāt /
bhrāmyaṃ pippalavat patraṃ vartanaiṣā tvadho bhavet // 91
31.d:
भागं भागं गृहीत्वा तु उभयोरथ गोचरात् ।
भ्राम्यं पिप्पलवत् पत्रं वर्तनैषा त्वधो भवेत् ॥ 91
31.m: Taking part by part within the range of both, / one should rotate a pippala-leaf; this turning line should be below. // 91

31.s:
ṣoḍaśāṃśe likhetpadmaṃ dvādaśāṅgulalopanāt /
tadūrdhvaṃ madhyabhāge tu vārijanma samālikhet // 92
31.d:
षोडशांशे लिखेत्पद्मं द्वादशाङ्गुललोपनात् ।
तदूर्ध्वं मध्यभागे तु वारिजन्म समालिखेत् ॥ 92
31.m: One should draw a lotus on the sixteenth part, omitting twelve digits; / above that, in the middle portion, one should draw a lotus. // 92

31.s:
madhyaśṛṅgāvasāne tu tṛtīyaṃ vilikhettataḥ /
savyāsavye tathaiveha kaṭisthābje samālikhet // 93
31.d:
मध्यशृङ्गावसाने तु तृतीयं विलिखेत्ततः ।
सव्यासव्ये तथैवेह कटिस्थाब्जे समालिखेत् ॥ 93
31.m: Then, at the tip of the central prong, one should draw a third [lotus]; / likewise, on the right and left, one should draw lotuses situated at the waist. // 93

31.s:
karṇikā pītalā raktapītaśuklaṃ ca kesaram /
dalāni padmabāhyasthā śuklā ca prativāraṇī // 94
31.d:
कर्णिका पीतला रक्तपीतशुक्लं च केसरम् ।
दलानि पद्मबाह्यस्था शुक्ला च प्रतिवारणी ॥ 94
31.m: The pericarp is yellow, and the filaments are red, yellow, and white; / the petals are on the outside of the lotus, and the outer enclosing border is white. // 94

31.s:
śūlaṃ kṛṣṇena rajasā brahmarekhā sitā punaḥ /
śūlāgraṃ jvālayā yuktaṃ śūladaṇḍastu pītalaḥ // 95
31.d:
शूलं कृष्णेन रजसा ब्रह्मरेखा सिता पुनः ।
शूलाग्रं ज्वालया युक्तं शूलदण्डस्तु पीतलः ॥ 95
31.m: The trident is made with black powder, and the central line is white; / the tip of the trident is endowed with a flame, while the trident-shaft is yellow. // 95

31.s:
śūlamadhye ca yatpadmaṃ tatreśaṃ pūjayetsadā /
asyordhve tu parāṃ dakṣe'nyāṃ vāme cāparāṃ budhaḥ // 96
31.d:
शूलमध्ये च यत्पद्मं तत्रेशं पूजयेत्सदा ।
अस्योर्ध्वे तु परां दक्षेऽन्यां वामे चापरां बुधः ॥ 96
31.m: And on the lotus that is in the middle of the trident, one should always worship the Lord; / above this, the wise [worships] Parā, in the right [another goddess], and in the left Aparā. // 96

31.s:
yā sā kālāntakā devī parātītā vyavasthitā /
grasate śūlacakraṃ sā tvicchāmātreṇa sarvadā // 97
31.d:
या सा कालान्तका देवी परातीता व्यवस्थिता ।
ग्रसते शूलचक्रं सा त्विच्छामात्रेण सर्वदा ॥ 97
31.m: She who is established as the goddess destroying time, transcending the supreme, / constantly devours the trident-mandala by mere will. // 97

31.s:
śāntirūpā kalā hyeṣā vidyārūpā parā bhavet /
aparā tu pratiṣṭhā syānnivṛttistu parāparā // 98
31.d:
शान्तिरूपा कला ह्येषा विद्यारूपा परा भवेत् ।
अपरा तु प्रतिष्ठा स्यान्निवृत्तिस्तु परापरा ॥ 98
31.m: This [goddess] has the form of the Śānti energy; Parā has the form of Vidyā, / Aparā is Pratiṣṭhā, and Parāparā is Nivṛtti. // 98

31.s:
bhairavaṃ daṇḍa ūrdhvasthaṃ rūpaṃ sādāśivātmakam /
catasraḥ śaktayastvasya sthūlāḥ sūkṣmāstvanekadhā // 99
31.d:
भैरवं दण्ड ऊर्ध्वस्थं रूपं सादाशिवात्मकम् ।
चतस्रः शक्तयस्त्वस्य स्थूलाः सूक्ष्मास्त्वनेकधा ॥ 99
31.m: Bhairava is on the shaft, having an upward form consisting of Sadāśiva; / and his four powers are gross, subtle, and manifold. // 99

31.s:
eṣa yāgaḥ samākhyāto ḍāmarākhyastriśaktikaḥ /
atha traiśirase śūlābjavidhirdṛṣṭo'bhilikhyate // 100
31.d:
एष यागः समाख्यातो डामराख्यस्त्रिशक्तिकः ।
अथ त्रैशिरसे शूलाब्जविधिर्दृष्टोऽभिलिख्यते ॥ 100
31.m: This sacrifice designated as Ḍāmara, possessing three powers, has been explained. / Now the procedure for the trident-lotus found in the Traiśirasa is described: // 100

31.s:
vāmāmṛtādibhirmukhyaiḥ pavitraiḥ sumanoramaiḥ /
bhūmiṃ rajāṃsi karaṇīṃ khaṭikāṃ mūlato'rcayet // 101
31.d:
वामामृतादिभिर्मुख्यैः पवित्रैः सुमनोरमैः ।
भूमिं रजांसि करणीं खटिकां मूलतोऽर्चयेत् ॥ 101
31.m: With the foremost, purifying, and delightful substances such as the left-hand nectar, / one should worship the ground, the colored powders, the compass-tool, and the chalk from their root. // 101

31.s:
caturaśre caturhaste madhye śūlaṃ karatrayam /
caṇḍo dvihasta ūrdhvādhaḥpīṭhayugvipulastvasau // 102
31.d:
चतुरश्रे चतुर्हस्ते मध्ये शूलं करत्रयम् ।
चण्डो द्विहस्त ऊर्ध्वाधःपीठयुग्विपुलस्त्वसौ ॥ 102
31.m: In a four-cornered [space] of four cubits, the trident in the middle is three cubits; / the Caṇḍa[-shaft] is two cubits, and it is broad with a pair of pedestals above and below. // 102

31.s:
vasvaṅgulaḥ prakartavyaḥ sūtratrayasamanvitaḥ /
dvādaśāṅgulamānena daṇḍamūle tu pīṭhikā // 103
31.d:
वस्वङ्गुलः प्रकर्तव्यः सूत्रत्रयसमन्वितः ।
द्वादशाङ्गुलमानेन दण्डमूले तु पीठिका ॥ 103
31.m: It should be made eight digits [broad], furnished with three threads; / and at the base of the shaft is a pedestal measuring twelve digits, // 103

31.s:
dairghyāttūcchrāyāccordhve ca caturaṅgulamānataḥ /
ūrdhve'pyucchrāyato vedāṅgulā dairghyāddaśāṅgulā // 104
31.d:
दैर्घ्यात्तूच्छ्रायाच्चोर्ध्वे च चतुरङ्गुलमानतः ।
ऊर्ध्वेऽप्युच्छ्रायतो वेदाङ्गुला दैर्घ्याद्दशाङ्गुला ॥ 104
31.m: in length, and four digits in height; / and above too, four digits in height, and ten digits in length. // 104

31.s:
śūlamūlagataṃ pīṭhīmadhyaṃ khābdhisamāṅgulam /
kṛtvā daṇḍaṃ triśūlaṃ tu tribhirbhāgaiḥ samantataḥ // 105
31.d:
शूलमूलगतं पीठीमध्यं खाब्धिसमाङ्गुलम् ।
कृत्वा दण्डं त्रिशूलं तु त्रिभिर्भागैः समन्ततः ॥ 105
31.m: The middle of the pedestal at the base of the trident is forty digits; / having made the shaft, the trident is [made] all around with three parts. // 105

31.s:
aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇaiḥ syāddhastamātraṃ samantataḥ /
śūlāgraṃ śūlamadhyaṃ tacchūlamūlaṃ tu tadbhavet // 106
31.d:
अष्टाङ्गुलप्रमाणैः स्याद्धस्तमात्रं समन्ततः ।
शूलाग्रं शूलमध्यं तच्छूलमूलं तु तद्भवेत् ॥ 106
31.m: Measuring eight digits each, it should be just one cubit all around; / that should be the trident's tip, the trident's middle, and the trident's base. // 106

31.s:
vedī madhye prakartavyā ubhayośca ṣaḍaṅgulam /
dvādaśāṅguladīrghā tu ubhayoḥ pārśvayostathā // 107
31.d:
वेदी मध्ये प्रकर्तव्या उभयोश्च षडङ्गुलम् ।
द्वादशाङ्गुलदीर्घा तु उभयोः पार्श्वयोस्तथा ॥ 107
31.m: An altar should be made in the middle, and six digits for both; / twelve digits long on both sides as well, // 107

31.s:
caturaṅgulamucchrāyānmūle vedīṃ prakalpayet /
ubhayoḥ pārśvayoścaivamardhacandrākṛtiṃ tathā // 108
31.d:
चतुरङ्गुलमुच्छ्रायान्मूले वेदीं प्रकल्पयेत् ।
उभयोः पार्श्वयोश्चैवमर्धचन्द्राकृतिं तथा ॥ 108
31.m: one should construct an altar at the base, four digits in height; / and likewise on both flanks in the shape of a half-moon, // 108

31.s:
bhrāmayet khaṭikāsūtraṃ kaṭiṃ kuryāddviraṅgulām /
vaipulyāddairghyato devi caturaṅgulamānataḥ // 109
31.d:
भ्रामयेत् खटिकासूत्रं कटिं कुर्याद्द्विरङ्गुलाम् ।
वैपुल्याद्दैर्घ्यतो देवि चतुरङ्गुलमानतः ॥ 109
31.m: one should sweep the chalked cord; one should make the waist two digits / in width, O goddess, and measuring four digits in length. // 109

31.s:
yādṛśaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge vāme tadvatprakalpayet /
madhye śūlāgravaipulyādaṅgulaśca adhordhvataḥ // 110
31.d:
यादृशं दक्षिणे भागे वामे तद्वत्प्रकल्पयेत् ।
मध्ये शूलाग्रवैपुल्यादङ्गुलश्च अधोर्ध्वतः ॥ 110
31.m:
Just as [it is formed] on the right side, one should construct it likewise on the left.
In the middle, from the width of the trident's point, [it is] an inch below and above.

31.s:
caturaṅgulamānena vaipulyāttu ṣaḍaṅgulā /
ucchrāyāttu tataḥ kāryā gaṇḍikā tu svarūpataḥ // 111
31.d:
चतुरङ्गुलमानेन वैपुल्यात्तु षडङ्गुला ।
उच्छ्रायात्तु ततः कार्या गण्डिका तु स्वरूपतः ॥ 111
31.m:
With a measure of four inches, but six inches in width,
the base (gaṇḍikā) should then be made in proper form according to its height.

31.s:
pīṭhordhve tu prakartavyaṃ śūlamūlaṃ tu suvrate /
śūlāgramaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ sutīkṣṇaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulam // 112
31.d:
पीठोर्ध्वे तु प्रकर्तव्यं शूलमूलं तु सुव्रते ।
शूलाग्रमङ्गुलं कार्यं सुतीक्ष्णं तु षडङ्गुलम् ॥ 112
31.m:
Above the pedestal the root of the trident should be made, O lady of good vows;
the tip of the trident should be made one inch [wide], and six inches [long], extremely sharp.

31.s:
arāmadhyaṃ prakartavyamarādhastu ṣaḍaṅgulam /
caturaṅgulanimnaṃ tu madhyaṃ tu parikalpayet // 113
31.d:
अरामध्यं प्रकर्तव्यमराधस्तु षडङ्गुलम् ।
चतुरङ्गुलनिम्नं तु मध्यं तु परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 113
31.m:
The space between the prongs should be made [thus]: below the prongs, [a distance of] six inches,
and one should construct the centre depressed by four inches.

31.s:
pūrvāparaṃ tadeveha madhye śūlaṃ tu tadbahiḥ /
kārayeta tribhiḥ sūtrairekaikaṃ vartayeta ca // 114
31.d:
पूर्वापरं तदेवेह मध्ये शूलं तु तद्बहिः ।
कारयेत त्रिभिः सूत्रैरेकैकं वर्तयेत च ॥ 114
31.m:
That very thing here from east to west [is to be made]; but outside of it is the trident in the middle.
One should have it drawn with three cords, tracing out each one.

31.s:
kajatrayaṃ tu śūlāgraṃ vedāṃśairdvādaśāṅgulam /
kramāddakṣānyamadhyeṣu tryaṣṭadvādaśapatrakam // 115
31.d:
कजत्रयं तु शूलाग्रं वेदांशैर्द्वादशाङ्गुलम् ।
क्रमाद्दक्षान्यमध्येषु त्र्यष्टद्वादशपत्रकम् ॥ 115
31.m:
The three lotus-tips of the trident measure twelve inches by four parts [each];
in order, in the right, the other [left], and middle, they have three, eight, and twelve petals.

31.s:
cakratrayaṃ vātapuraṃ padmamaṣṭāṅgulārakam /
vidyābhikhyaṃ śūlamūle rajaḥ paścātprapātayet // 116
31.d:
चक्रत्रयं वातपुरं पद्ममष्टाङ्गुलारकम् ।
विद्याभिख्यं शूलमूले रजः पश्चात्प्रपातयेत् ॥ 116
31.m:
The triad of wheels [forming] the city of wind is a lotus whose spokes measure eight inches;
at the base of the trident named Vidyā, one should afterwards cast down the powders.

31.s:
triśūlaṃ daṇḍaparyantaṃ rājavartena pūrayet /
sūtratrayasya pṛṣṭhe tu śuklaṃ cārātrayaṃ bhavet // 117
31.d:
त्रिशूलं दण्डपर्यन्तं राजवर्तेन पूरयेत् ।
सूत्रत्रयस्य पृष्ठे तु शुक्लं चारात्रयं भवेत् ॥ 117
31.m:
One should fill the trident up to the shaft with lapis lazuli;
and behind the three cords, the triad of prongs should be white.

31.s:
śuklena rajasā śūlamūle vidyāmbujaṃ bhavet /
raktaṃ raktāsitaṃ śuklaṃ kramādūrdhvāmbujatrayam // 118
31.d:
शुक्लेन रजसा शूलमूले विद्याम्बुजं भवेत् ।
रक्तं रक्तासितं शुक्लं क्रमादूर्ध्वाम्बुजत्रयम् ॥ 118
31.m:
With white powder the Vidyā lotus at the root of the trident should be made;
the triad of upper lotuses should be, in order, red, red-black, and white.

31.s:
śuklena vyomarekhā syāt sā sthaulyādaṅgulaṃ bahiḥ /
tāṃ tyaktvā vedikā kāryā hastamātraṃ pramāṇātaḥ // 119
31.d:
शुक्लेन व्योमरेखा स्यात् सा स्थौल्यादङ्गुलं बहिः ।
तां त्यक्त्वा वेदिका कार्या हस्तमात्रं प्रमाणातः ॥ 119
31.m:
The sky-line should be white, one inch in thickness outside [the design];
leaving that aside, a dais should be made, measuring a cubit [in extent].

31.s:
vaipulyatriguṇaṃ dairghyāt prākāraṃ caturaśrakam /
samantato'tha dikṣu syurdvārāṇi karamātrataḥ // 120
31.d:
वैपुल्यत्रिगुणं दैर्घ्यात् प्राकारं चतुरश्रकम् ।
समन्ततोऽथ दिक्षु स्युर्द्वाराणि करमात्रतः ॥ 120
31.m:
The square enclosure wall should be three times the width in length;
all around in the cardinal directions there should be doorways measuring one cubit.

31.s:
tridhā vibhajya kramaśo dvādaśāṅgulamānataḥ /
kaṇṭhaṃ kapolaṃ śobhāṃ tu upaśobhāṃ tadantataḥ // 121
31.d:
त्रिधा विभज्य क्रमशो द्वादशाङ्गुलमानतः ।
कण्ठं कपोलं शोभां तु उपशोभां तदन्ततः ॥ 121
31.m:
Dividing [it] into three parts in succession, by a measure of twelve inches [each],
[one forms] the neck, the cheek, the ornament, and the subsidiary ornament at the end.

31.s:
prākāraṃ caturaśraṃ tu sabhūrekhāsamanvitam /
sitaraktapītakṛṣṇai rajobhiḥ kārayettataḥ // 122
31.d:
प्राकारं चतुरश्रं तु सभूरेखासमन्वितम् ।
सितरक्तपीतकृष्णै रजोभिः कारयेत्ततः ॥ 122
31.m:
The square enclosure, provided with the ground-line,
one should then execute with white, red, yellow, and black powders.

31.s:
raktai rajobhirmadhyaṃ tu yathāśobhaṃ tu pūrayet /
asyā vyāptau purā coktaṃ tatraivānusarecca tat // 123
31.d:
रक्तै रजोभिर्मध्यं तु यथाशोभं तु पूरयेत् ।
अस्या व्याप्तौ पुरा चोक्तं तत्रैवानुसरेच्च तत् ॥ 123
31.m:
One should fill the middle with red powders so as to be beautiful;
concerning its pervasion, it was explained before, and one should follow that very procedure there.

31.s:
arātrayavibhāgastu praveśo nirgamo bhramaḥ /
anāhatapadavyāptiḥ kuṇḍalyā udayaḥ paraḥ // 124
31.d:
अरात्रयविभागस्तु प्रवेशो निर्गमो भ्रमः ।
अनाहतपदव्याप्तिः कुण्डल्या उदयः परः ॥ 124
31.m:
The division of the triad of prongs consists of entrance, exit, and circulation;
[it is] the pervasion of the unblemished state, the supreme rising of Kuṇḍalinī.

31.s:
hṛdi sthāne gatā devyastriśūlasya sumadhyame /
nābhisthaḥ śūladaṇḍastu śūlamūlaṃ hṛdi sthitam // 125
31.d:
हृदि स्थाने गता देव्यस्त्रिशूलस्य सुमध्यमे ।
नाभिस्थः शूलदण्डस्तु शूलमूलं हृदि स्थितम् ॥ 125
31.m:
The goddesses of the trident reside in the location of the heart, O woman of slender waist;
the shaft of the trident is located at the navel, and the root of the trident abides in the heart.

31.s:
śaktisthānagataṃ prāntaṃ prānte cakratrayaṃ smaret /
utkṣipyotkṣipya kalayā dehamadhyasvarūpataḥ // 126
31.d:
शक्तिस्थानगतं प्रान्तं प्रान्ते चक्रत्रयं स्मरेत् ।
उत्क्षिप्योत्क्षिप्य कलया देहमध्यस्वरूपतः ॥ 126
31.m:
Its tip reaches the locus of Śakti; at the tip one should contemplate the triad of wheels,
raising [the breath] repeatedly by the part, according to the nature of the centre of the body.

31.s:
śūladaṇḍāntamadhyasthaśūlamadhyāntagocaram /
praviśenmūlamadhyāntaṃ prāntānte śaktiveśmani // 127
31.d:
शूलदण्डान्तमध्यस्थशूलमध्यान्तगोचरम् ।
प्रविशेन्मूलमध्यान्तं प्रान्तान्ते शक्तिवेश्मनि ॥ 127
31.m:
Reaching the end of the shaft of the trident, the middle, and the end of the middle prong,
one should enter from the base to the middle and the top, into the abode of Śakti at the very end.

31.s:
aspandakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ekadā spandavartanam /
mūlamānandamāpīḍya śaktitrayapadaṃ viśet // 128
31.d:
अस्पन्दकरणं कृत्वा एकदा स्पन्दवर्तनम् ।
मूलमानन्दमापीड्य शक्तित्रयपदं विशेत् ॥ 128
31.m:
Having produced the unmoving instrument, and then a single revolving movement of pulsation,
pressing firmly upon the base of bliss, one should enter the plane of the three powers.

31.s:
tatra pūjyaṃ prayatnena jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥ /
samastādhvasamāyogāt ṣoḍhādhvavyāptibhāvataḥ // 129
31.d:
तत्र पूज्यं प्रयत्नेन जायन्ते सर्वसिद्धयः ।
समस्ताध्वसमायोगात् षोढाध्वव्याप्तिभावतः ॥ 129
31.m:
Worship should be performed there with effort; all spiritual accomplishments arise [there],
because of the conjunction of the entire path, through contemplating the pervasion of the sixfold path.

31.s:
samastamantracakrādyairevamādiprayatnataḥ /
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvaracitaṃ triśūlaṃ paribhāvayet // 130
31.d:
समस्तमन्त्रचक्राद्यैरेवमादिप्रयत्नतः ।
षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वरचितं त्रिशूलं परिभावयेत् ॥ 130
31.m:
With all the arrays of mantras and the like, through such effort as this,
one should contemplate the trident composed of the thirty-six principles of reality.

31.s:
viṣuvatsthena vinyāso mantrāṇāṃ maṇḍalottame /
kāryo'smin pūjite yatra sarveśvarapadaṃ bhajet // 131
31.d:
विषुवत्स्थेन विन्यासो मन्त्राणां मण्डलोत्तमे ।
कार्योऽस्मिन् पूजिते यत्र सर्वेश्वरपदं भजेत् ॥ 131
31.m:
The placement of mantras within this supreme maṇḍala should be performed by one stationed in the equinox;
when this is worshipped, one attains the state of the Lord of All.

31.s:
svastikenātha kartavyaṃ yuktaṃ tasyocyate vidhiḥ /
nāḍikāḥ sthāpayetpūrvaṃ muhūrtaṃ parimāṇataḥ // 132
31.d:
स्वस्तिकेनाथ कर्तव्यं युक्तं तस्योच्यते विधिः ।
नाडिकाः स्थापयेत्पूर्वं मुहूर्तं परिमाणतः ॥ 132
31.m:
Then [the maṇḍala] equipped with svastikas is to be constructed; its rule is now explained:
one should first establish channels measuring a muhūrta [thirty] in extent.

31.s:
śakravāruṇadiksthāśca yāmyasaumyagatāstathā /
ekonatriṃśadvaṃśāḥ syurṛjutiryaggatāstathā // 133
31.d:
शक्रवारुणदिक्स्थाश्च याम्यसौम्यगतास्तथा ।
एकोनत्रिंशद्वंशाः स्युरृजुतिर्यग्गतास्तथा ॥ 133
31.m:
Lines situated in the directions of Indra [east] and Varuṇa [west], and likewise those going south and north:
there should be twenty-nine lines running straight and crosswise.

31.s:
aṣṭau marmaśatānyekacatvāriṃśacca jāyate /
vaṃśairviṣayasaṃkhyaiśca padmaṃ yugmendumaṇḍalam // 134
31.d:
अष्टौ मर्मशतान्येकचत्वारिंशच्च जायते ।
वंशैर्विषयसंख्यैश्च पद्मं युग्मेन्दुमण्डलम् ॥ 134
31.m:
Eight hundred and forty-one intersections (marman) are produced;
with lines numbering the senses [five], the lotus has a circle of fourteen [parts].

31.s:
rasasaṃkhyairbhavetpīṭhaṃ svastikaṃ sarvakāmadam /
vasusaṃkhyairdvāravīthāvevaṃ bhāgaparikramaḥ // 135
31.d:
रससंख्यैर्भवेत्पीठं स्वस्तिकं सर्वकामदम् ।
वसुसंख्यैर्द्वारवीथावेवं भागपरिक्रमः ॥ 135
31.m:
With lines numbering six, the pedestal is a svastika granting all desires;
with eight lines in the doorway street: such is the sequence of divisions.

31.s:
randhravipraśarāgnīṃśca lupyedbāhyāntaraṃ kramāt /
marmāṇi ca caturdikṣu madhyāddvāreṣu sundari // 136
31.d:
रन्ध्रविप्रशराग्नींश्च लुप्येद्बाह्यान्तरं क्रमात् ।
मर्माणि च चतुर्दिक्षु मध्याद्द्वारेषु सुन्दरि ॥ 136
31.m:
One should erase nine, one, five, and three [intersections] in order, from outside to inside;
and the intersections in the four directions from the centre to the doorways, O beautiful lady.

31.s:
vahnibhūtamunivyomabāhyagarbhe purīṣu ca /
lopayeccaiva marmāṇi antarnāḍivivarjitān // 137
31.d:
वह्निभूतमुनिव्योमबाह्यगर्भे पुरीषु च ।
लोपयेच्चैव मर्माणि अन्तर्नाडिविवर्जितान् ॥ 137
31.m:
In the fire [three], elements [five], sages [seven], and sky [zero], in the outer core and in the enclosures,
one should erase the intersections, excluding the inner channels.

31.s:
dvāraprākārakoṇeṣu netrānalaśarānṛtūn /
nāḍayo brahmavaṃśasya lopyā netrādrasasthitāḥ // 138
31.d:
द्वारप्राकारकोणेषु नेत्रानलशरानृतून् ।
नाडयो ब्रह्मवंशस्य लोप्या नेत्राद्रसस्थिताः ॥ 138
31.m:
At the corners of the doorways and wall: two, three, five, and six;
the channels of the central Brahma-line should be erased from two to six.

31.s:
vahnernetrānalau lopyau vedānnetrayugaṃ rasāt /
netraṃ saumyagataṃ lopyaṃ pūrvādvedānalau rasāt // 139
31.d:
वह्नेर्नेत्रानलौ लोप्यौ वेदान्नेत्रयुगं रसात् ।
नेत्रं सौम्यगतं लोप्यं पूर्वाद्वेदानलौ रसात् ॥ 139
31.m:
From fire [three], two and three are to be erased; from four, a pair of twos; from six,
two going north is to be erased; from the east, four and three from six.

31.s:
lokasthā nāḍikā hitvā netrādvedāgnayaḥ kramāt /
śarairvahnigataṃ caiva yugaṃ netrāgnayo rasāt // 140
31.d:
लोकस्था नाडिका हित्वा नेत्राद्वेदाग्नयः क्रमात् ।
शरैर्वह्निगतं चैव युगं नेत्राग्नयो रसात् ॥ 140
31.m:
Leaving aside the channel stationed in the world, from two [erase] four and three in succession;
with five, that going to fire, and four; two and three from six.

31.s:
netrāt pūrvagatāccaiva sumerurdvārasaṃjñitaḥ /
svastikā ca purī ramyā caturdikṣu sthitāvubhau // 141
31.d:
नेत्रात् पूर्वगताच्चैव सुमेरुर्द्वारसंज्ञितः ।
स्वस्तिका च पुरी रम्या चतुर्दिक्षु स्थितावुभौ ॥ 141
31.m:
From two, and from that going east, [arises] the Sumeru named the doorway,
and the charming city of Svastikā; both are situated in the four directions.

31.s:
marmaṇāṃ ca śate dve ca ṛṣibhirguṇitā diśaḥ /
netrādikāṃśca saṃmārjya mārgamadhyāt suśobhane // 142
31.d:
मर्मणां च शते द्वे च ऋषिभिर्गुणिता दिशः ।
नेत्रादिकांश्च संमार्ज्य मार्गमध्यात् सुशोभने ॥ 142
31.m:
And two hundred intersections, multiplied by seven across the directions;
wiping away from two onwards from the middle of the path, O fair one,

31.s:
ṛṣitrayakṛte madhye viṣayaiḥ karṇikā bhavet /
netrīkṛtānvasūn patraṃ netraṃ sakṛdvibhājitam // 143
31.d:
ऋषित्रयकृते मध्ये विषयैः कर्णिका भवेत् ।
नेत्रीकृतान्वसून् पत्रं नेत्रं सकृद्विभाजितम् ॥ 143
31.m:
in the middle made of three sages [twenty-one], the pericarp consists of five;
the petals are eight made into two [sixteen]; two is divided once.

31.s:
vahniṃ vasugataṃ kṛtvā śaśāṅkasthāṃśca lopayet /
vahnīṣuṛṣimadhyācca lopyaṃ pīṭhendukāvadhi // 144
31.d:
वह्निं वसुगतं कृत्वा शशाङ्कस्थांश्च लोपयेत् ।
वह्नीषुऋषिमध्याच्च लोप्यं पीठेन्दुकावधि ॥ 144
31.m:
Placing three in eight, one should erase those located in the moon [one];
and from the middle of three, five, and seven, one should erase up to the moon of the pedestal.

31.s:
brahmaṇo netraviṣayānnetrādvedānalau haret /
sāgare netrakaṃ lopyaṃ nāḍayaḥ pūrvadiggatāḥ // 145
31.d:
ब्रह्मणो नेत्रविषयान्नेत्राद्वेदानलौ हरेत् ।
सागरे नेत्रकं लोप्यं नाडयः पूर्वदिग्गताः ॥ 145
31.m:
From the central line [erase] two and five; from two, remove four and three;
in the ocean [four], two is to be erased; [these are] the channels going to the eastern direction.

31.s:
bhūtanetragatānmūrdhnā netrāddvivahnidṛktrikāt /
saumyagāt pīṭhakoṇeṣu lopayeta caturṣvapi // 146
31.d:
भूतनेत्रगतान्मूर्ध्ना नेत्राद्द्विवह्निदृक्त्रिकात् ।
सौम्यगात् पीठकोणेषु लोपयेत चतुर्ष्वपि ॥ 146
31.m:
In the five and two [sectors] through the top, from two, and from the triad of two, three, and two,
going northward, one should erase in all four corners of the pedestal.

31.s:
dalāni kāryāṇi sitaiḥ kesaraṃ raktapītalaiḥ /
karṇikā kanakaprakhyā pallavāntāśca lohitāḥ // 147
31.d:
दलानि कार्याणि सितैः केसरं रक्तपीतलैः ।
कर्णिका कनकप्रख्या पल्लवान्ताश्च लोहिताः ॥ 147
31.m:
The petals should be made with white [powders], the filaments with red and yellow;
the pericarp shines like gold, and the leaf-tips are red.

31.s:
vyomarekhā tu susitā vartulābjāntanīlabhāḥ /
pīṭhaṃ rekhātrayopetaṃ sitalohitapītalam // 148
31.d:
व्योमरेखा तु सुसिता वर्तुलाब्जान्तनीलभाः ।
पीठं रेखात्रयोपेतं सितलोहितपीतलम् ॥ 148
31.m:
The sky-line is pure white, circular, possessing a blue radiance at the end of the lotus;
the pedestal is endowed with three lines, white, red, and yellow.

31.s:
svastikāśca caturvarṇā agnerīśānagocarāḥ /
vīthī vidrumasaṃkāśā svadikṣvastrāṇi bāhyataḥ // 149
31.d:
स्वस्तिकाश्च चतुर्वर्णा अग्नेरीशानगोचराः ।
वीथी विद्रुमसंकाशा स्वदिक्ष्वस्त्राणि बाह्यतः ॥ 149
31.m:
The svastikas have four colours, extending from the southeast (Agni) to the northeast (Īśāna);
the street resembles coral; the weapons are placed outside in their own directions:

31.s:
indranīlanibhaṃ vajraṃ śaktiṃ padmamaṇiprabhām /
daṇḍaṃ hāṭakasaṃkāśaṃ vaktraṃ tasyātilohitam // 150
31.d:
इन्द्रनीलनिभं वज्रं शक्तिं पद्ममणिप्रभाम् ।
दण्डं हाटकसंकाशं वक्त्रं तस्यातिलोहितम् ॥ 150
31.m:
the vajra resembling a sapphire, the śakti with the lustre of a lotus-gem,
the staff resembling gold with its tip exceedingly red,

31.s:
nīladyutisamaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ vatsakasaprabham /
dhvajaṃ puṣpaphalopetaṃ pañcaraṅgaiśca śobhitam // 151
31.d:
नीलद्युतिसमं खड्गं पाशं वत्सकसप्रभम् ।
ध्वजं पुष्पफलोपेतं पञ्चरङ्गैश्च शोभितम् ॥ 151
31.m:
the sword equal in lustre to lapis lazuli, the noose having the brilliance of a pearl,
the banner furnished with flowers and fruits and adorned with five colours,

31.s:
gadā hemanibhātyugrā nānāratnavibhūṣitā /
śūlaṃ nīlāmbujasamaṃ jvaladvahnyugraśekharam // 152
31.d:
गदा हेमनिभात्युग्रा नानारत्नविभूषिता ।
शूलं नीलाम्बुजसमं ज्वलद्वह्न्युग्रशेखरम् ॥ 152
31.m:
the club resembling gold, extremely fierce, decorated with various jewels,
the trident resembling a blue lotus with an intensely blazing fire at its crest.

31.s:
tasyopari sitaṃ padmamīṣatpītāruṇaprabham /
cakraṃ hemanibhaṃ dīptamarā vaiḍūryasaṃnibhāḥ // 153
31.d:
तस्योपरि सितं पद्ममीषत्पीतारुणप्रभम् ।
चक्रं हेमनिभं दीप्तमरा वैडूर्यसंनिभाः ॥ 153
31.m:
Above it is a white lotus with a slightly yellowish-red lustre;
the wheel resembles gold, radiant, its spokes resembling cat's-eye gem.

31.s:
arāmadhyaṃ supītaṃ ca bāhyaṃ jvālāruṇaṃ bhavet /
mandiraṃ devadevasya sarvakāmaphalapradam // 154
31.d:
अरामध्यं सुपीतं च बाह्यं ज्वालारुणं भवेत् ।
मन्दिरं देवदेवस्य सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥ 154
31.m:
The centre of the spokes should be deep yellow, and the exterior red like a flame;
[this is] the temple of the God of gods, granting the fruit of all desires.

31.s:
śrīsiddhāyāṃ śūlavidhiḥ prāk kṣetre caturaśrite /
hastamātraṃ tridhā sūryānnavakhaṇḍaṃ yathā bhavet // 155
31.d:
श्रीसिद्धायां शूलविधिः प्राक् क्षेत्रे चतुरश्रिते ।
हस्तमात्रं त्रिधा सूर्यान्नवखण्डं यथा भवेत् ॥ 155
31.m: In the venerable Siddhā[mata], the rule for the trident [is as follows]: first, on a four-cornered field, / one cubit in measure, [divide it] threefold from the suns so that it becomes nine divisions. // 155

31.s:
madhye śūlaṃ ca tatretthaṃ madhyabhāgaṃ tridhā bhajet /
navabhiḥ koṣṭhakairyuktaṃ tato'yaṃ vidhirucyate // 156
31.d:
मध्ये शूलं च तत्रेत्थं मध्यभागं त्रिधा भजेत् ।
नवभिः कोष्ठकैर्युक्तं ततोऽयं विधिरुच्यते ॥ 156
31.m: And in the middle of it, the trident: thus one should divide the middle part threefold. / When it is endowed with nine squares, then this procedure is stated: // 156

31.s:
madhyabhāgatrayaṃ tyaktvā madhye bhāgadvayasya tu /
adhastādbhrāmayetsūtraṃ śaśāṅkaśakalākṛti // 157
31.d:
मध्यभागत्रयं त्यक्त्वा मध्ये भागद्वयस्य तु ।
अधस्ताद्भ्रामयेत्सूत्रं शशाङ्कशकलाकृति ॥ 157
31.m: Omitting the three middle parts, in the middle of the two parts, however, / below, one should draw a cord in the shape of a crescent moon. // 157

31.s:
ubhayato bhrāmayettatra yathāgre hākṛtirbhavet /
koṭyāṃ tatra kṛtaṃ sūtraṃ nayedrekhāṃ tu pūrvikām // 158
31.d:
उभयतो भ्रामयेत्तत्र यथाग्रे हाकृतिर्भवेत् ।
कोट्यां तत्र कृतं सूत्रं नयेद्रेखां तु पूर्विकाम् ॥ 158
31.m: One should trace it on both sides there so that at the tip it assumes the shape of [the letter] ha; / bringing the cord made there at the point, he should draw the first line. // 158

31.s:
aparadvārapūrveṇa tyaktvāṅgulacatuṣṭayam /
rekhāṃ vināśayetprājño yathā śūlākṛtirbhavet // 159
31.d:
अपरद्वारपूर्वेण त्यक्त्वाङ्गुलचतुष्टयम् ।
रेखां विनाशयेत्प्राज्ञो यथा शूलाकृतिर्भवेत् ॥ 159
31.m: Leaving four fingers east of the western entrance, / the wise man should erase the line so that it takes the shape of a trident. // 159

31.s:
śūlāgre tvardhahastena tyaktvā padmāni kārayet /
adhaḥ śṛṅgatrayaṃ hastamadhye padmaṃ sakarṇikam // 160
31.d:
शूलाग्रे त्वर्धहस्तेन त्यक्त्वा पद्मानि कारयेत् ।
अधः शृङ्गत्रयं हस्तमध्ये पद्मं सकर्णिकम् ॥ 160
31.m: Leaving half a cubit at the tip of the trident, he should make lotuses; / below, the three prongs are a cubit; in the middle, a lotus with a pericarp. // 160

31.s:
mukhāgre dhārayetsūtraṃ tribhirhastaistu pātayet /
madhye cordhvaṃ tataḥ kuryādadhastādaṅguladvayam // 161
31.d:
मुखाग्रे धारयेत्सूत्रं त्रिभिर्हस्तैस्तु पातयेत् ।
मध्ये चोर्ध्वं ततः कुर्यादधस्तादङ्गुलद्वयम् ॥ 161
31.m: He should hold the cord at the tip of the face and drop it with three cubits; / in the middle and above he should then make two fingers below. // 161

31.s:
rekhādvayaṃ pātayeta yathā śūlaṃ bhavatyapi /
adhobhāgādibhiścordhvaṃ tatra rekhā prapadyate // 162
31.d:
रेखाद्वयं पातयेत यथा शूलं भवत्यपि ।
अधोभागादिभिश्चोर्ध्वं तत्र रेखा प्रपद्यते ॥ 162
31.m: He should cast two lines so that the trident comes to be; / from the lower parts and so forth upward, the line there extends. // 162

31.s:
samīkṛtya tataḥ sūtre ūrdhve dve evameva tu /
madhyaṃ padmaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ śūlādhastādyaśasvini // 163
ityeṣa maṇḍalavidhiḥ kathitaḥ saṃkṣepayogato mahāgurubhiḥ /
31.d:
समीकृत्य ततः सूत्रे ऊर्ध्वे द्वे एवमेव तु ।
मध्यं पद्मं प्रतिष्ठाप्यं शूलाधस्ताद्यशस्विनि ॥ 163
इत्येष मण्डलविधिः कथितः संक्षेपयोगतो महागुरुभिः ।
31.m:
Having leveled [them], then in the two upper cords in that very manner, / the central lotus is to be installed below the trident, O glorious lady. // 163
Thus this rule of the mandala has been declared in brief by the great gurus.

32.s:
atha kathaye mudrāṇāṃ gurvāgamagītamatra vidhim /
mudrā ca pratibimbātmā śrīmaddevyākhyayāmale /
uktā bimbodayaśrutyā vācyadvayavivecanāt // 1
32.d:
अथ कथये मुद्राणां गुर्वागमगीतमत्र विधिम् ।
मुद्रा च प्रतिबिम्बात्मा श्रीमद्देव्याख्ययामले ।
उक्ता बिम्बोदयश्रुत्या वाच्यद्वयविवेचनात् ॥ 1
32.m: Now I declare the rule of mudrās sung in the agamas of the gurus. / And the mudrā is essentially a reflection; in the venerable Devyāyāmala / it is spoken of as having the arising of the original image (bimba), through discernment of two meanings: // 1

32.s:
bimbātsamudayo yasyā ityuktā pratibimbatā /
vimbasya yasyā udaya ityuktā tadupāyatā // 2
32.d:
बिम्बात्समुदयो यस्या इत्युक्ता प्रतिबिम्बता ।
विम्बस्य यस्या उदय इत्युक्ता तदुपायता ॥ 2
32.m: That whose arising is from the original image (bimba)—thus its state of being a reflection is declared; / that from which the arising of the original image comes—thus its being the means to it is declared. // 2

32.s:
mudaṃ svarūpalābhākhyaṃ dehadvāreṇa cātmanām /
rātyarpayati yattena mudrā śāstreṣu varṇitā // 3
32.d:
मुदं स्वरूपलाभाख्यं देहद्वारेण चात्मनाम् ।
रात्यर्पयति यत्तेन मुद्रा शास्त्रेषु वर्णिता ॥ 3
32.m: Because through the body it imparts (rāti), provides, joy (muda), namely the attainment of one's own nature, / to selves, it is described as mudrā in the treatises. // 3

32.s:
tatra pradhānabhūtā śrīkhecarī devatātmikā /
niṣkalatvena vikhyātā sākalyena triśūlinī // 4
32.d:
तत्र प्रधानभूता श्रीखेचरी देवतात्मिका ।
निष्कलत्वेन विख्याता साकल्येन त्रिशूलिनी ॥ 4
32.m: Among them, the primary one is the venerable Khecarī, whose essence is the deity; / celebrated as partless, she is entirely the Trident-bearer (Triśūlinī). // 4

32.s:
karaṅkiṇī krodhanā ca bhairavī lelihānikā /
mahāpretā yogamudrā jvālinī kṣobhiṇī dhruvā // 5
32.d:
करङ्किणी क्रोधना च भैरवी लेलिहानिका ।
महाप्रेता योगमुद्रा ज्वालिनी क्षोभिणी ध्रुवा ॥ 5
32.m: Karaṅkiṇī, Krodhanā, Bhairavī, Lelihānikā, / Mahāpretā, Yogamudrā, Jvālinī, Kṣobhiṇī, Dhruvā— // 5

32.s:
ityevaṃbahubhedeyaṃ śrīkhecaryeva gīyate /
anyāstadaṅgabhūtāstu padmādyā mālinīmate // 6
32.d:
इत्येवंबहुभेदेयं श्रीखेचर्येव गीयते ।
अन्यास्तदङ्गभूतास्तु पद्माद्या मालिनीमते ॥ 6
32.m: thus as having many varieties is this venerable Khecarī alone proclaimed; / the others, such as Padmā, are its subordinate limbs according to the Mālinī doctrine. // 18

32.s:
tāsāṃ bahutvāmukhyatvayogābhyāṃ neha varṇanam /
śrīkhecarīsamāviṣṭo yadyatsthānaṃ samāśrayet // 7
32.d:
तासां बहुत्वामुख्यत्वयोगाभ्यां नेह वर्णनम् ।
श्रीखेचरीसमाविष्टो यद्यत्स्थानं समाश्रयेत् ॥ 7
32.m: Because of their multiplicity and secondary nature, they are not described here. / Whatever place one possessed by the venerable Khecarī resorts to, // 7

32.s:
devīsaṃnidhaye tatsyādalaṃ kiṃ ḍambarairvṛthā /
kāmye karmaṇi tāśca syurmukhyāḥ kasyāpi jātucit // 8
32.d:
देवीसंनिधये तत्स्यादलं किं डम्बरैर्वृथा ।
काम्ये कर्मणि ताश्च स्युर्मुख्याः कस्यापि जातुचित् ॥ 8
32.m: that becomes [a place] for the presence of the Goddess; what need is there of useless pretenses? / And in optional rituals, they may be primary for someone occasionally. // 8

32.s: mudrā caturvidhā kāyakaravākcittabhedataḥ // 9
32.d: मुद्रा चतुर्विधा कायकरवाक्चित्तभेदतः ॥ 9
32.m: And the mudrā is of four kinds according to the division into body, hand, speech, and mind. // 9

32.s:
tatra pūrṇena rūpeṇa khecarīmeva varṇaye /
baddhvā padmāsanaṃ yogī nābhāvakṣeśvaraṃ kṣipet // 10
32.d:
तत्र पूर्णेन रूपेण खेचरीमेव वर्णये ।
बद्ध्वा पद्मासनं योगी नाभावक्षेश्वरं क्षिपेत् ॥ 10
32.m: Among them, I shall describe Khecarī alone in her complete form: / Having assumed the lotus posture, the yogin should project the Lord of the Senses (akṣeśvara) into the navel. // 10

32.s:
daṇḍākāraṃ tu taṃ tāvannayedyāvatkakhatrayam /
nigṛhya tatra tattūrṇaṃ prerayet khatrayeṇa tu // 11
32.d:
दण्डाकारं तु तं तावन्नयेद्यावत्कखत्रयम् ।
निगृह्य तत्र तत्तूर्णं प्रेरयेत् खत्रयेण तु ॥ 11
32.m: He should lead it, shaped like a staff, as far as the triad of voids (kakhatraya); / having restrained it there quickly, he should impel it through the triad of voids. // 11

32.s:
etāṃ baddhvā khe gatiḥ syāditi śrīpūrvaśāsane /
dhvanijyotirmarudyuktaṃ cittaṃ viśramya copari // 12
32.d:
एतां बद्ध्वा खे गतिः स्यादिति श्रीपूर्वशासने ।
ध्वनिज्योतिर्मरुद्युक्तं चित्तं विश्रम्य चोपरि ॥ 12
32.m: Having bound this [mudrā], movement occurs in the sky—thus in the venerable Pūrvaśāsana. / Having rested the mind, endowed with sound, light, and wind, up above, // 12

32.s:
anenābhyāsayogena śivaṃ bhittvā paraṃ vrajet /
jatrvadhastātkarau kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ ca dakṣiṇe // 13
32.d:
अनेनाभ्यासयोगेन शिवं भित्त्वा परं व्रजेत् ।
जत्र्वधस्तात्करौ कृत्वा वामपादं च दक्षिणे ॥ 13
32.m: by the practice of this yoga, piercing Śiva, he should go to the Supreme. / Placing the two hands below the collarbones, and the left foot on the right, // 13

32.s:
vidāryāsyaṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu nāsikām /
anāme kuñcayetprājño bhrūbhaṅgaṃ tarjanīdvayam // 14
32.d:
विदार्यास्यं कनिष्ठाभ्यां मध्यमाभ्यां तु नासिकाम् ।
अनामे कुञ्चयेत्प्राज्ञो भ्रूभङ्गं तर्जनीद्वयम् ॥ 14
32.m: opening the mouth wide with the two little fingers, and the nose with the two middle fingers, / the wise man should bend the ring fingers, and [cause] a knitting of the brows with the two index fingers. // 14

32.s:
jihvāṃ ca cālayenmantrī hāhākāraṃ ca kārayet /
triśūlena prayogeṇa brahmarandhramupasthitaḥ // 15
32.d:
जिह्वां च चालयेन्मन्त्री हाहाकारं च कारयेत् ।
त्रिशूलेन प्रयोगेण ब्रह्मरन्ध्रमुपस्थितः ॥ 15
32.m: And the mantrin should move the tongue and produce the 'hāhā' sound; / by means of the trident practice, having arrived at the brahmarandhra, // 15

32.s:
padaṃ santyajya tanmātraṃ sadyastyajati medinīm /
śūnyāśūnyalaye kṛtvā ekadaṇḍe'nilānalau // 16
32.d:
पदं सन्त्यज्य तन्मात्रं सद्यस्त्यजति मेदिनीम् ।
शून्याशून्यलये कृत्वा एकदण्डेऽनिलानलौ ॥ 16
32.m: relinquishing the plane of subtle elements, he instantly abandons the earth. / Having dissolved in the void and non-void, the wind and fire in a single staff, // 16

32.s:
śaktitritayasambaddhe adhiṣṭhātṛtridaivate /
triśūlaṃ tadvijānīyādyena vyomotpatedbudhaḥ // 17
32.d:
शक्तित्रितयसम्बद्धे अधिष्ठातृत्रिदैवते ।
त्रिशूलं तद्विजानीयाद्येन व्योमोत्पतेद्बुधः ॥ 17
32.m: connected with the triad of powers, having the triad of deities as presiding lords, / one should know that as the trident by which the wise man flies up into the sky. // 17

32.s:
ākāśabhāvaṃ santyajya sattāmātramupasthitaḥ /
śūlaṃ samarasaṃ kṛtvā rase rasa iva sthitaḥ // 18
32.d:
आकाशभावं सन्त्यज्य सत्तामात्रमुपस्थितः ।
शूलं समरसं कृत्वा रसे रस इव स्थितः ॥ 18
32.m: Abandoning the state of space, having arrived at mere Being, / making the trident of equal flavor, abiding like taste in fluid, // 18

32.s:
ekadaṇḍaṃ sa vijñāya triśūlaṃ khacaraṃ priye /
baddhvā tu khecarīṃ mudrāṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ ca bhairavam // 19
32.d:
एकदण्डं स विज्ञाय त्रिशूलं खचरं प्रिये ।
बद्ध्वा तु खेचरीं मुद्रां ध्यात्वात्मानं च भैरवम् ॥ 19
32.m: knowing that sky-traversing trident as a single staff, O dear one, / having bound the Khecarī mudrā, and meditating upon oneself as Bhairava, // 19

32.s:
khecarīcakrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ sadyastyajati medinīm /
tyaktāṃśako nirācāro niḥśaṅko lokavarjitaḥ // 20
32.d:
खेचरीचक्रसंजुष्टं सद्यस्त्यजति मेदिनीम् ।
त्यक्तांशको निराचारो निःशङ्को लोकवर्जितः ॥ 20
32.m: accompanied by the wheel of khecarīs, he instantly abandons the earth. / Casting off shares, free from conventional conduct, free from doubt, secluded from worldly people, // 20

32.s:
avadhūto nirācāro nāhamasmīti bhāvayam /
mantraikaniṣṭhaḥ saṃpaśyan dehasthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ // 21
32.d:
अवधूतो निराचारो नाहमस्मीति भावयम् ।
मन्त्रैकनिष्ठः संपश्यन् देहस्थाः सर्वदेवताः ॥ 21
32.m: an avadhūta, free from conventional conduct, contemplating 'I am not,' / solely devoted to mantra, perceiving all the deities residing in the body, // 21

32.s:
hlādodvegāsmitākruṣṭanidrāmaithunamatsare /
rūpādau vā kartṛkarmakaraṇeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ // 22
32.d:
ह्लादोद्वेगास्मिताक्रुष्टनिद्रामैथुनमत्सरे ।
रूपादौ वा कर्तृकर्मकरणेषु च सर्वशः ॥ 22
32.m: in joy, agitation, egoism, reproach, sleep, sexual union, jealousy, / or in forms and so forth, and in subjects, objects, and instruments everywhere, // 22

32.s:
nāhamasmīti manvāna ekībhūtaṃ vicintayan /
karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam // 23
32.d:
नाहमस्मीति मन्वान एकीभूतं विचिन्तयन् ।
कर्णाक्षिमुखनासादिचक्रस्थं देवतागणम् ॥ 23
32.m: thinking 'I am not,' contemplating the host of deities residing in the wheels / of ears, eyes, mouth, nose, and so forth as unified, // 23

32.s:
grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā siddhyati sphuṭam /
vidyāśaṅkī malāśaṅkī śāstraśaṅkī na siddhyati // 24
32.d:
ग्रहीतारं सदा पश्यन् खेचर्या सिद्ध्यति स्फुटम् ।
विद्याशङ्की मलाशङ्की शास्त्रशङ्की न सिद्ध्यति ॥ 24
32.m: always seeing the grasper, he clearly attains spiritual accomplishment through Khecarī; / one who doubts knowledge, who doubts impurity, who doubts the scripture, does not attain spiritual accomplishment. // 24

32.s:
śivo raviḥ śivo vahniḥ paktṛtvātsa purohitaḥ /
tatrasthā devatāḥ sarvā dyotayantyo'khilaṃ jagat // 25
32.d:
शिवो रविः शिवो वह्निः पक्तृत्वात्स पुरोहितः ।
तत्रस्था देवताः सर्वा द्योतयन्त्योऽखिलं जगत् ॥ 25
32.m: Śiva is the sun, Śiva is fire; because of being the cooker, he is the priest; / all the deities residing there illumine the entire universe. // 25

32.s:
kaniṣṭhayā vidāryāsyaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ bhruvau tathā /
anāme madhyame vaktre jihvayā tālukaṃ spṛśet // 26
32.d:
कनिष्ठया विदार्यास्यं तर्जनीभ्यां भ्रुवौ तथा ।
अनामे मध्यमे वक्त्रे जिह्वया तालुकं स्पृशेत् ॥ 26
32.m: Opening the mouth wide with the little finger, and the two brows likewise with the two index fingers, / [placing] the ring and middle fingers in the mouth, he should touch the palate with the tongue. // 26

32.s:
eṣā karaṅkiṇī devī jvālinīṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam /
hanurlalāṭagau hastau prasāryāṅgulitaḥ sphuṭau // 27
32.d:
एषा करङ्किणी देवी ज्वालिनीं शृणु सांप्रतम् ।
हनुर्ललाटगौ हस्तौ प्रसार्याङ्गुलितः स्फुटौ ॥ 27
32.m: This is the goddess Karaṅkiṇī; hear now of Jvālinī: / The two hands placed on the chin and forehead, clearly extended from the fingers, // 27

32.s:
cālayedvāyuvegena kṛtvāntarbhrukuṭīṃ budhaḥ /
vidāryāsyaṃ sajihvaṃ ca hāhākāraṃ tu kārayet // 28
32.d:
चालयेद्वायुवेगेन कृत्वान्तर्भ्रुकुटीं बुधः ।
विदार्यास्यं सजिह्वं च हाहाकारं तु कारयेत् ॥ 28
32.m: the wise man should move with the speed of the wind, having made an internal frown; / opening wide the mouth together with the tongue, he should make the 'hāhā' sound. // 28

32.s:
eṣā jvālinyagnicakre tayā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam /
japedyadi tataḥ siddhyettrailokyaṃ sacarācaram // 29
32.d:
एषा ज्वालिन्यग्निचक्रे तया चाष्टोत्तरं शतम् ।
जपेद्यदि ततः सिद्ध्येत्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥ 29
32.m: This is Jvālinī in the circle of fire; if one recites [a mantra] a hundred and eight times with it, / then the three worlds, with the moving and unmoving, will be mastered. // 29

32.s:
paradeheṣu cātmānaṃ paraṃ cātmaśarīrataḥ /
paśyeccarantaṃ hānādādgamāgamapadasthitam // 30
32.d:
परदेहेषु चात्मानं परं चात्मशरीरतः ।
पश्येच्चरन्तं हानादाद्गमागमपदस्थितम् ॥ 30
32.m: And in other bodies he should see oneself, and the other from one's own body, / moving, established in the state of arrival and departure through the sound hā. // 30

32.s:
navacchidragataṃ caikaṃ nadantaṃ vyāpakaṃ dhruvam /
anayā hi khacārī śrīyogasañcāra ucyate // 31
32.d:
नवच्छिद्रगतं चैकं नदन्तं व्यापकं ध्रुवम् ।
अनया हि खचारी श्रीयोगसञ्चार उच्यते ॥ 31
32.m: And one [power] residing in the nine apertures, sounding, all-pervading, constant; / by means of this, indeed, the moving in the void, the glorious transmigration of yoga, is taught. // 31

32.s:
kulakuṇḍalikāṃ baddhvā aṇorantaravedinīm /
vāmo yo'yaṃ jagatyasmiṃstasya saṃharaṇodyatām // 32
32.d:
कुलकुण्डलिकां बद्ध्वा अणोरन्तरवेदिनीम् ।
वामो योऽयं जगत्यस्मिंस्तस्य संहरणोद्यताम् ॥ 32
32.m: Having bound the Kulakuṇḍalikā, who experiences the interior of the soul, / who is intent upon the dissolution of whatever is left (vāma) in this universe, // 32

32.s:
svasthāne nirvṛtiṃ labdhvā jñānāmṛtarasātmakam /
vrajetkandapadaṃ madhye rāvaṃ kṛtvā hyarāvakam // 33
32.d:
स्वस्थाने निर्वृतिं लब्ध्वा ज्ञानामृतरसात्मकम् ।
व्रजेत्कन्दपदं मध्ये रावं कृत्वा ह्यरावकम् ॥ 33
32.m: having found peace in one's own place, consisting of the nectar-sap of consciousness, / making a sound without sound, he should go to the plane of the bulb (kanda) in the center. // 33

32.s:
yāvajjīvaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ piṇḍādhāraṃ ca kāmikam /
tatra tāṃ bodhayitvā tu gatiṃ buddhvā kramāgatām // 34
32.d:
यावज्जीवं चतुष्कोणं पिण्डाधारं च कामिकम् ।
तत्र तां बोधयित्वा तु गतिं बुद्ध्वा क्रमागताम् ॥ 34
32.m: As far as the vital breath (jīva), the four-cornered foundation of the body, fulfilling desires— / having awakened her there and comprehended the movement that has arrived in succession, // 34

32.s:
cakrobhayanibaddhāṃ tu śākhāprāntāvalambinīm /
mūlasthānādyathā devi tamogranthiṃ vidārayet // 35
32.d:
चक्रोभयनिबद्धां तु शाखाप्रान्तावलम्बिनीम् ।
मूलस्थानाद्यथा देवि तमोग्रन्थिं विदारयेत् ॥ 35
32.m: bound to both wheels, clinging to the ends of the branches, / so that, O Goddess, he may pierce the knot of darkness from the root-place, // 35

32.s:
vajrākhyāṃ jñānajenaiva tathā śākhobhayāntataḥ /
koṇamadhyaviniṣkrāntaṃ liṅgamūlaṃ vibhedayet // 36
32.d:
वज्राख्यां ज्ञानजेनैव तथा शाखोभयान्ततः ।
कोणमध्यविनिष्क्रान्तं लिङ्गमूलं विभेदयेत् ॥ 36
32.m: and similarly, from both ends of the branches, through that which is born of knowledge, / he should pierce the [nāḍī] called Vajrā and the root of the sexual organ, emerging from the center of the corner. // 36

32.s:
tatra saṅghaṭṭitaṃ cakrayugmamaikyena bhāsate /
vaiparītyāttu nikṣipya dvidhābhāvaṃ vrajatyataḥ // 37
32.d:
तत्र सङ्घट्टितं चक्रयुग्ममैक्येन भासते ।
वैपरीत्यात्तु निक्षिप्य द्विधाभावं व्रजत्यतः ॥ 37
32.m: There, the coupled pair of wheels shines as one through union; / but when cast inversely, it proceeds from there into duality. // 37

32.s:
ūrvādyaṅguṣṭhakālāgniparyante sā vinikṣipet /
gamāgamanasañcāre caretsā liṅgaliṅginī // 38
32.d:
ऊर्वाद्यङ्गुष्ठकालाग्निपर्यन्ते सा विनिक्षिपेत् ।
गमागमनसञ्चारे चरेत्सा लिङ्गलिङ्गिनी ॥ 38
32.m: From the thighs down to the great toe and the Kālāgni, she should cast [it]; / in the movement of departing and arriving, that female possessor of the linga should move. // 38

32.s:
tatra tatpadasaṃyogādunmīlanavidhāyinī /
yo jānāti sa siddhyettu rasādānavisargayoḥ // 39
32.d:
तत्र तत्पदसंयोगादुन्मीलनविधायिनी ।
यो जानाति स सिद्ध्येत्तु रसादानविसर्गयोः ॥ 39
32.m:
There, through union with that plane, she effects opening;
he who knows her will attain spiritual accomplishment in the taking and releasing of essence.

32.s:
sasaṅgamamidaṃ sthānamūrmiṇyunmīlanaṃ param /
eṣa kramastato'nyo'pi vyutkramaḥ khecarī parā // 40
32.d:
ससङ्गममिदं स्थानमूर्मिण्युन्मीलनं परम् ।
एष क्रमस्ततोऽन्योऽपि व्युत्क्रमः खेचरी परा ॥ 40
32.m:
This place of conjunction is the wavy, supreme opening;
this is the order of succession. Another, the counter-order, is the supreme Khecarī:

32.s:
yonyādhāreti vikhyātā śūlamūleti śabdyate /
varṇāstatra layaṃ yānti hyavarṇe varṇarūpiṇi // 41
32.d:
योन्याधारेति विख्याता शूलमूलेति शब्द्यते ।
वर्णास्तत्र लयं यान्ति ह्यवर्णे वर्णरूपिणि ॥ 41
32.m:
celebrated as the receptacle of the womb (yonyādhārā), she is called the base of the trident;
there the phonemes dissolve into that which is without phoneme, yet composed of phoneme.

32.s:
nādiphāntaṃ samuccārya kauleśaṃ dehasaṃnibham /
ākramya prathamaṃ cakraṃ khe yantre pādapīḍitam // 42
32.d:
नादिफान्तं समुच्चार्य कौलेशं देहसंनिभम् ।
आक्रम्य प्रथमं चक्रं खे यन्त्रे पादपीडितम् ॥ 42
32.m:
Pronouncing [the mantra] from Na to Pha, which resembles the body of the Lord of Kula,
having stepped upon the first cakra, pressed by the foot in the void instrument,

32.s:
nādaṃ vai śaktisadgarbhaṃ sadgarbhātkaulinīpadam /
bījapañcakacāreṇa śūlabhedakrameṇa tu // 43
32.d:
नादं वै शक्तिसद्गर्भं सद्गर्भात्कौलिनीपदम् ।
बीजपञ्चकचारेण शूलभेदक्रमेण तु ॥ 43
32.m:
verily to the resonance pregnant with power, from that pregnant one to the plane of Kaulinī,
by the motion through the five seed-syllables, in the sequence of piercing the tridents,

32.s:
hṛcchūlagranthibhedaiścidrudraśaktiṃ prabodhayet /
vāyucakrāntanilayaṃ bindvākhyaṃ nābhimaṇḍalam // 44
32.d:
हृच्छूलग्रन्थिभेदैश्चिद्रुद्रशक्तिं प्रबोधयेत् ।
वायुचक्रान्तनिलयं बिन्द्वाख्यं नाभिमण्डलम् ॥ 44
32.m:
through piercing the knots of the heart-trident one should awaken the power of Cit-Rudra;
[then] to the navel circle named the point, which abides at the end of the wind-cakra,

32.s:
āgacchellambikāsthānaṃ sūtradvādaśanirgatam /
candracakravilomena praviśedbhūtapañjare // 45
32.d:
आगच्छेल्लम्बिकास्थानं सूत्रद्वादशनिर्गतम् ।
चन्द्रचक्रविलोमेन प्रविशेद्भूतपञ्जरे ॥ 45
32.m:
one should proceed to the place of the uvula that has emerged from the twelve threads;
in reverse to the moon-cakra, one should enter into the cage of the elements.

32.s:
bhūyastu kurute līlāṃ māyāpañjaravartinīm /
punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhṛtiśca khecaryā kriyate budhaiḥ // 46
32.d:
भूयस्तु कुरुते लीलां मायापञ्जरवर्तिनीम् ।
पुनः सृष्टिः संहृतिश्च खेचर्या क्रियते बुधैः ॥ 46
32.m:
Then once more she engages in play within the cage of māyā;
emission and resorption are performed again by the wise through Khecarī.

32.s:
śrīmadvīrāvalīyoga eṣa syātkhecarīvidhiḥ /
cumbākāreṇa vaktreṇa yattattvaṃ śrūyate param // 47
32.d:
श्रीमद्वीरावलीयोग एष स्यात्खेचरीविधिः ।
चुम्बाकारेण वक्त्रेण यत्तत्त्वं श्रूयते परम् ॥ 47
32.m:
In the venerable Vīrāvalī yoga, this is the ritual practice of Khecarī.
Through a kiss-shaped mouth, the supreme reality that is heard,

32.s:
grasamānamidaṃ viśvaṃ candrārkapuṭasaṃpuṭe /
tenaiva syātkhagāmīti śrīmatkāmika ucyate // 48
32.d:
ग्रसमानमिदं विश्वं चन्द्रार्कपुटसंपुटे ।
तेनैव स्यात्खगामीति श्रीमत्कामिक उच्यते ॥ 48
32.m:
swallowing this universe within the sealed cavity of moon and sun—
by that very means one moves in the void (khecara); thus it is taught in the venerable Kāmika.

32.s:
bhavānmuktvā drāvayanti pāśānmudrā hi śaktayaḥ /
mukhyāsāṃ khecarī sā ca tridhoccāreṇa vācikī // 49
32.d:
भवान्मुक्त्वा द्रावयन्ति पाशान्मुद्रा हि शक्तयः ।
मुख्यासां खेचरी सा च त्रिधोच्चारेण वाचिकी ॥ 49
32.m:
Mudrās are powers indeed, for they release [the soul] from worldly existence and liquefy bonds.
The chief among them is Khecarī, and that is threefold: vocal, by pronunciation;

32.s:
triśiromudgaro devi kāyikī paripaṭhyate /
nāsāṃ netradvayaṃ cāpi hṛtstanadvayameva ca // 50
32.d:
त्रिशिरोमुद्गरो देवि कायिकी परिपठ्यते ।
नासां नेत्रद्वयं चापि हृत्स्तनद्वयमेव च ॥ 50
32.m:
the three-headed hammer, O goddess, is recited as the bodily [mudrā]:
reaching the nose, both eyes, the heart, and both breasts,

32.s:
vṛṣaṇadvayaliṅgaṃ ca prāpya kāyaṃ gatā tviyam /
bhavasthānābhavasthānamuccāreṇāvadhārayet // 51
32.d:
वृषणद्वयलिङ्गं च प्राप्य कायं गता त्वियम् ।
भवस्थानाभवस्थानमुच्चारेणावधारयेत् ॥ 51
32.m:
and both testicles and the penis, this has entered the body;
by pronunciation, one should determine the place of becoming and the place of non-becoming.

32.s:
mānasīyamitastvanyāḥ padmādyā aṣṭa mudrikāḥ /
mātṛvyūhakule tāḥ syurasyāstu parivāragāḥ // 52
32.d:
मानसीयमितस्त्वन्याः पद्माद्या अष्ट मुद्रिकाः ।
मातृव्यूहकुले ताः स्युरस्यास्तु परिवारगाः ॥ 52
32.m:
This is mental; yet other than this are the eight mudrās beginning with the lotus.
In the family of the assembly of mothers, they are her retinue.

32.s:
śarīraṃ tu samastaṃ yatkūṭākṣarasamākṛti /
eṣā mudrā mahāmudrā bhairavasyeti gahvare // 53
32.d:
शरीरं तु समस्तं यत्कूटाक्षरसमाकृति ।
एषा मुद्रा महामुद्रा भैरवस्येति गह्वरे ॥ 53
32.m:
The entire body whose shape is like the conjunct letter:
this mudrā is the Mahāmudrā of Bhairava; thus in the Gahvara.

32.s:
sūpaviṣṭaḥ padmake tu hastāgrāṅguliraśmibhiḥ /
parāṅmukhairjhaṭityudyadraśmibhiḥ pṛṣṭhasaṃsthitaiḥ // 54
32.d:
सूपविष्टः पद्मके तु हस्ताग्राङ्गुलिरश्मिभिः ।
पराङ्मुखैर्झटित्युद्यद्रश्मिभिः पृष्ठसंस्थितैः ॥ 54
32.m:
Seated well in the lotus posture, with the rays of the fingertips
averted, with the suddenly rising rays situated behind,

32.s:
antaḥsthitiḥ khecarīyaṃ saṃkocākhyā śaśāṅkinī /
tasmādeva samuttambya bāhū caivāvakuñcitau // 55
32.d:
अन्तःस्थितिः खेचरीयं संकोचाख्या शशाङ्किनी ।
तस्मादेव समुत्तम्ब्य बाहू चैवावकुञ्चितौ ॥ 55
32.m:
this inner abiding is the Khecarī named Saṃkocā, holding the moon.
Bracing [oneself] from that very [posture], with both arms drawn back,

32.s:
samyagvyomasu saṃsthānādvyomākhyā khecarī matā /
muṣṭidvitayasaṅghaṭṭāddhṛdi sā hṛdayāhvāyā // 56
32.d:
सम्यग्व्योमसु संस्थानाद्व्योमाख्या खेचरी मता ।
मुष्टिद्वितयसङ्घट्टाद्धृदि सा हृदयाह्वाया ॥ 56
32.m:
because of standing firmly in the voids, it is considered the Khecarī named Vyomā.
From the striking together of both fists at the heart, it is named Hṛdayā.

32.s:
śāntākhyā sā hastayugmamūrdhvādhaḥ sthitamudgatam /
samadṛṣṭyāvalokyaṃ ca bahiryojitapāṇikam // 57
32.d:
शान्ताख्या सा हस्तयुग्ममूर्ध्वाधः स्थितमुद्गतम् ।
समदृष्ट्यावलोक्यं च बहिर्योजितपाणिकम् ॥ 57
32.m:
She is named Śāntā: the pair of hands placed raised up and downward,
to be viewed with an even gaze, with the hands joined outward.

32.s:
eṣaiva śaktimudrā cedadhodhāvitapāṇikā /
daśānāmaṅgulīnāṃ tu muṣṭibandhādanantaram // 58
32.d:
एषैव शक्तिमुद्रा चेदधोधावितपाणिका ।
दशानामङ्गुलीनां तु मुष्टिबन्धादनन्तरम् ॥ 58
32.m:
This very one is the Śaktimudrā if the hands are turned downward;
then, after forming a fist with the ten fingers,

32.s:
drākkṣepātkhecarī devī pañcakuṇḍalinī matā /
saṃhāramudrā caiṣaiva yadyūrdhvaṃ kṣipyate kila // 59
32.d:
द्राक्क्षेपात्खेचरी देवी पञ्चकुण्डलिनी मता ।
संहारमुद्रा चैषैव यद्यूर्ध्वं क्षिप्यते किल ॥ 59
32.m:
by a sudden casting forth, the goddess Khecarī is considered Pañcakuṇḍalinī.
And this very one is the Saṃhāramudrā if it is cast upward.

32.s:
utkrāmaṇī jhagityeva paśūnāṃ pāśakartarī /
śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svātmānaṃ pātayanniva // 60
32.d:
उत्क्रामणी झगित्येव पशूनां पाशकर्तरी ।
श्वभ्रे सुदूरे झटिति स्वात्मानं पातयन्निव ॥ 60
32.m:
Utkrāmaṇī suddenly cuts the fetters of bound souls,
as if casting oneself rapidly into a distant abyss,

32.s:
sāhasānupraveśena kuñcitaṃ hastayugmakam /
